# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key supplied as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. In production, auth may be validated by the API gateway and forwarded via Telnyx auth headers.

* API Key (Payment)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. Machine Payment Protocol credential used on paid retries, sent as `Authorization: Payment ...`. Obtained by paying a challenge returned in the `WWW-Authenticate` header of a 402 response. This is not a Telnyx API key; initial challenge requests use standard bearer authentication instead.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key. Generate one at https://portal.telnyx.com/#/app/api-keys.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key. Collections and results are automatically scoped to the authenticated user's organization.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key. Generate one at https://portal.telnyx.com/#/app/api-keys.

- oAuth2 authentication. OAuth 2.0 authentication for Telnyx API and MCP integrations

    - Flow: clientCredentials
    - Token URL = [https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token](https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|admin|Administrative access to Telnyx resources|

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/authorize](https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/authorize)
    - Token URL = [https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token](https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token)
    - Refresh URL = [https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token](https://api.telnyx.com/v2/oauth/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|admin|Administrative access to Telnyx resources|

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key, not the processor bearer token.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API v2 key. Obtain from https://portal.telnyx.com

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Management-only Telnyx account credential.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key. Results are automatically scoped to the authenticated user's organization.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer Telnyx API key

<h1 id="telnyx-api-ai-collections">AI Collections</h1>

Create and manage logical collections of your Telnyx data, tune retrieval settings, manage sources, and run collection-scoped semantic search.

## List collections

<a id="opIdListCollections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/collections \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai/collections`

Returns a paginated list of collections in your organization.

<h3 id="list-collections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|Page number to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Number of results per page. Defaults to 20.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "uuid": "6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e",
      "slug": "support-transcripts",
      "record_type": "ai_collection",
      "name": "Support Transcripts",
      "description": "All customer support voice transcripts.",
      "status": "ready",
      "sources": [
        {
          "id": "source_8vkvtcksnawvbnxq48yv2l06wx",
          "record_type": "ai_collection_source",
          "collection_id": "6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e",
          "source_type": "voice",
          "bucket_id": "policy-docs",
          "status": "ready"
        }
      ],
      "settings": {
        "record_type": "ai_collection_settings",
        "retrieval": {
          "top_k": 5,
          "retrieval_type": "vector"
        }
      },
      "created_at": "2026-08-04T12:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-08-04T12:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 42,
    "page_number": 1,
    "page_size": 20
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10009",
      "title": "Authentication failed",
      "detail": "The required authentication headers were either invalid or not included in the request.",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10009"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-collections-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A paginated list of collections.|[CollectionListEnvelope](#schemacollectionlistenvelope)|
|401|Unauthorized|Missing or invalid authentication.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Create a collection

<a id="opIdCreateCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/collections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Support Transcripts",
    "description": "All customer support voice transcripts.",
    "slug": "support-transcripts",
    "sources": [
      {
        "source_type": "voice",
        "bucket_id": "policy-docs"
      }
    ],
    "settings": {
      "retrieval": {
        "top_k": 5,
        "retrieval_type": "vector"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /ai/collections`

Creates a new collection scoped to your organization. Optionally attach sources and retrieval settings at creation time. If `slug` is omitted, one is derived from `name` and must be unique within your organization.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Support Transcripts",
  "description": "All customer support voice transcripts.",
  "slug": "support-transcripts",
  "sources": [
    {
      "source_type": "voice",
      "bucket_id": "policy-docs"
    }
  ],
  "settings": {
    "retrieval": {
      "top_k": 5,
      "retrieval_type": "vector"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-collection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateCollectionRequest](#schemacreatecollectionrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Human-readable collection name.|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional description.|
|» slug|body|string|false|Optional slug (unique per organization). Derived from `name` when omitted.|
|» sources|body|[[SourceRequest](#schemasourcerequest)]|false|Optional sources to attach at creation time.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Optional retrieval settings.|
|» » retrieval|body|[RetrievalSettings](#schemaretrievalsettings)|false|How documents are retrieved when searching the collection.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "uuid": "6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e",
    "slug": "support-transcripts",
    "record_type": "ai_collection",
    "name": "Support Transcripts",
    "description": "All customer support voice transcripts.",
    "status": "ready",
    "sources": [
      {
        "id": "source_8vkvtcksnawvbnxq48yv2l06wx",
        "record_type": "ai_collection_source",
        "collection_id": "6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e",
        "source_type": "voice",
        "bucket_id": "policy-docs",
        "status": "ready"
      }
    ],
    "settings": {
      "record_type": "ai_collection_settings",
      "retrieval": {
        "top_k": 5,
        "retrieval_type": "vector"
      }
    },
    "created_at": "2026-08-04T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-08-04T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10015",
      "title": "Bad Request",
      "detail": "The request failed because it was not well-formed.",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10015"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10009",
      "title": "Authentication failed",
      "detail": "The required authentication headers were either invalid or not included in the request.",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10009"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "collection_slug_taken",
      "title": "Collection slug already in use",
      "detail": "A collection with slug 'support-transcripts' already exists for this account.",
      "meta": {
        "pointer": "/slug"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "invalid_source_configuration",
      "title": "Invalid source configuration",
      "detail": "The bucket_id field is required when source_type is bucket.",
      "meta": {
        "pointer": "/sources/0/bucket_id"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-collection-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Collection created.|[CollectionEnvelope](#schemacollectionenvelope)|
|400|Bad Request|The request was malformed or failed validation.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|
|401|Unauthorized|Missing or invalid authentication.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|
|409|Conflict|The request conflicts with existing state (e.g. duplicate slug or duplicate source).|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error -- a `bucket` source without a `bucket_id` (`invalid_source_configuration`), an unknown `source_type` (`invalid_source_type`), an unsupported `retrieval_type` (`unsupported_retrieval_type`), or `top_k` out of range 1-50 (`invalid_top_k`).|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Delete a collection

<a id="opIdDeleteCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/collections/6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /ai/collections/{uuid}`

Soft-deletes a collection. Its `slug` is freed and may be reused by a new collection.

## Update a collection

<a id="opIdUpdateCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/collections/6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Support Transcripts (2026)",
    "description": "Updated description."
  }'
```

`PATCH /ai/collections/{uuid}`

Updates a collection's metadata (`name` and/or `description`). Sources and settings are managed through their own sub-resources.

> Body parameter

```json

  "name": "Support Transcripts (2026)",
  "description": "Updated description."
}
```

|» description|body|string|false|none|

## Replace collection settings

<a id="opIdReplaceCollectionSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/collections/6a09ccbd-8f9b-4c3a-9b0e-2f1d3c4b5a6e/settings \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "retrieval": {
      "top_k": 5,
      "retrieval_type": "vector"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /ai/collections/{uuid}/settings`

Replaces the collection's retrieval settings.

> Body parameter

## Search collection documents

<a id="opIdSearchCollectionDocuments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/knowledge/collections/support-transcripts/documents \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai/knowledge/collections/{slug}/documents`

Runs search over the documents in a collection, ranked by relevance to `query`. Searches currently run `vector` retrieval (semantic similarity). The collection's `retrieval_type` setting is the forward-compatible selector: `hybrid` (vector similarity fused with keyword matching) can be set but cannot be searched yet, and `keyword` (lexical BM25 matching) is not accepted yet -- setting it returns 422 `unsupported_retrieval_type`. A per-request `retrieval_type` is accepted but ignored; `meta.retrieval_type` echoes the mode that actually ran. When `query` is omitted, returns a plain catalog listing of the collection's documents.

**How it works:**
1. The `query` text is embedded into a 1024-dimensional vector using the multilingual-e5-large model.
2. The embedding is compared against the collection's indexed document chunks using semantic similarity. When `hybrid` and `keyword` execution ship, those scores will be fused with, or replaced by, lexical BM25 matching.
3. Results are ranked by `score` (descending) and paginated via `page[number]` / `page[size]`.

**Authentication:** Requires a Telnyx API key via `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Results are automatically scoped to your organization and cannot be overridden.

**Filtering:** Use `filter[field][operator]=value` query parameters to narrow results before search. Supported operators: `eq` (default), `in`, `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt`, `contains`. Metadata fields resolve to `metadata.<field>`.

**Examples:**
- `GET /v2/ai/knowledge/collections/my-collection/documents?query=billing+issue&top_k=10`
- `GET /v2/ai/knowledge/collections/my-collection/documents?query=refund&sources=voice,message`
- `GET /v2/ai/knowledge/collections/my-collection/documents?query=outage&filter[record_created_at][gte]=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`

<h3 id="search-collection-documents-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slug|path|string|true|The collection's slug (unique within your organization).|
|query|query|string|false|Natural-language search query. When provided, the text is matched against the collection's document chunks using the collection's `retrieval_type` (vector or hybrid). When omitted, documents are returned as a plain catalog listing.|
|top_k|query|integer|false|Maximum number of ranked results to consider. When omitted, the collection's configured `top_k` setting is used.|
|sources|query|string|false|Comma-separated list of source types to restrict the search to. When omitted, all of the collection's sources are searched.|
|retrieval_type|query|string|false|Reserved; not yet functional. A value supplied here is accepted but ignored — it does not override the collection's configured strategy, and it is not echoed back. Searches run `vector` retrieval, and `meta.retrieval_type` reports the mode that actually ran. To change retrieval strategy, set it on the collection's settings subresource.|
|filter|query|object|false|Field filters applied before ranking, using `filter[field][operator]=value`. Supported operators: `eq` (default), `in`, `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt`, `contains`. Known fields: `record_type`, `record_id`, `user_id`, `record_created_at`, `ingested_at`; any other name resolves to a `metadata.<field>` filter. Example: `filter[record_id][eq]=rec_123`.|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|Page number to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Number of results per page. Defaults to 20.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|retrieval_type|vector|
|retrieval_type|hybrid|
|retrieval_type|keyword|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "record_id": "string",
      "record_type": "voice",
      "chunk_index": 0,
      "chunk_total": 0,
      "text": "string",
      "score": 0,
      "region": "string",
      "user_id": "string",
      "organization_id": "string",
      "record_created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "ingested_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "metadata": {}
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "collection_slug": "support-transcripts",
    "searched_sources": [
      "voice",
      "message"
    ],
    "retrieval_type": "vector",
    "top_k": 5,
    "total_results": 42,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "page_number": 1,
    "page_size": 20
  }
}
```

```json
    {
      "code": "10015",

      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h1 id="telnyx-api-ai-gateway">AI Gateway</h1>

Manage and report AI Gateway usage.

## List gateway spend events

<a id="opIdget_ai_gateway_spend_events"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/spend/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /llm_token_gateway/spend/events`

Return request-level usage history for the authenticated account. Supply both UTC dates or neither; omitting both returns the previous full UTC day. Dates use a half-open range [start_date, end_date) of at most 31 days. Cost reflects budget reference rates, not invoice charges. Unknown spend is excluded and reported separately. The report snapshot supports at most 10,000 matching requests, independently of page size. Exceeding this bound returns HTTP 503 without partial results. Narrow the date range or resource filters before retrying. A failed report must not be interpreted as zero usage. Request tags can filter either report and metadata:<key> can group the summary.

<h3 id="list-gateway-spend-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|none|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|none|
|page[snapshot]|query|string|false|Required after page 1; account/filter-bound 15-minute stable snapshot; expired/mismatch 409.|
|start_date|query|string(date)|false|none|
|end_date|query|string(date)|false|none|
|token_group_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|token_user_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|token_key_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|end_user_id|query|string|false|none|
|metadata|query|object|false|Request tag filters as metadata[<key>]=<value>, at most 5, combined with AND. A value matches the tag's text form exactly (booleans as true/false, integers in decimal), so metadata[flag]=true matches both boolean true and the string "true". Keys are case-sensitive; reserved-prefix keys are rejected. Unindexed: bounded by the account, the date range and the report timeout.|

## Get gateway spend summary

<a id="opIdget_ai_gateway_spend_summary"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/spend/summary?start_date=1970-01-01&end_date=1970-01-01&group_by=token_group' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /llm_token_gateway/spend/summary`

Return request counts, token counts and reference spend grouped by one attribution dimension. Both UTC dates and group_by are required. Dates use a half-open range [start_date, end_date) of at most 31 days. Cost reflects budget reference rates, not invoice charges. Unknown spend is excluded and reported separately. The report snapshot supports at most 10,000 matching requests, independently of page size. Exceeding this bound returns HTTP 503 without partial results. Narrow the date range or resource filters before retrying. A failed report must not be interpreted as zero usage. Request tags can filter either report and metadata:<key> can group the summary.

<h3 id="get-gateway-spend-summary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|none|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|none|
|page[snapshot]|query|string|false|Required after page 1; account/filter-bound 15-minute stable snapshot; expired/mismatch 409.|
|start_date|query|string(date)|true|none|
|end_date|query|string(date)|true|none|
|token_group_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|token_user_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|token_key_id|query|string(uuid)|false|none|
|end_user_id|query|string|false|none|
|metadata|query|object|false|Request tag filters as metadata[<key>]=<value>, at most 5, combined with AND. A value matches the tag's text form exactly (booleans as true/false, integers in decimal), so metadata[flag]=true matches both boolean true and the string "true". Keys are case-sensitive; reserved-prefix keys are rejected. Unindexed: bounded by the account, the date range and the report timeout.|
|group_by|query|[SpendGroupBy](#schemaspendgroupby)|true|A scope, or metadata:<key> to group by one request tag's text-form value; requests without the key form one group with a null dimension_id.|

## Create gateway token group

<a id="opIdcreate_token_groups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/token_groups \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: string' \
  -d '{
    "name": "support-backend",
    "allowed_models": [
      "Kimi-K3",
      "GLM-5.3-Flash"
    ],
    "max_parallel_requests": 20,
    "fallbacks": {
      "Kimi-K3": [
        "GLM-5.3-Flash"
      ]
    },
    "retries": {
      "max_attempts": 2,
      "retry_delay_ms": 250,
      "backoff": "exponential",
      "request_timeout_ms": 10000
    }
  }'
```

`POST /llm_token_gateway/token_groups`

Create gateway token group within the authenticated Telnyx account. Foreign and unknown resource IDs return the same 404 response.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "support-backend",
  "allowed_models": [
    "Kimi-K3",
    "GLM-5.3-Flash"
  ],
  "max_parallel_requests": 20,
  "fallbacks": {
    "Kimi-K3": [
      "GLM-5.3-Flash"
    ]
  },
  "retries": {
    "max_attempts": 2,
    "retry_delay_ms": 250,
    "backoff": "exponential",
    "request_timeout_ms": 10000
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-gateway-token-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|24h, scoped by account+method+path. Same key/body returns same outcome; changed body 409; in-progress 409 with Retry-After. Token-create replay returns 200 metadata WITHOUT secret.|
|body|body|[TokenGroupCreate](#schematokengroupcreate)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» max_budget|body|[Money](#schemamoney) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[Money](#schemamoney)|false|USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» budget_duration|body|[BudgetDuration](#schemabudgetduration)|false|none|
|» tpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» rpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» allowed_models|body|[string]|true|none|
|» max_parallel_requests|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|Optional maximum concurrent reserved/dispatched cache misses across replicas. Null means no concurrency cap. Cache hits do not consume slots; unknown usage retains its budget hold without a slot.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» cache_ttl|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» provider_key_ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» guardrails|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group guardrail policy. Missing actions default to ignore. profiles may be listed with both dlp actions ignore (staged, inactive) but a non-ignore dlp action requires at least one profile. streaming defaults to buffered when any response action is block and passthrough otherwise; passthrough with a response block is 400. Findings are codes and counts only; content is never stored. The stored form is echoed back canonicalised (all actions explicit, profiles sorted); {} is stored as an all-ignore policy, null disables.|
|» » secrets|body|object|false|none|
|» » » prompt|body|string|false|none|
|» » » response|body|string|false|none|
|» » dlp|body|object|false|none|
|» » » profiles|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » » prompt|body|string|false|none|
|» » » response|body|string|false|none|
|» » streaming|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» fallbacks|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group model fallbacks: primary alias -> ordered list of 1..3 other aliases. Every key and listed alias must be in allowed_models (a PATCH removing a referenced alias is 400); a chain never lists its own key; wildcards are rejected. Chains are one level deep (a step's own chain is not expanded). Fallback is attempted only for managed routes, only before the first provider event is forwarded, and only to steps the key may use; each attempt is reserved and recorded. {} and null both disable fallbacks.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» retries|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group same-route retries. max_attempts counts the first try of each step (the primary and each fallback) and is the ceiling for the x-ltg-max-attempts request header. A step is retried only when its attempt definitely did no provider work (connection failure before dispatch, or 429/529) before the first provider event; an uncertain failure (timeout, 408/500/502/503/504) moves to the next fallback step instead. max_attempts x (1 + the longest fallback chain) must not exceed 8, else 400. The n-th retry waits retry_delay_ms (constant), retry_delay_ms*n (linear) or retry_delay_ms*2^(n-1) (exponential), at most 5 s and never past the request deadline, then jittered uniformly down to half that value so concurrent retries spread out; a provider Retry-After of at most 5 s is honoured and a longer one moves to the next step. request_timeout_ms applies to streaming requests only: it bounds each attempt's time to its first provider event and never applies after it. Non-stream requests keep the per-attempt hop and idle bounds (their headers arrive only with the finished completion). retry_delay_ms and backoff are floors for the request knobs. Each planned attempt is reserved (at most 8 per request); unused reservation is released at settlement. Managed routes only. The stored form is echoed back with defaults filled in; null disables retries.|
|» » max_attempts|body|integer|true|none|
|» » retry_delay_ms|body|integer|false|none|
|» » backoff|body|string|false|none|
|» » request_timeout_ms|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» blocked|body|boolean|false|none|

## Update gateway token group

<a id="opIdpatch_token_groups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/token_groups/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: string' \
  -H 'If-Match: string' \
  -d '{
    "name": "support-backend",
    "allowed_models": [
      "Kimi-K3",
      "GLM-5.3-Flash"
    ],
    "max_parallel_requests": 20,
    "fallbacks": {
      "Kimi-K3": [
        "GLM-5.3-Flash"
      ]
    },
    "retries": {
      "max_attempts": 2,
      "retry_delay_ms": 250,
      "backoff": "exponential",
      "request_timeout_ms": 10000
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /llm_token_gateway/token_groups/{id}`

Update gateway token group within the authenticated Telnyx account. Foreign and unknown resource IDs return the same 404 response. Omitted fields are preserved. Null clears the optional concurrency, fallback and retry settings. A stale If-Match returns 412; read the resource again before updating.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "support-backend",
  "allowed_models": [
    "Kimi-K3",
    "GLM-5.3-Flash"
  ],
  "max_parallel_requests": 20,
  "fallbacks": {
    "Kimi-K3": [
      "GLM-5.3-Flash"
    ]
  },
  "retries": {
    "max_attempts": 2,
    "retry_delay_ms": 250,
    "backoff": "exponential",
    "request_timeout_ms": 10000
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-gateway-token-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|24h, scoped by account+method+path. Same key/body returns same outcome; changed body 409; in-progress 409 with Retry-After. Token-create replay returns 200 metadata WITHOUT secret.|
|If-Match|header|string|true|Exact quoted resource-version ETag; an exact intermediary-weakened echo W/"n" is accepted. Wildcard, combined and malformed validators are rejected; stale 412; missing 428. HTTP field names are case-insensitive. Replayed idempotent result is checked first.|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[TokenGroupPatch](#schematokengrouppatch)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» max_budget|body|[Money](#schemamoney) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[Money](#schemamoney)|false|USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» budget_duration|body|[BudgetDuration](#schemabudgetduration)|false|none|
|» tpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» rpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» allowed_models|body|[string]|false|none|
|» max_parallel_requests|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|Optional maximum concurrent reserved/dispatched cache misses across replicas. Null means no concurrency cap. Cache hits do not consume slots; unknown usage retains its budget hold without a slot.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» cache_ttl|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» provider_key_ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» guardrails|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group guardrail policy. Missing actions default to ignore. profiles may be listed with both dlp actions ignore (staged, inactive) but a non-ignore dlp action requires at least one profile. streaming defaults to buffered when any response action is block and passthrough otherwise; passthrough with a response block is 400. Findings are codes and counts only; content is never stored. The stored form is echoed back canonicalised (all actions explicit, profiles sorted); {} is stored as an all-ignore policy, null disables.|
|» » secrets|body|object|false|none|
|» » » prompt|body|string|false|none|
|» » » response|body|string|false|none|
|» » dlp|body|object|false|none|
|» » » profiles|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » » prompt|body|string|false|none|
|» » » response|body|string|false|none|
|» » streaming|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» fallbacks|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group model fallbacks: primary alias -> ordered list of 1..3 other aliases. Every key and listed alias must be in allowed_models (a PATCH removing a referenced alias is 400); a chain never lists its own key; wildcards are rejected. Chains are one level deep (a step's own chain is not expanded). Fallback is attempted only for managed routes, only before the first provider event is forwarded, and only to steps the key may use; each attempt is reserved and recorded. {} and null both disable fallbacks.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» retries|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|Per-group same-route retries. max_attempts counts the first try of each step (the primary and each fallback) and is the ceiling for the x-ltg-max-attempts request header. A step is retried only when its attempt definitely did no provider work (connection failure before dispatch, or 429/529) before the first provider event; an uncertain failure (timeout, 408/500/502/503/504) moves to the next fallback step instead. max_attempts x (1 + the longest fallback chain) must not exceed 8, else 400. The n-th retry waits retry_delay_ms (constant), retry_delay_ms*n (linear) or retry_delay_ms*2^(n-1) (exponential), at most 5 s and never past the request deadline, then jittered uniformly down to half that value so concurrent retries spread out; a provider Retry-After of at most 5 s is honoured and a longer one moves to the next step. request_timeout_ms applies to streaming requests only: it bounds each attempt's time to its first provider event and never applies after it. Non-stream requests keep the per-attempt hop and idle bounds (their headers arrive only with the finished completion). retry_delay_ms and backoff are floors for the request knobs. Each planned attempt is reserved (at most 8 per request); unused reservation is released at settlement. Managed routes only. The stored form is echoed back with defaults filled in; null disables retries.|
|» » max_attempts|body|integer|true|none|
|» » retry_delay_ms|body|integer|false|none|
|» » backoff|body|string|false|none|
|» » request_timeout_ms|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

## Create gateway token key

<a id="opIdcreate_token_keys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/token_keys \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: string' \
  -d '{
    "name": "support-service",
    "token_group_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    "max_parallel_requests": 5
  }'
```

`POST /llm_token_gateway/token_keys`

Create gateway token key within the authenticated Telnyx account. Foreign and unknown resource IDs return the same 404 response. The token secret is returned only on the original create response. A replay returns metadata without the secret. Provisioning is advisory; ready is not a guarantee of inference availability.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "support-service",
  "token_group_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "max_parallel_requests": 5
}
```

<h3 id="create-gateway-token-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|24h, scoped by account+method+path. Same key/body returns same outcome; changed body 409; in-progress 409 with Retry-After. Token-create replay returns 200 metadata WITHOUT secret.|
|body|body|[TokenKeyCreate](#schematokenkeycreate)|true|none|
|» max_parallel_requests|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|Optional maximum concurrent reserved/dispatched cache misses across replicas. Null means no concurrency cap. Cache hits do not consume slots; unknown usage retains its budget hold without a slot.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» token_group_id|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» token_user_id|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string(uuid)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» max_budget|body|[Money](#schemamoney) \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (1000 USD) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (0.000001 USD) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted. The default budget is lifetime unless budget_duration is set. Budgets and spend are an enforcement guard computed at one flat placeholder rate for every Telnyx-hosted model (rate_version telnyx-reference-v1: 5 USD per million input and 15 USD per million output tokens), not the customer's bill; Telnyx Inference usage is billed separately at the model's actual price.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[Money](#schemamoney)|false|USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» budget_duration|body|[BudgetDuration](#schemabudgetduration)|false|none|
|» tpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (10000000) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (1) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» rpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (6000) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (1) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» allowed_models|body|[string] \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» blocked|body|boolean|false|none|
|» required_end_user_id|body|boolean|false|Require a nonempty caller-asserted end-user ID; not proof of identity.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» budget_duration|1d|
|» budget_duration|7d|
|» budget_duration|30d|
|» budget_duration|null|

## Delete gateway token key

<a id="opIddelete_token_keys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/token_keys/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: string' \
  -H 'If-Match: string'
```

`DELETE /llm_token_gateway/token_keys/{id}`

Revoke this token key. Acknowledged revocation blocks new admissions with the key; requests already admitted may complete. Historical usage attribution is retained. Other keys in the group are unchanged.

<h3 id="delete-gateway-token-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|24h, scoped by account+method+path. Same key/body returns same outcome; changed body 409; in-progress 409 with Retry-After. Token-create replay returns 200 metadata WITHOUT secret.|
|If-Match|header|string|true|Exact quoted resource-version ETag; an exact intermediary-weakened echo W/"n" is accepted. Wildcard, combined and malformed validators are rejected; stale 412; missing 428. HTTP field names are case-insensitive. Replayed idempotent result is checked first.|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|

## Update gateway token key

<a id="opIdpatch_token_keys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/token_keys/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: string' \
  -H 'If-Match: string' \
  -d '{
    "max_parallel_requests": 5
  }'
```

`PATCH /llm_token_gateway/token_keys/{id}`

Update gateway token key within the authenticated Telnyx account. Foreign and unknown resource IDs return the same 404 response. Omitted fields are preserved. Null clears max_parallel_requests; null resets budget and rate limits to their maximum. A stale If-Match returns 412.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "max_parallel_requests": 5
}
```

<h3 id="update-gateway-token-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|24h, scoped by account+method+path. Same key/body returns same outcome; changed body 409; in-progress 409 with Retry-After. Token-create replay returns 200 metadata WITHOUT secret.|
|If-Match|header|string|true|Exact quoted resource-version ETag; an exact intermediary-weakened echo W/"n" is accepted. Wildcard, combined and malformed validators are rejected; stale 412; missing 428. HTTP field names are case-insensitive. Replayed idempotent result is checked first.|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[TokenKeyPatch](#schematokenkeypatch)|true|none|
|» max_parallel_requests|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|Optional maximum concurrent reserved/dispatched cache misses across replicas. Null means no concurrency cap. Cache hits do not consume slots; unknown usage retains its budget hold without a slot.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» max_budget|body|[Money](#schemamoney) \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (1000 USD) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (0.000001 USD) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted. The default budget is lifetime unless budget_duration is set. Budgets and spend are an enforcement guard computed at one flat placeholder rate for every Telnyx-hosted model (rate_version telnyx-reference-v1: 5 USD per million input and 15 USD per million output tokens), not the customer's bill; Telnyx Inference usage is billed separately at the model's actual price.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[Money](#schemamoney)|false|USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» budget_duration|body|[BudgetDuration](#schemabudgetduration)|false|none|
|» tpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (10000000) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (1) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» rpm_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Omitted or null defaults to the maximum (6000) (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked); a value below the minimum (1) or above the maximum is rejected with 400 limit_out_of_range; a malformed value (negative, wrong type or precision) is 400 invalid_request. Block the key (blocked: true) to deny it; blocking is always accepted.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» allowed_models|body|[string] \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string(date-time)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» blocked|body|boolean|false|none|
|» required_end_user_id|body|boolean|false|Require a nonempty caller-asserted end-user ID; not proof of identity. Omission preserves the current requirement.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» budget_duration|1d|
|» budget_duration|7d|
|» budget_duration|30d|
|» budget_duration|null|

## Export gateway usage

<a id="opIdexportGatewayUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/usage/export \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /llm_token_gateway/usage/export`

Durable, replayable, content-free usage export for customer pipelines. Requires the dedicated llm_token_gateway.usage_export.read V2 action; spend.read and usage.read do not grant it. Records are inference.request (one per immutable ledger revision; a correction adds a new id with supersedes, keep the highest revision per request_id) and guardrail.evaluation (one per guardrail event, including blocked prompts with no inference record; correlate on request_id). Delivery is at least once in commit order: deduplicate on id. Records appear after settlement and after every older database transaction has finished (meta.horizon_lag_seconds); keep polling with next_cursor, which is always returned and is reusable after has_more is false. After a logical database restore, restart from start_time and deduplicate on id; a cursor from before it may return 409 cursor_expired (no Retry-After). Retention promise 30 days. No prompts, responses, provider credentials, supplier or customer rates. Gateway reference/enforcement usage, not invoice truth or BYOK provider charges.

<h3 id="export-gateway-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|integer|false|none|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque next_cursor from a previous page; not combinable with start_time. Bound to the requested types; the account always comes from the credential.|
|start_time|query|string(date-time)|false|First page only: RFC 3339 with offset, at most 30 days ago and not in the future; default now - 24h.|
|types|query|string|false|Comma-separated subset of inference.request,guardrail.evaluation; default both.|

```json
  "meta": {
```

## Get gateway usage summary

<a id="opIdgateway_usage_summary"></a>

```bash
curl 'https://api.telnyx.com/v2/llm_token_gateway/usage/summary?token_group_id=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08&start_date=1970-01-01&end_date=1970-01-01' \
```

`GET /llm_token_gateway/usage/summary`

Gateway reference/enforcement usage, not invoice truth or BYOK provider charges. Requires the dedicated llm_token_gateway.usage.read V2 action for combined spend and guardrail reporting; existing spend.read and guardrail_events.read grants do not grant this endpoint. All totals, UTC daily buckets, models and latest 20 guardrail events share one database snapshot. UTC half-open dates, at most 31 days. Zero-filled days; at most 1000 models (503 rather than truncation on overflow/timeout). Known tokens sum independently known categories across latest attempt evidence, including corrections; unknown spend is excluded and unknown_requests/reserved_spend remain explicit. Guardrail counts count events, not distinct requests. No raw spend events, prompts or secrets. This read-only report creates no pagination snapshot and accepts no pagination parameters.

<h3 id="get-gateway-usage-summary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token_group_id|query|string(uuid)|true|none|
|start_date|query|string(date)|true|none|
|end_date|query|string(date)|true|none|
|metadata|query|object|false|Request tag filters as metadata[<key>]=<value>, at most 5, combined with AND. A value matches the tag's text form exactly (booleans as true/false, integers in decimal), so metadata[flag]=true matches both boolean true and the string "true". Keys are case-sensitive; reserved-prefix keys are rejected. Unindexed: bounded by the account, the date range and the report timeout.|

|401|Unauthorized|Wrong/missing credential for this plane.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|403|Forbidden|Blocked/expired, exhausted budget or disallowed model; scope identifies exhausted level.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|404|Not Found|Absent or foreign-account resource (indistinguishable).|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|409|Conflict|Membership, idempotency or snapshot conflict.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|412|Precondition Failed|ETag mismatch.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|428|Precondition Required|If-Match required.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Rate limited.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|502|Bad Gateway|upstream_error: every admitted provider attempt, including configured group retries and fallbacks, failed before the first provider event; streams return this real status instead of 200 plus an SSE error. Retrying is not idempotent.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The usage report is unavailable, its query timed out, or it exceeds the 1,000-model-row limit. No partial or truncated report is returned. Honor Retry-After for a temporary failure. If the report exceeds its limits, narrow the UTC date range or add metadata filters before retrying. Treat unavailable totals as unknown, not zero.|[ai-gateway_Error](#schemaai-gateway_error)|
|504|Gateway Timeout|upstream_timeout: as 502 upstream_error, but the last admitted attempt timed out waiting for the provider (connect, read or write timeout, the attempt deadline, or x-ltg-request-timeout) before its first event. Retrying is not idempotent.|[ai-gateway-resources_Error](#schemaai-gateway-resources_error)|

## Create a scheduled test job

<a id="opIdcreate_scheduled_test_job"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/tests/schedules/v1/cron-jobs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "crontab_expression": "0 3 * * *",
    "name": "Nightly regression",
    "agent": 1259,
    "scenarios": [
      9512
    ],
    "timezone": "America/Chicago",
    "execution_mode": "voice",
    "notify_on": "failure"
  }'
```

## Generate evaluator scenarios

<a id="opIdgenerate_evaluator_scenarios"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/tests/test_framework/v1/scenarios/generate-bg \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "num_scenarios": 5,
    "agent_id": 1259,
    "extra_instructions": "Focus on angry customers asking about refunds.",
    "scenario_type": "workflow",
    "generate_expected_outcomes": true
  }'
```

`POST /ai/tests/test_framework/v1/scenarios/generate-bg`

Starts background generation of evaluator scenarios for a test agent. Returns a progress ID to poll with the generate-scenarios-progress endpoint.

## Run evaluator scenarios

<a id="opIdrun_evaluator_scenarios"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/tests/test_framework/v1/scenarios/run_scenarios \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`POST /ai/tests/test_framework/v1/scenarios/run_scenarios`

Runs the selected evaluator scenarios against their test agents and creates a run batch. Returns the ID of the created batch, whose results can be listed with the test-run-results endpoints.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "agent_id": 1259,
  "scenarios": [
    9512
  ],
  "tags": [
    "regression"
  ],
  "mode": "same_number",
  "concurrency_limit": 3
}
```

|» assistant_id|body|string|false|none|

|» tags|body|[string]|false|none|
|» frequency|body|integer|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|

|» test_profile_ids|body|[integer]|false|none|
|» mode|body|string|false|none|

Generate a UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request body. Valid characters: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, -, and _. Length: 1-255 characters. Do not include sensitive data in the key.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|201|Created|JWT|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request / Validation Failed (10015). Invalid, duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong Idempotency-Key headers are rejected by Edge with HTTP 400 and error code 10015.|[telephony-credentials_ErrorResponse](#schematelephony-credentials_errorresponse)|
|404|Not Found|Resource not Found|None|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-actions">Actions</h1>

Execute browser actions: navigate, observe, click, fill, select, press, scroll, wait_for, screenshot, batch.

## Execute browser action

<a id="opIdExecuteBrowserAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/browser_sessions/string/actions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "type": "navigate",
    "url": "https://example.com/"
  }'
```

`POST /browser_sessions/{id}/actions`

Executes a browser action on the session. Returns 200 if completed within wait_seconds, 202 if still in-flight.

Action types: navigate, observe, click, fill, select, press, scroll, wait_for, screenshot, batch.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "type": "navigate",
  "url": "https://example.com/"
}
```

<h3 id="execute-browser-action-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|wait_seconds|query|integer|false|Maximum seconds the submission request waits for completion, not an execution timeout. If still queued or running, returns 202 without cancelling execution; poll the returned action ID.|
|body|body|[ActionRequest](#schemaactionrequest)|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[NavigateAction](#schemanavigateaction)|false|Navigate to a URL.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[ObserveAction](#schemaobserveaction)|false|Capture an observation (DOM snapshot) of the current page.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[ClickAction](#schemaclickaction)|false|Click an element identified by observation_id + ref.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[FillAction](#schemafillaction)|false|Type text into the element identified by observation_id + ref.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[SelectAction](#schemaselectaction)|false|Select an option on the element identified by observation_id + ref.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[PressAction](#schemapressaction)|false|Press a keyboard key.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[ScrollAction](#schemascrollaction)|false|Scroll the page.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[ScreenshotAction](#schemascreenshotaction)|false|Capture a screenshot of the current page.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[WaitForAction](#schemawaitforaction)|false|Wait for a condition before continuing.|
|» *oneOf*|body|[BatchAction](#schemabatchaction)|false|Execute 1-50 sub-actions sequentially. Non-recursive: a batch inside a batch is rejected (400). An empty array is rejected (400). A failed sub-action stops the batch; earlier browser mutations are not rolled back, but partial sub-action results are not returned.|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-addresses">Addresses</h1>

Operations to work with Address records. Address records are emergency-validated addresses meant to be associated with phone numbers. They are validated for emergency usage purposes at creation time, although you may validate them separately with a custom workflow using the ValidateAddress operation separately. Address records are not usable for physical orders, such as for Telnyx SIM cards, please use UserAddress for that. It is not possible to entirely skip emergency service validation for Address records; if an emergency provider for a phone number rejects the address then it cannot be used on a phone number. To prevent records from getting out of sync, Address records are immutable and cannot be altered once created. If you realize you need to alter an address, a new record must be created with the differing address.

## List all addresses

<a id="opIdFindAddresses"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/addresses \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /addresses`

Returns a paginated list of the addresses on your account, with support for filtering and sorting.

<h3 id="list-all-addresses-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[number], page[size]|
|filter|query|object|false|Consolidated filter parameter (deepObject style). Originally: filter[customer_reference][eq], filter[customer_reference][contains], filter[used_as_emergency], filter[street_address][contains], filter[address_book][eq]|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>street_address</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>street_address</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-street_address</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>street_address</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

|sort|first_name|
|sort|last_name|
|sort|business_name|
|sort|street_address|

## Creates an address

<a id="opIdCreateAddress"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/addresses \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "customer_reference": "MY REF 001",
    "first_name": "Alfred",
    "last_name": "Foster",
    "business_name": "Toy-O'\''Kon",
    "phone_number": "+12125559000",
    "street_address": "600 Congress Avenue",
    "extended_address": "14th Floor",
    "locality": "Austin",
    "administrative_area": "TX",
    "neighborhood": "Ciudad de los deportes",
    "borough": "Guadalajara",
    "postal_code": "78701",
    "country_code": "US",
    "address_book": false,
    "validate_address": true
  }'
```

`POST /addresses`

Creates a new address on your account from the provided details, for use with services that require a physical address such as emergency calling and regulatory compliance.

By default, the new record is validated for emergency use at creation time. If the address fails validation, no record is created and the request is rejected with a 422 response; the `errors` array includes a suggested value for each offending field when one is available.

Set `validate_address` to `false` to skip validation at creation, for example when the address was already validated with the Validate an address action. The record is then created without emergency validation: if it is not valid it will not be able to be used for emergency services (such as a phone number's emergency address), and because address records cannot be updated, a new record has to be created to correct it.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer_reference": "MY REF 001",
  "first_name": "Alfred",
  "last_name": "Foster",
  "business_name": "Toy-O'Kon",
  "phone_number": "+12125559000",
  "street_address": "600 Congress Avenue",
  "extended_address": "14th Floor",
  "locality": "Austin",
  "administrative_area": "TX",
  "neighborhood": "Ciudad de los deportes",
  "borough": "Guadalajara",
  "postal_code": "78701",
  "country_code": "US",
  "address_book": false,
  "validate_address": true
}
```

<h3 id="creates-an-address-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AddressCreate](#schemaaddresscreate)|true|Parameters that can be defined during address creation|
|» customer_reference|body|[customer_reference](#schemacustomer_reference)|false|A customer reference string for customer look ups.|
|» first_name|body|[first_name](#schemafirst_name)|true|The first name associated with the address. An address must have either a first last name or a business name.|
|» last_name|body|[last_name](#schemalast_name)|true|The last name associated with the address. An address must have either a first last name or a business name.|
|» business_name|body|[business_name](#schemabusiness_name)|true|The business name associated with the address. An address must have either a first last name or a business name.|
|» phone_number|body|[phone_number2](#schemaphone_number2)|false|The phone number associated with the address.|
|» street_address|body|[street_address](#schemastreet_address)|true|The primary street address information about the address.|
|» extended_address|body|[extended_address](#schemaextended_address)|false|Additional street address information about the address such as, but not limited to, unit number or apartment number.|
|» locality|body|[locality](#schemalocality)|true|The locality of the address. For US addresses, this corresponds to the city of the address.|
|» administrative_area|body|[administrative_area](#schemaadministrative_area)|false|The locality of the address. For US addresses, this corresponds to the state of the address.|
|» neighborhood|body|[neighborhood](#schemaneighborhood)|false|The neighborhood of the address. This field is not used for addresses in the US but is used for some international addresses.|
|» borough|body|[borough](#schemaborough)|false|The borough of the address. This field is not used for addresses in the US but is used for some international addresses.|
|» postal_code|body|[postal_code](#schemapostal_code)|false|The postal code of the address.|
|» country_code|body|[country_code2](#schemacountry_code2)|true|The two-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) country code of the address.|
|» address_book|body|[address_book](#schemaaddress_book)|false|Indicates whether or not the address should be considered part of your list of addresses that appear for regular use.|
|» validate_address|body|[validate_address](#schemavalidate_address)|false|Indicates whether or not the address should be validated for emergency use upon creation or not. This should be left with the default value of `true` unless you have used the `/addresses/actions/validate` endpoint to validate the address separately prior to creation. If an address is not validated for emergency use upon creation and it is not valid, it will not be able to be used for emergency services. In an address record, this flag indicates whether emergency validation was performed at creation: `true` means the record passed emergency validation before it was created; `false` means validation was skipped during this creation request, and the address may have been validated separately. This flag is not a current validity status; emergency use still requires a valid address.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "1293384261075731499",
    "record_type": "address",
    "customer_reference": "MY REF 001",
    "first_name": "Alfred",
    "last_name": "Foster",
    "business_name": "Toy-O'Kon",
    "phone_number": "+12125559000",
    "street_address": "600 Congress Avenue",
    "extended_address": "14th Floor",
    "locality": "Austin",
    "administrative_area": "TX",
    "neighborhood": "Ciudad de los deportes",
    "borough": "Guadalajara",
    "postal_code": "78701",
    "country_code": "US",
    "address_book": false,
    "validate_address": true,
    "created_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z",
    "updated_at": "2018-02-02T22:25:27.521Z"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10015",
      "title": "Bad Request",
      "detail": "The street address provided is invalid.",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/street_address"
      },
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10015"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-an-address-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response. `validate_address` on the returned record indicates whether it was validated for emergency use at creation: created with the default `true`, the record passed emergency validation; created with `false`, validation was skipped during this creation request, and the address may have been validated separately. This flag is not a current validity status; emergency use still requires a valid address.|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity. The request could not be processed: supplied parameters were invalid, the address failed validation for emergency use at creation (when `validate_address` is `true`, the default), or the address is in use by an active phone number order (delete). Check the `errors` array for details; when the validation service can suggest corrections for an invalid address, each offending field's error entry carries the suggested value.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<h3 id="creates-an-address-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|The address passed validation. The validation result is `valid`.|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Address validation failed. A completed validation with an invalid result returns `data.result: invalid`, with normalized or suggested address fields in `data.suggested` when available, and a top-level `errors` array. Other validation errors can return only `errors`, without `data`. Check `errors` before accessing the optional validation result.|Inline|

|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key.|[GatewayError](#schemagatewayerror)|
|404|Not Found|Session or artifact not found.|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Get artifact metadata

<a id="opIdGetBrowserArtifact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/browser_sessions/string/artifacts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /browser_sessions/{id}/artifacts/{artifactId}`

Returns artifact metadata and a signed download URL. The download URL requires Bearer auth.

<h3 id="get-artifact-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|artifactId|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "bart_75975c73-...",
    "session_id": "string",
    "action_id": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "content_type": "string",
    "size_bytes": 0,
    "checksum": "string",
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "download_url": "string",
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10009",
      "title": "Authentication failed",
      "detail": "Could not find any usable credentials in the request.",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/"
      },
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10009"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "message": "session not found",
    "retryable": false
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-artifact-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Artifact metadata|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key.|[GatewayError](#schemagatewayerror)|
|404|Not Found|Session or artifact not found.|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

<h3 id="get-artifact-metadata-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[Artifact](#schemaartifact)|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="create-an-assistant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional opaque, unquoted key for safely retrying the same logical request. Keys must contain 1 to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. Generate a unique UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request. Invalid headers—including duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong values—return 400 with error code 10015. A request already in progress with the same key returns 409; reusing the key with a different request returns 422. Only successful responses are replayed, for up to 24 hours. Do not include sensitive data in the key.|
|body|body|[CreateAssistantRequest](#schemacreateassistantrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» model|body|string|false|ID of the model to use when `external_llm` is not set. You can use the [Get models API](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/openai-chat/get-available-models-openai-compatible) to see available models. If `external_llm` is provided, the assistant uses `external_llm` instead of this field. If neither `model` nor `external_llm` is provided, Telnyx applies the default model.|
|» instructions|body|string|true|System instructions for the assistant. These may be templated with [dynamic variables](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables)|
|» tools|body|[AssistantTools](#schemaassistanttools)|false|Deprecated for new integrations. Inline tool definitions available to the assistant. Prefer `tool_ids` to attach shared tools created with the AI Tools endpoints.|
|» mcp_servers|body|[[AssistantMCPServer](#schemaassistantmcpserver)]|false|MCP servers attached to the assistant. Create MCP servers with `/ai/mcp_servers`, then reference them by `id` here.|
|» a2a_agents|body|[[AssistantA2AAgent](#schemaassistanta2aagent)]|false|A2A agents this assistant can delegate to. Tools are not stored here: at the start of every conversation each agent's card is fetched and one tool is derived per skill the card advertises, named `a2a_<name>_<skill_id>`. The following limits are not enforced when the assistant is saved, and anything past them is dropped when the conversation starts: 64 agents per assistant, 64 skills per card, 128 derived tools per assistant, and a 6 second budget for all card fetches combined. An agent whose card cannot be fetched costs the assistant that capability for the conversation; it does not fail the call.|
|» tool_ids|body|[string]|false|IDs of shared tools to attach to the assistant. New integrations should prefer `tool_ids` over inline `tools`.|
|» description|body|string|false|none|
|» greeting|body|string|false|Text that the assistant will use to start the conversation. This may be templated with [dynamic variables](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables). Use an empty string to have the assistant wait for the user to speak first. Use the special value `<assistant-speaks-first-with-model-generated-message>` to have the assistant generate the greeting based on the system instructions.|
|» llm_api_key_ref|body|string|false|This is only needed when using third-party inference providers selected by `model`. The `identifier` for an integration secret [/v2/integration_secrets](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/integration-secrets/create-a-secret) that refers to your LLM provider's API key. For bring-your-own endpoint authentication, use `external_llm.llm_api_key_ref` instead. Warning: Free plans are unlikely to work with this integration.|
|» external_llm|body|[ExternalLLMReq](#schemaexternalllmreq)|false|none|
|» fallback_config|body|[FallbackConfigReq](#schemafallbackconfigreq)|false|none|
|» voice_settings|body|[inference-embedding_VoiceSettings](#schemainference-embedding_voicesettings)|false|none|
|» avatar_settings|body|[AvatarSettingsRequest](#schemaavatarsettingsrequest) \| null|false|**Beta:** Optional avatar configuration for supported realtime browser conversations. Omit or set to `null` to create the assistant without an avatar.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[AvatarSettingsRequest](#schemaavatarsettingsrequest)|false|**Beta:** Telnyx avatar configuration accepted when creating or updating an assistant. Set `provider` to `telnyx`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» transcription|body|[TranscriptionSettings](#schematranscriptionsettings)|false|none|
|» telephony_settings|body|[TelephonySettings](#schematelephonysettings)|false|none|
|» messaging_settings|body|[MessagingSettings](#schemamessagingsettings)|false|none|
|» enabled_features|body|[[EnabledFeatures](#schemaenabledfeatures)]|false|none|
|» insight_settings|body|[InsightSettings](#schemainsightsettings)|false|none|
|» privacy_settings|body|[PrivacySettings](#schemaprivacysettings)|false|none|
|» dynamic_variables_webhook_url|body|string|false|If `dynamic_variables_webhook_url` is set, Telnyx sends a POST request to this URL at the start of the conversation to resolve dynamic variables. **Gotcha:** the webhook response must wrap variables under a top-level `dynamic_variables` object, e.g. `{"dynamic_variables": {"customer_name": "Jane"}}`. Returning a flat object will be ignored and variables will fall back to their defaults. See the [dynamic variables guide](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables) for the full request/response format and timeout behavior.|
|» dynamic_variables_webhook_timeout_ms|body|integer|false|Timeout in milliseconds for the dynamic variables webhook. Must be between 1 and 10000 ms. If the webhook does not respond within this timeout, the call proceeds with default values. See the [dynamic variables guide](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables).|
|» dynamic_variables|body|object|false|Map of dynamic variables and their default values|
|» widget_settings|body|[WidgetSettings](#schemawidgetsettings)|false|Configuration settings for the assistant's web widget.|
|» interruption_settings|body|[inference-embedding_InterruptionSettings](#schemainference-embedding_interruptionsettings)|false|Settings for interruptions and how the assistant decides the user has finished speaking. These timings are most relevant when using non turn-taking transcription models. For turn-taking models like `deepgram/flux`, end-of-turn behavior is controlled by the transcription end-of-turn settings under `transcription.settings` (`eot_threshold`, `eot_timeout_ms`, `eager_eot_threshold`).|
|» integrations|body|[[AssistantIntegration](#schemaassistantintegration)]|false|Connected integrations attached to the assistant. The catalog of available integrations is at `/ai/integrations`; the user's connected integrations are at `/ai/integrations/connections`. Each item references a catalog integration by `integration_id`.|
|» observability_settings|body|[ObservabilityReq](#schemaobservabilityreq)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the assistant. Tags can also be managed with the assistant tag endpoints.|
|» post_conversation_settings|body|[PostConversationSettingsReq](#schemapostconversationsettingsreq)|false|Configuration for post-conversation processing. When enabled, the assistant receives one additional LLM turn after the conversation ends, allowing it to execute final tool calls such as sending a summary or updating a record via webhook or function tools. Integration and MCP server tools are not available post-conversation; call-control tools (e.g. hangup, transfer) are also unavailable. Beta feature.|
|» delegation_settings|body|[DelegationSettings](#schemadelegationsettings)|false|Splits the conversation between a frontend model that talks to the caller and a backend model that does the work. On the GPT-Live route the frontend model cannot call tools at all — when it needs something done it raises a delegation and waits. On the chat completion route the frontend keeps a single `delegate` tool that returns immediately, so the conversation carries on while the backend works. Either way the backend's answer is spoken as commentary or kept as silent context, depending on `speak_results`. Beta feature.|
|» websocket_settings|body|[WebsocketSettings](#schemawebsocketsettings)|false|Streams conversation and telephony events to a WebSocket server you host, and accepts messages injected back into the conversation. Telnyx opens the connection as a client, once per conversation. Delivery is best effort throughout: while the connection is down events are dropped rather than queued, and no socket failure is ever allowed to affect the call. Beta feature.|
|» conversation_flow|body|[ConversationFlowReq](#schemaconversationflowreq)|false|Conversation flow as supplied by API clients (create / update).<br><br>A directed graph of `FlowNodeReq` connected by `FlowEdge`s. Validation<br>enforces unique node/edge IDs, that `start_node_id` references a real<br>node, and that every edge's endpoints reference real nodes.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|» enabled_features|messaging|

<h3 id="create-an-assistant-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[inference-embedding_Assistant](#schemainference-embedding_assistant)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request / Validation Failed (10015). Invalid, duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong Idempotency-Key headers are rejected by Edge with HTTP 400 and error code 10015. The assistant configuration is validated too: enabling `privacy_settings.in_transit_data_locality` is refused when the organization's data-locality region has no in-region inference, when any model the assistant could use — its `model`, its `fallback_config`, or a conversation-flow node override — is not Telnyx-hosted, or when its `insight_settings.model` is not available in that region.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|
|409|Conflict|A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed (10036). Retry later with the same key and request.|[email_ErrorResponse](#schemaemail_errorresponse)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Payload Too Large. A request sent with an Idempotency-Key whose body exceeds the endpoint's Edge replay-protection limit (256 KB) is rejected before it reaches the service. Requests sent without the header are not subject to this limit.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error. Reusing an Idempotency-Key with a different request body also returns 422 with error code 10027.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service unavailable (10016), including unavailable Edge idempotency protection for a keyed request.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|

<h3 id="create-an-assistant-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **422**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anyOf*|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Idempotent-Replayed|boolean||Present with value `true` when Edge replayed a stored successful response for the supplied Idempotency-Key. Omitted for first-time requests and error responses.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
