## Gather using audio

<a id="opIdGatherUsingAudio"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/gather_using_audio \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "audio_url": "http://example.com/message.wav",
    "invalid_audio_url": "http://example.com/message.wav",
    "minimum_digits": 1,
    "maximum_digits": 10,
    "timeout_millis": 10000,
    "terminating_digit": "#",
    "valid_digits": "123",
    "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 10000,
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/gather_using_audio`

Play an audio file on the call until the required DTMF signals are gathered to build interactive menus.

You can pass a list of valid digits along with an 'invalid_audio_url', which will be played back at the beginning of each prompt. Playback will be interrupted when a DTMF signal is received. The `Answer command must be issued before the `gather_using_audio` command.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.playback.started`
- `call.playback.ended`
- `call.dtmf.received` (you may receive many of these webhooks)
- `call.gather.ended`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "audio_url": "http://example.com/message.wav",
  "invalid_audio_url": "http://example.com/message.wav",
  "minimum_digits": 1,
  "maximum_digits": 10,
  "timeout_millis": 10000,
  "terminating_digit": "#",
  "valid_digits": "123",
  "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 10000,
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="gather-using-audio-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[GatherUsingAudioRequest](#schemagatherusingaudiorequest)|true|Gather using audio request|
|» audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played back at the beginning of each prompt. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|» media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played back at the beginning of each prompt. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|» invalid_audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to play when digits don't match the `valid_digits` parameter or the number of digits is not between `min` and `max`. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. invalid_media_name and invalid_audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|» invalid_media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played back when digits don't match the `valid_digits` parameter or the number of digits is not between `min` and `max`. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|» minimum_digits|body|integer(int32)|false|The minimum number of digits to fetch. This parameter has a minimum value of 1.|
|» maximum_digits|body|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of digits to fetch. This parameter has a maximum value of 128.|
|» maximum_tries|body|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of times the file should be played if there is no input from the user on the call.|
|» timeout_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of milliseconds to wait for a DTMF response after file playback ends before a replaying the sound file.|
|» terminating_digit|body|string|false|The digit used to terminate input if fewer than `maximum_digits` digits have been gathered. Set to an empty string to disable the terminating digit entirely, so that a digit such as `#` can be collected as input per `valid_digits`.|
|» valid_digits|body|string|false|A list of all digits accepted as valid.|
|» inter_digit_timeout_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of milliseconds to wait for input between digits.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "result": "ok"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10004",
      "title": "Missing required parameter",
      "detail": "The 'to' parameter is required and cannot be blank.",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/to"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Unexpected error",
      "detail": "An unexpected error occured."
    }
  ]
}
```

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response upon making a call control command.|Inline|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity. The request was well-formed but could not be processed due to semantic errors. This includes validation errors, invalid parameter values, call state errors, conference errors, queue errors, recording/transcription errors, and business logic violations.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

## Gather using speak

<a id="opIdGatherUsingSpeak"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/gather_using_speak \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "payload": "say this on call",
    "invalid_payload": "say this on call",
    "payload_type": "text",
    "service_level": "premium",
    "voice": "male",
    "language": "arb",
    "minimum_digits": 1,
    "maximum_digits": 10,
    "terminating_digit": "#",
    "valid_digits": "123",
    "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 10000,
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/gather_using_speak`

Convert text to speech and play it on the call until the required DTMF signals are gathered to build interactive menus.

You can pass a list of valid digits along with an 'invalid_payload', which will be played back at the beginning of each prompt. Speech will be interrupted when a DTMF signal is received. The `Answer` command must be issued before the `gather_using_speak` command.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.dtmf.received` (you may receive many of these webhooks)
- `call.gather.ended`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payload": "say this on call",
  "invalid_payload": "say this on call",
  "payload_type": "text",
  "service_level": "premium",
  "voice": "male",
  "language": "arb",
  "minimum_digits": 1,
  "maximum_digits": 10,
  "terminating_digit": "#",
  "valid_digits": "123",
  "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 10000,
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="gather-using-speak-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[GatherUsingSpeakRequest](#schemagatherusingspeakrequest)|true|Gather using speak request|
|» payload|body|string|true|The text or SSML to be converted into speech. There is a 3,000 character limit.|
|» invalid_payload|body|string|false|The text or SSML to be converted into speech when digits don't match the `valid_digits` parameter or the number of digits is not between `min` and `max`. There is a 3,000 character limit.|
|» payload_type|body|string|false|The type of the provided payload. The payload can either be plain text, or Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML).|
|» service_level|body|string|false|This parameter impacts speech quality, language options and payload types. When using `basic`, only the `en-US` language and payload type `text` are allowed.|
|» voice|body|string|true|Specifies the voice used in speech synthesis.<br><br>- Define voices using the format `<Provider>.<Model>.<VoiceId>`. Specifying only the provider will give default values for voice_id and model_id.<br><br> **Supported Providers:**<br>- **AWS:** Use `AWS.Polly.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna`). For neural voices, which provide more realistic, human-like speech, append `-Neural` to the `VoiceId` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural`). Check the [available voices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/available-voices.html) for compatibility.<br>- **Azure:** Use `Azure.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Azure.en-CA-ClaraNeural`, `Azure.en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural`, `Azure.en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural`). For a complete list of voices, go to [Azure Voice Gallery](https://speech.microsoft.com/portal/voicegallery). Use `voice_settings` to configure custom deployments, regions, or API keys.<br>- **ElevenLabs:** Use `ElevenLabs.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `ElevenLabs.eleven_multilingual_v2.21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM`). The `ModelId` part is optional. To use ElevenLabs, you must provide your ElevenLabs API key as an integration identifier secret in `"voice_settings": {"api_key_ref": "<secret_identifier>"}`. See [integration secrets documentation](https://developers.telnyx.com/api/secrets-manager/integration-secrets/create-integration-secret) for details. Check [available voices](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/get-voices).<br>- **Telnyx:** Use `Telnyx.<model_id>.<voice_id>` (e.g., `Telnyx.KokoroTTS.af`). Use `voice_settings` to configure voice_speed and other synthesis parameters. `Bayan` provides Arabic (multiple dialects) and English voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Bayan.Ahmed`, `Telnyx.Bayan.Amanda`). `Sukhan` provides Urdu voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Sukhan.urdu-professor`); `voice_speed` is not supported.<br>- **Minimax:** Use `Minimax.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Minimax.speech-02-hd.Wise_Woman`). Supported models: `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-2.8-turbo`. Use `voice_settings` to configure speed, volume, pitch, and language_boost.<br>- **Resemble:** Use `Resemble.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Resemble.Turbo.Aaron_en-US`). Supported models: `Pro`, `Turbo`, `Urdu`. `<VoiceId>` is a stock voice name or the ID of a Resemble voice clone. Use `voice_settings` to configure precision, sample_rate, and format.<br>- **Inworld:** Use `Inworld.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Inworld.Mini.Loretta`, `Inworld.Max.Oliver`, `Inworld.TTS2.Loretta`). Supported models: `Mini`, `Max`, `TTS2`. Use `voice_settings` to configure `delivery_mode` (`STABLE`, `BALANCED`, `CREATIVE`), supported by `TTS2` only.<br>- **Fish Audio:** Use `FishAudio.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `FishAudio.s2.1-pro.<reference_id>`). Supported models: `s2.1-pro`, `s2-pro`, `s1`. `VoiceId` is a Fish Voice-Library reference ID.<br>- **Soniox:** Use `Soniox.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Soniox.tts-rt-v2.Emma`). Supported model: `tts-rt-v2`. Browse the catalog via the [Voices API](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/text-to-speech-commands/list-available-voices). Every voice speaks all supported languages; set `language` to the two-letter ISO 639-1 code of the text, for example `it`. SSML is not supported. Use `voice_settings` to configure `speed` (0.7 to 1.3) and `reduce_silence`.<br>- **xAI:** Use `xAI.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `xAI.eve`). Available voices: `eve`, `ara`, `rex`, `sal`, `leo`.<br>- **Humain:** Use `Humain.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Humain.sara-ar`). Available voices: `sara-en`, `abdulaziz-en`, `sara-ar`, `abdulaziz-ar`, `nourah-ar`, `abdullah-ar`. Native Arabic (Saudi dialect) and English voices only — no `ModelId` segment.<br><br>For service_level basic, you may define the gender of the speaker (male or female).|

## Hangup call

<a id="opIdHangupCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/hangup \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/hangup`

Hang up the call.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.hangup`
- `call.recording.saved`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="hangup-call-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[HangupRequest](#schemahanguprequest)|true|Hangup request|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|
|» custom_headers|body|[[CustomSipHeader](#schemacustomsipheader)]|false|Custom headers to be added to the SIP BYE message.|
|» reason|body|string|false|Text for the SIP `Reason` header (RFC 3326) sent when cancelling an unanswered outbound leg. The SIP CANCEL carries `Reason: SIP;cause=200;text="<reason>"`; phones such as Poly and Yealink use it to suppress the missed-call entry for a call answered elsewhere. Has no effect on an answered leg or an inbound leg. A hangup sent before the leg's `call.initiated` webhook still hangs up the leg, but without the `Reason` header. Must not contain `"`, `\`, control characters, or characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (such as emoji); invalid values are rejected with a 422.|

```json
      }
    }
```

```json
}
```

## Process a payment

<a id="opIdPayCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/pay \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "connector_name": "Default",
    "amount": 10.5,
    "currency": "USD",
    "payment_method": "credit-card",
    "transaction_type": "charge",
    "max_attempts": 3,
    "timeout_millis": 5000,
    "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 5000,
    "voice": "female",
    "language": "en-US",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/pay`

Collect payment details from the caller using DTMF and either charge or tokenize the payment method through a configured Pay connector. Pay pauses active call recordings while sensitive payment details are collected.

When `payment_token` is supplied, the DTMF collection steps are skipped and the existing token is sent to the connector.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.payment.progress`
- `call.payment.completed`

**Test mode card numbers:** `4111111111111111` (Visa), `5555555555554444` (Mastercard), `378282246310005` (American Express), `6011111111111117` (Discover), `3065930009020004` (Diners Club), `3566002020360505` (JCB), `6200000000000005` (UnionPay), and `6771798021000008` (Maestro). Test-mode connectors reject other card numbers before contacting the configured processor. The UnionPay and Maestro numbers are accepted for processor testing, but Pay currently does not emit a card type for them.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connector_name": "Default",
  "amount": 10.5,
  "currency": "USD",
  "payment_method": "credit-card",
  "transaction_type": "charge",
  "max_attempts": 3,
  "timeout_millis": 5000,
  "inter_digit_timeout_millis": 5000,
  "voice": "female",
  "language": "en-US",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="process-a-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[PayRequest](#schemapayrequest)|true|Pay request|
|» connector_name|body|string|false|Name of the Pay connector used to process the transaction.|
|» amount|body|number|false|Amount to charge. Required when `transaction_type` is `charge`.|
|» currency|body|string|false|Currency used for the transaction. Pay currently supports USD only.|
|» payment_token|body|string|false|Existing payment token. When supplied, payment-detail collection is skipped.|
|» payment_method|body|string|false|Payment method to collect.|
|» valid_card_types|body|[string]|false|Restricts accepted card numbers to the listed card types. When the caller enters a card number that does not match one of the listed types, Pay treats the input as invalid and re-prompts for the card number. Cannot be used together with `payment_token`.|
|» postal_code|body|string \| boolean|false|Controls billing postal code collection for credit-card payments when no `payment_token` is supplied. Set to `true` or the string `"true"` (the default) to prompt the caller for a postal code. Set to `false` or the string `"false"` to skip the postal code prompt without supplying a postal code to the payment connector. Supply any other non-empty string, such as `"90210"`, to use that postal code without prompting. Empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected. This option does not affect ACH debit payments or payments using an existing token.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|boolean|false|none|
|» min_postal_code_length|body|integer|false|Minimum number of digits the caller must enter when collecting a credit-card billing postal code. Applies only when `postal_code` is `true` or `"true"` and no `payment_token` is supplied. The default is 1. The maximum number of digits collected is the greater of 10 and this value. This does not validate the length of a postal code supplied directly in `postal_code`.|
|» transaction_type|body|string|false|Transaction to perform. If omitted, Pay infers `tokenize` when `amount` is absent or zero and `charge` when `amount` is positive.|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional description forwarded with the payment transaction.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Base64-encoded state included in subsequent webhooks.|
|» metadata|body|object|false|Metadata forwarded to the Pay connector.|
|» parameters|body|object|false|Additional parameters forwarded to the Pay connector.|
|» prompts|body|[PayPrompts](#schemapayprompts)|false|Custom text-to-speech prompts keyed by payment collection step.|
|» max_attempts|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum number of attempts for each payment collection step.|
|» timeout_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Time in milliseconds to wait for DTMF input for each collection step.|
|» inter_digit_timeout_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Time in milliseconds to wait between consecutive DTMF digits.|
|» voice|body|string|false|Voice used for payment prompts. Accepts `male`, `female`, or a provider voice in `<Provider>.<Model>.<VoiceId>` format, for example `AWS.Polly.Joanna` or `Telnyx.KokoroTTS.af`.|
|» language|body|string|false|Language used for payment prompts.|
|» service_level|body|string|false|Speech synthesis service level used for payment prompts. Pay defaults to `premium`.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Idempotency key for the command. Telnyx ignores a duplicate command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» currency|USD|
|» currency|usd|
|» payment_method|credit-card|
|» payment_method|ach-debit|
|» valid_card_types|visa|
|» valid_card_types|mastercard|
|» valid_card_types|amex|
|» valid_card_types|maestro|
|» valid_card_types|discover|
|» valid_card_types|optima|
|» valid_card_types|jcb|
|» valid_card_types|diners-club|
|» valid_card_types|enroute|
|» transaction_type|charge|
|» transaction_type|tokenize|

```json
  "data": {
    "result": "ok"
  }
}
```

```json
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10004",
      "title": "Missing required parameter",
      "detail": "The 'to' parameter is required and cannot be blank.",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/to"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Unexpected error",
      "detail": "An unexpected error occured."
    }
  ]
}
```

|200|OK|Successful response upon making a call control command.|Inline|

This includes validation errors, invalid parameter values, call state errors, conference errors, queue errors, recording/transcription errors, and business logic violations.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

## Play audio URL

<a id="opIdStartCallPlayback"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/playback_start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav",
    "loop": "infinity",
    "overlay": true,
    "stop": "current",
    "target_legs": "self",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/playback_start`

Play an audio file on the call. If multiple play audio commands are issued consecutively,
the audio files will be placed in a queue awaiting playback.

*Notes:*

- When `overlay` is enabled, `target_legs` is limited to `self`.
- A customer cannot Play Audio with `overlay=true` unless there is a Play Audio with `overlay=false` actively playing.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.playback.started`
- `call.playback.ended`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav",
  "loop": "infinity",
  "overlay": true,
  "stop": "current",
  "target_legs": "self",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="play-audio-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[PlayAudioUrlRequest](#schemaplayaudiourlrequest)|true|Play audio URL request|
|» audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played back on the call. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|» media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played back on the call. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|» loop|body|[Loopcount](#schemaloopcount)|false|The number of times the audio file should be played. If supplied, the value must be an integer between 1 and 100, or the special string `infinity` for an endless loop.|
|» overlay|body|boolean|false|When enabled, audio will be mixed on top of any other audio that is actively being played back. Note that `overlay: true` will only work if there is another audio file already being played on the call.|
|» stop|body|string|false|When specified, it stops the current audio being played. Specify `current` to stop the current audio being played, and to play the next file in the queue. Specify `all` to stop the current audio file being played and to also clear all audio files from the queue.|
|» target_legs|body|string|false|Specifies the leg or legs on which audio will be played. If supplied, the value must be either `self`, `opposite` or `both`.|
|» cache_audio|body|boolean|false|Caches the audio file. Useful when playing the same audio file multiple times during the call.|
|» audio_type|body|string|false|Specifies the type of audio provided in `audio_url` or `playback_content`.|
|» playback_content|body|string|false|Allows a user to provide base64 encoded mp3 or wav. Note: when using this parameter, `media_url` and `media_name` in the `playback_started` and `playback_ended` webhooks will be empty|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» audio_type|mp3|
|» audio_type|wav|

```json
    "result": "ok"
  }
}
```

```json
      }

}

    }
```

## Recording start

<a id="opIdStartCallRecord"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/record_start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "format": "wav",
    "channels": "single",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "play_beep": true,
    "max_length": 0,
    "timeout_secs": 0,
    "transcription": true,
    "transcription_engine": "B",
    "transcription_language": "en"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/record_start`

Start recording the call. Recording will stop on call hang-up, or can be initiated via the Stop Recording command.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.recording.saved`
- `call.recording.transcription.saved`
- `call.recording.error`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "format": "wav",
  "channels": "single",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "play_beep": true,
  "max_length": 0,
  "timeout_secs": 0,
  "transcription": true,
  "transcription_engine": "B",
  "transcription_language": "en"
}
```

<h3 id="recording-start-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[StartRecordingRequest](#schemastartrecordingrequest)|true|Start recording audio request|
|» format|body|string|true|The audio file format used when storing the call recording. Can be either `mp3` or `wav`.|
|» channels|body|string|true|When `dual`, final audio file will be stereo recorded with the first leg on channel A, and the rest on channel B.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|
|» play_beep|body|boolean|false|If enabled, a beep sound will be played at the start of a recording.|
|» max_length|body|integer(int32)|false|Defines the maximum length for the recording in seconds. The minimum value is 0. The maximum value is 14400. The default value is 0 (infinite)|
|» timeout_secs|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of seconds that Telnyx will wait for the recording to be stopped if silence is detected. The timer only starts when the speech is detected. Please note that call transcription is used to detect silence and the related charge will be applied. The minimum value is 0. The default value is 0 (infinite)|
|» recording_track|body|string|false|The audio track to be recorded. Can be either `both`, `inbound` or `outbound`. If only single track is specified (`inbound`, `outbound`), `channels` configuration is ignored and it will be recorded as mono (single channel).|
|» trim|body|string|false|When set to `trim-silence`, silence will be removed from the beginning and end of the recording.|
|» custom_file_name|body|string|false|The custom recording file name to be used instead of the default `call_leg_id`. Telnyx will still add a Unix timestamp suffix.|
|» transcription|body|boolean|false|Enable post recording transcription. The default value is false.|
|» transcription_engine|body|string|false|Engine to use for speech recognition. `A` - `Google`, `B` - `Telnyx`, `deepgram/nova-3` - `Deepgram Nova-3`. Note: `deepgram/nova-3` supports only `en` and `en-{Region}` languages.|
|» transcription_language|body|[TranscriptionLanguage](#schematranscriptionlanguage)|false|Language code for transcription. Note: Not all languages are supported by all transcription engines (google, telnyx, deepgram). See engine-specific documentation for supported values.|
|» transcription_profanity_filter|body|boolean|false|Enables profanity_filter. Applies to `google` engine only.|
|» transcription_speaker_diarization|body|boolean|false|Enables speaker diarization. Applies to `google` engine only.|
|» transcription_min_speaker_count|body|integer(int32)|false|Defines minimum number of speakers in the conversation. Applies to `google` engine only.|
|» transcription_max_speaker_count|body|integer(int32)|false|Defines maximum number of speakers in the conversation. Applies to `google` engine only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» format|wav|
|» format|mp3|
|» channels|single|
|» channels|dual|
|» recording_track|both|
|» recording_track|inbound|
|» recording_track|outbound|
|» trim|trim-silence|
|» transcription_engine|A|
|» transcription_engine|B|
|» transcription_engine|deepgram/nova-3|

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/refer`

Initiate a SIP Refer on a Call Control call. You can initiate a SIP Refer at any point in the duration of a call.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.refer.started`
- `call.refer.completed`
- `call.refer.failed`

```json
}
```

|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[ReferRequest](#schemareferrequest)|true|Refer request|
|» sip_address|body|string|true|The SIP URI to which the call will be referred to.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» custom_headers|body|[[CustomSipHeader](#schemacustomsipheader)]|false|Custom headers to be added to the SIP INVITE.|
|» sip_auth_username|body|string|false|SIP Authentication username used for SIP challenges.|
|» sip_auth_password|body|string|false|SIP Authentication password used for SIP challenges.|
|» sip_headers|body|[[SipHeader](#schemasipheader)]|false|SIP headers to be added to the request. Currently only User-to-User header is supported.|

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/siprec_start`

Start siprec session to configured in SIPREC connector SRS. 

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `siprec.started`

|» session_timeout_secs|body|integer|false|Sets `Session-Expires` header to the INVITE. A reinvite is sent every half the value set. Usefull for session keep alive. Minimum value is 90, set to 0 to disable.|

## Speak text

<a id="opIdSpeakCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/speak \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "payload": "Say this on the call",
    "payload_type": "text",
    "service_level": "basic",
    "stop": "current",
    "voice": "female",
    "language": "arb",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/speak`

Convert text to speech and play it back on the call. If multiple speak text commands are issued consecutively, the audio files will be placed in a queue awaiting playback.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.speak.started`
- `call.speak.ended`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payload": "Say this on the call",
  "payload_type": "text",
  "service_level": "basic",
  "stop": "current",
  "voice": "female",
  "language": "arb",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901"
}
```

<h3 id="speak-text-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[SpeakRequest](#schemaspeakrequest)|true|Speak request|
|» payload|body|string|true|The text or SSML to be converted into speech. There is a 3,000 character limit.|
|» payload_type|body|string|false|The type of the provided payload. The payload can either be plain text, or Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML).|
|» service_level|body|string|false|This parameter impacts speech quality, language options and payload types. When using `basic`, only the `en-US` language and payload type `text` are allowed.|
|» stop|body|string|false|When specified, it stops the current audio being played. Specify `current` to stop the current audio being played, and to play the next file in the queue. Specify `all` to stop the current audio file being played and to also clear all audio files from the queue.|
|» voice|body|string|true|Specifies the voice used in speech synthesis.<br><br>- Define voices using the format `<Provider>.<Model>.<VoiceId>`. Specifying only the provider will give default values for voice_id and model_id.<br><br> **Supported Providers:**<br>- **AWS:** Use `AWS.Polly.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna`). For neural voices, which provide more realistic, human-like speech, append `-Neural` to the `VoiceId` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural`). Check the [available voices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/available-voices.html) for compatibility.<br>- **Azure:** Use `Azure.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Azure.en-CA-ClaraNeural`, `Azure.en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural`, `Azure.en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural`). For a complete list of voices, go to [Azure Voice Gallery](https://speech.microsoft.com/portal/voicegallery). Use `voice_settings` to configure custom deployments, regions, or API keys.<br>- **ElevenLabs:** Use `ElevenLabs.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `ElevenLabs.eleven_multilingual_v2.21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM`). The `ModelId` part is optional. To use ElevenLabs, you must provide your ElevenLabs API key as an integration identifier secret in `"voice_settings": {"api_key_ref": "<secret_identifier>"}`. See [integration secrets documentation](https://developers.telnyx.com/api/secrets-manager/integration-secrets/create-integration-secret) for details. Check [available voices](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/get-voices).<br>- **Telnyx:** Use `Telnyx.<model_id>.<voice_id>` (e.g., `Telnyx.KokoroTTS.af`). Use `voice_settings` to configure voice_speed and other synthesis parameters. `Bayan` provides Arabic (multiple dialects) and English voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Bayan.Ahmed`, `Telnyx.Bayan.Amanda`). `Sukhan` provides Urdu voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Sukhan.urdu-professor`); `voice_speed` is not supported.<br>- **Minimax:** Use `Minimax.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Minimax.speech-02-hd.Wise_Woman`). Supported models: `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-2.8-turbo`. Use `voice_settings` to configure speed, volume, pitch, and language_boost.<br>- **Resemble:** Use `Resemble.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Resemble.Turbo.Aaron_en-US`). Supported models: `Pro`, `Turbo`, `Urdu`. `<VoiceId>` is a stock voice name or the ID of a Resemble voice clone. Use `voice_settings` to configure precision, sample_rate, and format.<br>- **Inworld:** Use `Inworld.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Inworld.Mini.Loretta`, `Inworld.Max.Oliver`, `Inworld.TTS2.Loretta`). Supported models: `Mini`, `Max`, `TTS2`. Use `voice_settings` to configure `delivery_mode` (`STABLE`, `BALANCED`, `CREATIVE`), supported by `TTS2` only.<br>- **Fish Audio:** Use `FishAudio.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `FishAudio.s2.1-pro.<reference_id>`). Supported models: `s2.1-pro`, `s2-pro`, `s1`. `VoiceId` is a Fish Voice-Library reference ID.<br>- **Soniox:** Use `Soniox.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Soniox.tts-rt-v2.Emma`). Supported model: `tts-rt-v2`. Browse the catalog via the [Voices API](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/text-to-speech-commands/list-available-voices). Every voice speaks all supported languages; set `language` to the two-letter ISO 639-1 code of the text, for example `it`. SSML is not supported. Use `voice_settings` to configure `speed` (0.7 to 1.3) and `reduce_silence`.<br>- **xAI:** Use `xAI.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `xAI.eve`). Available voices: `eve`, `ara`, `rex`, `sal`, `leo`.<br>- **Humain:** Use `Humain.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Humain.sara-ar`). Available voices: `sara-en`, `abdulaziz-en`, `sara-ar`, `abdulaziz-ar`, `nourah-ar`, `abdullah-ar`. Native Arabic (Saudi dialect) and English voices only — no `ModelId` segment.<br><br>For service_level basic, you may define the gender of the speaker (male or female).|

|» » *oneOf*|body|[ElevenLabsVoiceSettings](#schemaelevenlabsvoicesettings)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TelnyxVoiceSettings](#schematelnyxvoicesettings)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AWSVoiceSettings](#schemaawsvoicesettings)|false|none|

|» » *oneOf*|body|[AssemblyAIVoiceSettings](#schemaassemblyaivoicesettings)|false|none|
|» language|body|string|false|The language you want spoken. This parameter is ignored when a `Polly.*` voice is specified.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|
|» loop|body|[Loopcount](#schemaloopcount)|false|The number of times to play the audio file. Use `infinity` to loop indefinitely. Defaults to 1.|

## Streaming start

<a id="opIdStartCallStreaming"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/streaming_start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "stream_url": "wss://www.example.com/websocket",
    "stream_track": "both_tracks",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "enable_dialogflow": false,
    "dialogflow_config": {
      "analyze_sentiment": false,
      "partial_automated_agent_reply": false
    }
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/streaming_start`

Start streaming the media from a call to a specific WebSocket address or Dialogflow connection in near-realtime. Audio will be delivered as base64-encoded RTP payload (raw audio), wrapped in JSON payloads.

Please find more details about media streaming messages specification under the [link](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/voice/programmable-voice/media-streaming).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "stream_url": "wss://www.example.com/websocket",
  "stream_track": "both_tracks",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "enable_dialogflow": false,
  "dialogflow_config": {
    "analyze_sentiment": false,
    "partial_automated_agent_reply": false
  }
}
```

<h3 id="streaming-start-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[StartStreamingRequest](#schemastartstreamingrequest)|true|Start streaming media request|
|» stream_url|body|string|false|The destination WebSocket address where the stream is going to be delivered.|
|» stream_track|body|string|false|Specifies which track should be streamed.|
|» stream_codec|body|[StreamCodec](#schemastreamcodec)|false|Specifies the codec to be used for the streamed audio. When set to 'default' or when transcoding is not possible, the codec from the call will be used.|
|» stream_bidirectional_mode|body|[StreamBidirectionalMode](#schemastreambidirectionalmode)|false|Configures method of bidirectional streaming (mp3, rtp).|
|» stream_bidirectional_codec|body|[StreamBidirectionalCodec](#schemastreambidirectionalcodec)|false|Indicates codec for bidirectional streaming RTP payloads. Used only with stream_bidirectional_mode=rtp. Case sensitive.|
|» stream_bidirectional_target_legs|body|[StreamBidirectionalTargetLegs](#schemastreambidirectionaltargetlegs)|false|Specifies which call legs should receive the bidirectional stream audio.|
|» stream_bidirectional_sampling_rate|body|[StreamBidirectionalSamplingRate](#schemastreambidirectionalsamplingrate)|false|Audio sampling rate.|
|» enable_dialogflow|body|boolean|false|Enables Dialogflow for the current call. The default value is false.|
|» dialogflow_config|body|[DialogflowConfig](#schemadialogflowconfig)|false|none|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|
|» custom_parameters|body|[object]|false|Custom parameters to be sent as part of the WebSocket connection.|
|» » name|body|string|false|The name of the custom parameter.|
|» » value|body|string|false|The value of the custom parameter.|
|» stream_auth_token|body|string|false|An authentication token to be sent as part of the WebSocket connection. Maximum length is 4000 characters.|

## Transfer call

<a id="opIdTransferCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/calls/string/actions/transfer \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "to": "+18005550100 or sip:username@sip.telnyx.com;secure=srtp",
    "from": "+18005550101",
    "from_display_name": "Company Name",
    "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav",
    "send_digits_on_answer": "wwww200",
    "timeout_secs": 60,
    "time_limit_secs": 60,
    "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
    "webhook_url_method": "POST",
    "answering_machine_detection": "detect",
    "answering_machine_detection_config": {
      "total_analysis_time_millis": 5000,
      "after_greeting_silence_millis": 1000,
      "between_words_silence_millis": 1000,
      "greeting_duration_millis": 1000,
      "initial_silence_millis": 1000,
      "maximum_number_of_words": 1000,
      "maximum_word_length_millis": 2000,
      "silence_threshold": 512,
      "greeting_total_analysis_time_millis": 50000,
      "greeting_silence_duration_millis": 2000
    },
    "custom_headers": [
      {
        "name": "head_1",
        "value": "val_1"
      },
      {
        "name": "head_2",
        "value": "val_2"
      }
    ],
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "early_media": true,
    "media_encryption": "SRTP",
    "sip_auth_username": "username",
    "sip_auth_password": "password",
    "sip_headers": [
      {
        "name": "User-to-User",
        "value": "value"
      }
    ],
    "sip_transport_protocol": "TLS"
  }'
```

`POST /calls/{call_control_id}/actions/transfer`

Transfer a call to a new destination. If the transfer is unsuccessful, a `call.hangup` webhook for the other call (Leg B) will be sent indicating that the transfer could not be completed. The original call will remain active and may be issued additional commands, potentially transfering the call to an alternate destination.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `call.initiated`
- `call.bridged` to Leg B
- `call.answered` or `call.hangup`
- `call.machine.detection.ended` if `answering_machine_detection` was requested
- `call.machine.greeting.ended` if `answering_machine_detection` was requested to detect the end of machine greeting
- `call.machine.premium.detection.ended` if `answering_machine_detection=premium` was requested
- `call.machine.premium.greeting.ended` if `answering_machine_detection=premium` was requested and a beep was detected
- `call.machine.premium.call_screening.detected` if `answering_machine_detection=premium_ios_call_screening_detection` was requested and an Apple Call Screening tone was detected


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "to": "+18005550100 or sip:username@sip.telnyx.com;secure=srtp",
  "from": "+18005550101",
  "from_display_name": "Company Name",
  "audio_url": "http://www.example.com/sounds/greeting.wav",
  "send_digits_on_answer": "wwww200",
  "timeout_secs": 60,
  "time_limit_secs": 60,
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
  "webhook_url_method": "POST",
  "answering_machine_detection": "detect",
  "answering_machine_detection_config": {
    "total_analysis_time_millis": 5000,
    "after_greeting_silence_millis": 1000,
    "between_words_silence_millis": 1000,
    "greeting_duration_millis": 1000,
    "initial_silence_millis": 1000,
    "maximum_number_of_words": 1000,
    "maximum_word_length_millis": 2000,
    "silence_threshold": 512,
    "greeting_total_analysis_time_millis": 50000,
    "greeting_silence_duration_millis": 2000
  },
  "custom_headers": [
    {
      "name": "head_1",
      "value": "val_1"
    },
    {
      "name": "head_2",
      "value": "val_2"
    }
  ],
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "early_media": true,
  "media_encryption": "SRTP",
  "sip_auth_username": "username",
  "sip_auth_password": "password",
  "sip_headers": [
    {
      "name": "User-to-User",
      "value": "value"
    }
  ],
  "sip_transport_protocol": "TLS"
}
```

<h3 id="transfer-call-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[TransferCallRequest](#schematransfercallrequest)|true|Transfer call request|
|» to|body|string|true|The DID or SIP URI to dial out to. For SIP URI destinations, append `;secure=true` or `;secure=srtp` to enable SRTP media encryption for that endpoint, or `;secure=dtls` to enable DTLS media encryption for that endpoint. If `media_encryption` is set to `SRTP` or `DTLS`, it takes precedence over any per-endpoint `secure` URI parameter. You may also append a comma followed by DTMF digits (e.g. `+18004247767,200`) to play those digits as DTMF once the transfer destination answers — equivalent to setting `send_digits_on_answer` separately. If both are present, the explicit `send_digits_on_answer` parameter takes precedence.|
|» from|body|string|false|The `from` number to be used as the caller id presented to the destination (`to` number). The number should be in +E164 format. This attribute will default to the `to` number of the original call if omitted.|
|» diversion|body|string|false|The `to` number of an active inbound call, in +E164 format. Telnyx checks whether there is currently an active inbound call where `to` matches this `diversion` value and `from` matches the `from` number supplied for this request. If such a call exists, the `from` number is treated as verified (since it is already on an active inbound call to you) and can be used as the caller id for this outbound call.|
|» from_display_name|body|string|false|The `from_display_name` string to be used as the caller id name (SIP From Display Name) presented to the destination (`to` number). The string should have a maximum of 128 characters, containing only letters, numbers, spaces, and -_~!.+ special characters. If ommited, the display name will be the same as the number in the `from` field.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|Indicates the privacy level to be used for the call. When set to `id`, caller ID information (name and number) will be hidden from the called party. When set to `none` or omitted, caller ID will be shown normally.|
|» audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played back when the transfer destination answers before bridging the call. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. media_name and audio_url cannot be used together in one request.|
|» send_digits_on_answer|body|string|false|DTMF digits to send automatically after the transfer destination answers. Useful for reaching an extension behind an IVR (e.g. `"200"` to dial extension 200 once the called party picks up). Allowed characters: `0-9`, `A-D`, `w` (0.5s pause), `W` (1s pause), `*`, `#`. Maximum 64 characters. When omitted, no automatic DTMF is sent. May also be supplied inline by appending `,<digits>` to `to` (e.g. `to=+18004247767,200`); if both forms are present, this explicit field takes precedence.|
|» early_media|body|boolean|false|If set to false, early media will not be passed to the originating leg.|
|» media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played back when the transfer destination answers before bridging the call. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file.|
|» timeout_secs|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of seconds that Telnyx will wait for the call to be answered by the destination to which it is being transferred. If the timeout is reached before an answer is received, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `timeout` will be sent. Minimum value is 5 seconds. Maximum value is 600 seconds.|
|» time_limit_secs|body|integer(int32)|false|Sets the maximum duration of a Call Control Leg in seconds. If the time limit is reached, the call will hangup and a `call.hangup` webhook with a `hangup_cause` of `time_limit` will be sent. For example, by setting a time limit of 120 seconds, a Call Leg will be automatically terminated two minutes after being answered. The default time limit is 14400 seconds or 4 hours and this is also the maximum allowed call length.|
|» park_after_unbridge|body|string|false|Specifies behavior after the bridge ends (i.e. the opposite leg either hangs up or is transferred). If supplied with the value `self`, the current leg will be parked after unbridge. If not set, the default behavior is to hang up the leg.|
|» answering_machine_detection|body|string|false|Enables Answering Machine Detection. When a call is answered, Telnyx runs real-time detection to determine if it was picked up by a human or a machine and sends an `call.machine.detection.ended` webhook with the analysis result. If 'greeting_end' or 'detect_words' is used and a 'machine' is detected, you will receive another 'call.machine.greeting.ended' webhook when the answering machine greeting ends with a beep or silence. If `detect_beep` is used, you will only receive 'call.machine.greeting.ended' if a beep is detected. If `answering_machine_detection` is set to `premium_ios_call_screening_detection`, Premium AMD runs with iOS Call Screening support: after an initial `machine` result, Telnyx listens for the iOS call-screening prompt to end or for an Apple Call Screening tone, sends `call.machine.premium.greeting.ended` with `result=prompt_ended` or `call.machine.premium.call_screening.detected` with `result=screening` respectively. When the Apple Call Screening tone is detected, Premium AMD is restarted on the screened call and a `call.machine.premium.detection.ended` webhook with the post-screening classification follows.|
|» answering_machine_detection_config|body|object|false|Optional configuration parameters to modify 'answering_machine_detection' performance. Only `total_analysis_time_millis` and `greeting_duration_millis` parameters are applicable when `premium` is selected as answering_machine_detection. `prompt_end_timeout_millis` is additionally applicable when `premium_ios_call_screening_detection` is selected.|
|» » total_analysis_time_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum timeout threshold for overall detection.|
|» » beep_detection_profile|body|string|false|Selects which detectors must validate a beep. `both` requires the amplitude and frequency detectors to agree. `freq_only` uses the frequency detector alone, for beeps whose volume is too unsteady for the default profile.|
|» » beep_min_frequency_hz|body|integer(int32)|false|Lowest frequency, in Hz, that a tone must reach to be treated as a beep. Raising it above 480 excludes North American ringback (440 + 480 Hz), which can otherwise be reported as a beep when the `freq_only` profile is in use. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_max_frequency_hz|body|integer(int32)|false|Highest frequency, in Hz, that a tone can reach and still be treated as a beep. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_min_tone_duration_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Shortest tone, in milliseconds, that can be treated as a beep. Raising it rejects brief tones such as call-progress blips. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_spectral_confirmation|body|boolean|false|When enabled, a candidate beep must pass an additional spectral check before it is reported. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_spectral_window_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Length of the spectral confirmation window, in milliseconds. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_spectral_min_purity|body|number|false|Minimum spectral purity, from 0 to 1, for a tone to be treated as a beep. Raising it rejects mixed tones such as ringback, which combines two frequencies. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » beep_spectral_reject_fax_cng|body|boolean|false|When enabled, the fax CNG tone is rejected rather than reported as a beep. Only used when beep detection is active.|
|» » after_greeting_silence_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Silence duration threshold after a greeting message or voice for it be considered human.|
|» » between_words_silence_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum threshold for silence between words.|
|» » greeting_duration_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum threshold of a human greeting. If greeting longer than this value, considered machine.|
|» » initial_silence_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|If initial silence duration is greater than this value, consider it a machine.|
|» » maximum_number_of_words|body|integer(int32)|false|If number of detected words is greater than this value, consder it a machine.|
|» » maximum_word_length_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|If a single word lasts longer than this threshold, consider it a machine.|
|» » silence_threshold|body|integer(int32)|false|Minimum noise threshold for any analysis.|
|» » greeting_total_analysis_time_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|If machine already detected, maximum timeout threshold to determine the end of the machine greeting.|
|» » greeting_silence_duration_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|If machine already detected, maximum threshold for silence between words. If exceeded, the greeting is considered ended.|
|» » prompt_end_timeout_millis|body|integer(int32)|false|Maximum time Telnyx waits, in milliseconds, for the iOS call-screening prompt to end after Premium AMD initially detects a `machine`. Used when `answering_machine_detection` is `premium_ios_call_screening_detection`. Defaults to 5000 milliseconds.|
|» custom_headers|body|[[CustomSipHeader](#schemacustomsipheader)]|false|Custom headers to be added to the SIP INVITE.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» target_leg_client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook for the new leg. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `call_control_id`.|
|» media_encryption|body|string|false|Defines whether media should be encrypted on the new call leg. For SIP URI destinations, media encryption can also be requested per endpoint with the `secure` URI parameter: `;secure=true` or `;secure=srtp` enables SRTP, and `;secure=dtls` enables DTLS. This parameter, when set to `SRTP` or `DTLS`, takes precedence over the per-endpoint `secure` value.|
|» sip_auth_username|body|string|false|SIP Authentication username used for SIP challenges.|
|» sip_auth_password|body|string|false|SIP Authentication password used for SIP challenges.|
|» sip_headers|body|[[SipHeader](#schemasipheader)]|false|SIP headers to be added to the SIP INVITE. Currently only User-to-User header is supported.|
|» sip_transport_protocol|body|string|false|Defines SIP transport protocol to be used on the call.|
|» sound_modifications|body|[SoundModifications](#schemasoundmodifications)|false|Use this field to modify sound effects, for example adjust the pitch.|
|» webhook_url|body|string|false|Use this field to override the URL for which Telnyx will send subsequent webhooks to for this call.|
|» webhook_url_method|body|string|false|HTTP request type used for `webhook_url`.|
|» mute_dtmf|body|string|false|When enabled, DTMF tones are not passed to the call participant. The webhooks containing the DTMF information will be sent.|
|» record|body|string|false|Start recording automatically after an event. Disabled by default.|
|» record_channels|body|string|false|Defines which channel should be recorded ('single' or 'dual') when `record` is specified.|
|» record_format|body|string|false|Defines the format of the recording ('wav' or 'mp3') when `record` is specified.|
|» record_max_length|body|integer(int32)|false|Defines the maximum length for the recording in seconds when `record` is specified. The minimum value is 0. The maximum value is 43200. The default value is 0 (infinite).|
|» record_timeout_secs|body|integer(int32)|false|The number of seconds that Telnyx will wait for the recording to be stopped if silence is detected when `record` is specified. The timer only starts when the speech is detected. Please note that call transcription is used to detect silence and the related charge will be applied. The minimum value is 0. The default value is 0 (infinite).|
|» record_track|body|string|false|The audio track to be recorded. Can be either `both`, `inbound` or `outbound`. If only single track is specified (`inbound`, `outbound`), `channels` configuration is ignored and it will be recorded as mono (single channel).|
|» record_trim|body|string|false|When set to `trim-silence`, silence will be removed from the beginning and end of the recording.|
|» record_custom_file_name|body|string|false|The custom recording file name to be used instead of the default `call_leg_id`. Telnyx will still add a Unix timestamp suffix.|
|» sip_region|body|string|false|Defines the SIP region to be used for the call.|
|» preferred_codecs|body|string|false|The list of comma-separated codecs in order of preference to be used during the call. The codecs supported are `G722`, `PCMU`, `PCMA`, `G729`, `OPUS`, `VP8`, `H264`, `AMR-WB`.|
|» webhook_urls|body|object|false|A map of event types to arrays of webhook URLs. When an event of the specified type occurs, the webhook URLs associated with that event type will be called instead of `webhook_url`. Events not mapped here will use the default `webhook_url`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[string(uri)]|false|none|
|» webhook_urls_method|body|string|false|HTTP request method to invoke `webhook_urls`.|
|» webhook_retries_policies|body|object|false|A map of event types to retry policies. Each retry policy contains an array of `retries_ms` specifying the delays between retry attempts in milliseconds. Maximum 5 retries, total delay cannot exceed 60 seconds.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» » » retries_ms|body|[integer]|false|Array of delays in milliseconds between retry attempts. Total sum cannot exceed 60000ms.|
|» route_to_mobile|body|boolean|false|When set to true, routes the call directly to the mobile device associated with the destination Telnyx Mobile number, bypassing Inbound Calls Interception configured in the Telnyx Portal under Mobile Numbers → select the number → Voice → Call Interception. Use this when transferring an intercepted call to the mobile device to prevent the call from being intercepted again. Defaults to false.|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-call-control-applications">Call Control Applications</h1>

Call Control applications operations

## List call control applications

<a id="opIdListCallControlApplications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/call_control_applications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /call_control_applications`

Return a list of call control applications.

<h3 id="list-call-control-applications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter|query|object|false|Consolidated filter parameter (deepObject style). Originally: filter[application_name][contains], filter[outbound.outbound_voice_profile_id], filter[leg_id], filter[application_session_id], filter[connection_id], filter[product], filter[failed], filter[from], filter[to], filter[name], filter[type], filter[occurred_at][eq/gt/gte/lt/lte], filter[status]|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[after], page[before], page[limit], page[size], page[number]|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|connection_name|
|sort|active|

## Create a call control application

<a id="opIdCreateCallControlApplication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/call_control_applications \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "application_name": "call-router",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "active": false,
    "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
    "dtmf_type": "Inband",
    "first_command_timeout": true,
    "first_command_timeout_secs": 10,
    "inbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "shaken_stir_enabled": true,
      "sip_subdomain": "example",
      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    },
    "webhook_api_version": "1",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25,
    "call_cost_in_webhooks": true,
    "redact_dtmf_debug_logging": true
  }'
```

`POST /call_control_applications`

Creates a call control application, which defines the webhook endpoints and settings used to control calls on associated connections.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "application_name": "call-router",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "active": false,
  "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
  "dtmf_type": "Inband",
  "first_command_timeout": true,
  "first_command_timeout_secs": 10,
  "inbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "shaken_stir_enabled": true,
    "sip_subdomain": "example",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
  },
  "outbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
  },
  "webhook_api_version": "1",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25,
  "call_cost_in_webhooks": true,
  "redact_dtmf_debug_logging": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-call-control-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateCallControlApplicationRequest](#schemacreatecallcontrolapplicationrequest)|true|Create call control application request.|
|» application_name|body|string|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(url)|true|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|string|false|<code>Latency</code> directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.<br>|
|» dtmf_type|body|string|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» first_command_timeout|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether calls to phone numbers associated with this connection should hangup after timing out.|
|» first_command_timeout_secs|body|integer|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a dial command.|
|» inbound|body|[CallControlApplicationInbound](#schemacallcontrolapplicationinbound)|false|none|
|» outbound|body|[CallControlApplicationOutbound](#schemacallcontrolapplicationoutbound)|false|none|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string \| null(url)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|
|» call_cost_in_webhooks|body|boolean|false|Specifies if call cost webhooks should be sent for this Call Control Application.|
|» redact_dtmf_debug_logging|body|boolean|false|When enabled, DTMF digits entered by users will be redacted in debug logs to protect PII data entered through IVR interactions.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|

<h3 id="create-a-call-control-application-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

## List dial metrics

<a id="opIdListDialMetrics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.telnyx.com/v2/dial_metrics?granularity=hour&start_time=2026-09-29T12%3A00%3A00.000Z&end_time=2026-09-29T14%3A00%3A00.000Z' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /dial_metrics`

Returns dials-per-second (DPS) metrics for your account's outbound dials made with the Call Control `Dial` command and TeXML, as time buckets with dial counts, accepted and rejected dials, average and peak DPS, and the DPS limit in force.

The result has one record per region per bucket, ordered by `start_time` and then `region`, newest first unless `sort=start_time`. Regions are never summed: the DPS limit is enforced per region, so a cross-region total cannot be compared with it.

Only buckets that saw dials are returned. Treat a missing bucket as zero dials.

Only complete 5-second windows are counted, and a window is counted about 15 seconds after it closes. The newest `granularity=second` record is therefore your live DPS, about 20 seconds old. Request the last minute or two with `sort=-start_time`; the first record of each `region` is that region's live rate (`page[limit]=1` would hide every region but one). If no recent record exists, the live rate is zero.

Results are cursor paginated. Follow `meta.next`, or pass `meta.cursors.after` as `page[after]`, until `meta.next` is absent. No total count is returned.

This endpoint is in development and can change before general availability.


<h3 id="list-dial-metrics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|granularity|query|string|true|Bucket size. `second` returns 5-second buckets (the finest resolution) and is kept for the last 48 hours. `minute` and `hour` are kept for the last 30 days.|
|start_time|query|string(date-time)|true|Inclusive start of the range, ISO 8601 (for example `2026-09-29T12:00:00.000Z`). Buckets that start at or after this time are returned. A `start_time` older than the retention window of the chosen `granularity` is moved forward to the start of that window, and `meta.start_time` returns the start actually used.|
|end_time|query|string(date-time)|true|Exclusive end of the range, ISO 8601. Must be after `start_time`. Buckets that start before this time are returned.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort order of the buckets by `start_time`. `-start_time` (default) returns the newest first, `start_time` the oldest first. `region` follows the same direction for buckets with the same `start_time`. To read the live rate, use `granularity=second` and `sort=-start_time`, then take the first record of each `region`.|
|page[after]|query|string|false|Opaque cursor from `meta.cursors.after` of the previous page. Do not parse or construct it. A cursor that matches no records returns an empty page whose `meta.cursors.after` and `meta.cursors.before` both echo the given cursor.|
|page[limit]|query|integer|false|Maximum number of buckets per page. Values outside the range are clamped to 1-10,000.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|granularity|second|
|granularity|minute|
|granularity|hour|
|sort|-start_time|
|sort|start_time|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "record_type": "dial_metric",
      "region": "us",
      "start_time": "2026-09-29T13:00:00.000Z",
      "end_time": "2026-09-29T14:00:00.000Z",
      "dials": {
        "total": 85600,
        "accepted": 85240,
        "rejected": {
          "dps_limit": 360,
          "hourly_limit": 0,
          "daily_limit": 0
        }
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response with a page of dial metrics buckets.|[ListDialMetricsResponse](#schemalistdialmetricsresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized. Authentication failed - the required authentication headers were either invalid or not included in the request.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|404|Not Found|Resource not found. The route does not exist.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity. A required parameter is missing, a parameter has an invalid value, or the whole range ends at or before the start of the retention window of the chosen granularity.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests. The API request rate limit was exceeded. Wait before retrying; honor `Retry-After` when present. See API rate limiting. This is the request rate limit, not the dials-per-second limit of outbound calls.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error. An unexpected error occurred on the server. This is typically returned for unhandled exceptions or system failures.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|
|default|Default|Unexpected error|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|429|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||Request limit for the current window.|
|429|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||Requests remaining in the current window.|
|429|X-RateLimit-Reset|integer||Reset timing signal for the current window.|
|429|Retry-After|integer||Seconds to wait before another attempt, when supplied.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Update campaign

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/10dlc/campaign/string \
```

`PUT /10dlc/campaign/{campaignId}`

Update a campaign's properties by `campaignId`. **Please note:** only sample messages are editable.

> Body parameter

```json
  "webhookFailoverURL": "WebhookURL"
```

<h3 id="update-campaign-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the campaign.|
|body|body|[UpdateCampaignRequest](#schemaupdatecampaignrequest)|true|none|
|» resellerId|body|string|false|Alphanumeric identifier of the reseller that you want to associate with this campaign.|
|» sample1|body|string|false|Message sample. Some campaign tiers require 1 or more message samples.|
|» sample2|body|string|false|Message sample. Some campaign tiers require 2 or more message samples.|
|» sample3|body|string|false|Message sample. Some campaign tiers require 3 or more message samples.|

|» sample5|body|string|false|Message sample. Some campaign tiers require 5 or more message samples.|
|» messageFlow|body|string|false|Message flow description.|
|» helpMessage|body|string|false|Help message of the campaign.|
|» autoRenewal|body|boolean|false|Help message of the campaign.|
|» webhookURL|body|string|false|Webhook to which campaign status updates are sent.|
|» webhookFailoverURL|body|string|false|Webhook failover to which campaign status updates are sent.|

## Submit campaign appeal for manual review

<a id="opIdAppealCampaign"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/10dlc/campaign/5eb13888-32b7-4cab-95e6-d834dde21d64/appeal \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "appeal_reason": "The website has been updated to include the required privacy policy and terms of service."
  }'
```

`POST /10dlc/campaign/{campaignId}/appeal`

Submits an appeal for rejected native campaigns in TELNYX_FAILED or MNO_REJECTED status. The appeal is recorded for manual compliance team review and the campaign status is reset to TCR_ACCEPTED. Note: Appeal forwarding is handled manually to allow proper review before incurring upstream charges.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "appeal_reason": "The website has been updated to include the required privacy policy and terms of service."
}
```

<h3 id="submit-campaign-appeal-for-manual-review-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|campaignId|path|string(uuid)|true|The Telnyx campaign identifier|
|body|body|object|true|Appeal request payload|
|» appeal_reason|body|string|true|Detailed explanation of why the campaign should be reconsidered and what changes have been made to address the rejection reason.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "appealed_at": "2025-08-06T15:30:45.123456+00:00"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "detail": "string",
  "source": {
    "pointer": "string",
    "parameter": "string"
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "detail": "string",
  "source": {
    "pointer": "string",
    "parameter": "string"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "title": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "string",
        "parameter": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="submit-campaign-appeal-for-manual-review-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Appeal recorded successfully. Campaign status updated to TCR_ACCEPTED for manual compliance review.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Campaign not in appealable status or invalid request|[10dlc_Error_ca4eb0ad6f](#schema10dlc_error_ca4eb0ad6f)|
|404|Not Found|Campaign not found|[10dlc_Error_ca4eb0ad6f](#schema10dlc_error_ca4eb0ad6f)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[10dlc_HTTPValidationError](#schema10dlc_httpvalidationerror)|
|4XX|Client Error|Generic response error|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

`POST /10dlc/campaignBuilder`

Before creating a campaign, use the [Qualify By Usecase endpoint](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/campaign/qualify-by-usecase) to ensure that the brand you want to assign a new campaign to is qualified for the desired use case of that campaign. **Please note:** After campaign creation, you'll only be able to edit the campaign's sample messages. Creating a campaign will entail an upfront, non-refundable three month's cost that will depend on the campaign's use case ([see 10DLC Costs section for details](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/campaign/get-campaign-cost)).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ageGated": true,
  "autoRenewal": true,
  "brandId": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "directLending": true,
  "embeddedLink": true,
  "embeddedPhone": true,
  "helpKeywords": "string",
  "helpMessage": "string",
  "messageFlow": "string",
  "mnoIds": [
    0
  ],
  "numberPool": true,
```

|» sample2|body|string|false|Message sample. Some campaign tiers require 2 or more message samples.|

|» termsAndConditions|body|boolean|false|Is terms and conditions accepted?|

|» termsAndConditionsLink|body|string|false|Link to the campaign's terms and conditions.|
|» embeddedLinkSample|body|string|false|Sample of an embedded link that will be sent to subscribers.|
|» usecase|body|string|true|Campaign usecase. Must be of defined valid types. Use `/10dlc/enum/usecase` operation to retrieve usecases available for given brand.|
|» webhookURL|body|string|false|Webhook to which campaign status updates are sent.|
|» webhookFailoverURL|body|string|false|Failover webhook to which campaign status updates are sent.|
