<h1 id="telnyx-api-chat">Chat</h1>

Generate text with LLMs

## Create a chat completion

<a id="opIdchat_public_chat_completions_post"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "system",
        "content": "You are a friendly chatbot."
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Hello, world!"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /ai/chat/completions`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

**Deprecated**: Use `POST /v2/ai/openai/chat/completions` instead. Chat with a language model. This endpoint is consistent with the [OpenAI Chat Completions API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat) and may be used with the OpenAI JS or Python SDK.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a friendly chatbot."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Hello, world!"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-chat-completion-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ChatCompletionRequest](#schemachatcompletionrequest)|true|none|
|» messages|body|[[ChatCompletionSystemMessageParam](#schemachatcompletionsystemmessageparam)]|true|A list of the previous chat messages for context.|
|» model|body|string|false|The language model to chat with.|
|» service_tier|body|string|false|The service tier to use for this request. Supported values vary by model; use `GET /v2/ai/openai/models` and inspect the model's `service_tiers` field. If omitted, Telnyx-hosted models use `default`.|
|» region|body|string|false|Optional data-residency region the request should be served from, using the same vocabulary as your account's Data Locality setting. Behavior depends on `mode`. Supported for Telnyx-hosted models only: a request routed to an external provider never passes through Telnyx model routing, so a region cannot be enforced for it. Omit for today's latency-based routing.|
|» mode|body|string|false|How strictly `region` is applied. `preferred` (the default when `region` is set) tries that region first and falls back to another when the model cannot be served there, so a request that would have succeeded still succeeds. `strict` pins the request: it is served from that region or it fails with a 422, never redirected to another region. Requires `region`.|
|» api_key_ref|body|string|false|If you are using an external inference provider like xAI or OpenAI, this field allows you to pass along a reference to your API key. After creating an [integration secret](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/integration-secrets/create-a-secret) for you API key, pass the secret's `identifier` in this field.|
|» stream|body|boolean|false|Whether or not to stream data-only server-sent events as they become available.|
|» temperature|body|number|false|Adjusts the "creativity" of the model. Lower values make the model more deterministic and repetitive, while higher values make the model more random and creative.|
|» max_tokens|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of completion (output) tokens, including reasoning and answer tokens combined. An omitted or null limit defaults to 8192 unless the model is excluded from that default; excluded models leave the limit to the serving engine. Explicit values and applied defaults are clamped to the model's max_completion_tokens metadata when that ceiling is set (see GET /v2/ai/openai/models). An omitted limit on an excluded model remains unset even when metadata declares a ceiling. Input and output together must fit the model's context window. Set an explicit limit when a bounded generation budget is required. For example, omitted or null limits default to 8192 for `zai-org/GLM-5.3` and `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash`. Hosted exclusions include `moonshotai/Kimi-K3`, `moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6`, `moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5`, `zai-org/GLM-5.2`, `zai-org/GLM-5.1-FP8`, `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8`, `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7`, `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`, `Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B`, `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct`, `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct`, `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` and `google/gemma-2b-it`. Legacy external and fine-tuned model IDs can also bypass the default; model discovery reports completion ceilings, not whether this default applies. Set an explicit limit for predictable behavior across models.|
|» tools|body|[[ChatCompletionToolParam](#schemachatcompletiontoolparam) \| [Retrieval](#schemaretrieval)]|false|The `function` tool type follows the same schema as the [OpenAI Chat Completions API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat). The `retrieval` tool type is unique to Telnyx. You may pass a list of [embedded storage buckets](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/embeddings/embed-documents) for retrieval-augmented generation.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ChatCompletionToolParam](#schemachatcompletiontoolparam)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[Retrieval](#schemaretrieval)|false|none|
|» tool_choice|body|string|false|none|
|» response_format|body|[ChatCompletionResponseFormatParam](#schemachatcompletionresponseformatparam)|false|Controls the format of the model output. `json_object` guarantees valid JSON output without defining a schema; `json_schema` constrains the output to the JSON schema you supply via the `json_schema` property and is the supported way to get guaranteed structured output on Telnyx-hosted models.|
|» min_p|body|number|false|This is an alternative to `top_p` that [many prefer](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/27670). Must be in [0, 1].|
|» n|body|number|false|This will return multiple choices for you instead of a single chat completion.|
|» use_beam_search|body|boolean|false|Setting this to `true` will allow the model to [explore more completion options](https://huggingface.co/blog/how-to-generate#beam-search). This is not supported by OpenAI.|
|» best_of|body|integer|false|This is used with `use_beam_search` to determine how many candidate beams to explore.|
|» length_penalty|body|number|false|This is used with `use_beam_search` to prefer shorter or longer completions.|
|» early_stopping|body|boolean|false|This is used with `use_beam_search`. If `true`, generation stops as soon as there are `best_of` complete candidates; if `false`, a heuristic is applied and the generation stops when is it very unlikely to find better candidates.|
|» logprobs|body|boolean|false|Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the `content` of `message`.|
|» top_logprobs|body|integer|false|This is used with `logprobs`. An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.|
|» frequency_penalty|body|number|false|Higher values will penalize the model from repeating the same output tokens.|
|» presence_penalty|body|number|false|Higher values will penalize the model from repeating the same output tokens.|
|» top_p|body|number|false|An alternative or complement to `temperature`. This adjusts how many of the top possibilities to consider.|
|» stop|body|string \| [string]|false|Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequence.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» seed|body|integer|false|If specified, the system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same `seed` and parameters should return the same result.|
|» enable_thinking|body|boolean|false|Whether to enable the thinking/reasoning phase for models that support it (e.g., QwQ, Qwen3). When set to false, the model will skip the internal reasoning step and respond directly, which can reduce latency. Defaults to true.|
|» reasoning_effort|body|string|false|Controls the reasoning effort for models that support it. When set, the model spends more or less compute on internal reasoning before generating its response. Supported values: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Not all models support all values; unsupported values are rejected with a 400 error. When omitted, reasoning models use their default effort level.|

|» region|EU|
|» region|AUS|
|» region|UAE|
|» mode|preferred|
|» mode|strict|
|» tool_choice|none|
|» tool_choice|auto|
|» tool_choice|required|
|» reasoning_effort|none|
|» reasoning_effort|minimal|
|» reasoning_effort|low|
|» reasoning_effort|medium|
|» reasoning_effort|high|
|» reasoning_effort|xhigh|
|» reasoning_effort|max|

## Summarize file content

<a id="opIdPostSummary"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/summarize \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "bucket": "string",
    "filename": "string",
    "system_prompt": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ai/summarize`

Generate a summary of a file's contents. 

 Supports the following text formats: 
- PDF, HTML, txt, json, csv

 Supports the following media formats (billed for both the transcription and summary): 
- flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm
- Up to 100 MB

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bucket": "string",
  "filename": "string",
  "system_prompt": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="summarize-file-content-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional opaque, unquoted key for safely retrying the same logical request. Keys must contain 1 to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. Generate a unique UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request. Invalid headers—including duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong values—return 400 with error code 10015. A request already in progress with the same key returns 409; reusing the key with a different request returns 422. Only successful responses are replayed, for up to 24 hours. Do not include sensitive data in the key.|
|body|body|[SummaryRequest](#schemasummaryrequest)|true|none|
|» bucket|body|string|true|The name of the bucket that contains the file to be summarized.|
|» filename|body|string|true|The name of the file to be summarized.|
|» system_prompt|body|string|false|A system prompt to guide the summary generation.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "summary": "Summary"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10036",
      "detail": "A request with this Idempotency-Key is already being processed.",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/header/Idempotency-Key"
      },
      "title": "Resource is being processed"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 413 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "body",
        "name"
      ],
      "msg": "Field required",
      "type": "missing"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="summarize-file-content-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[SummaryResponseData](#schemasummaryresponsedata)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request / Validation Failed (10015). Invalid, duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong Idempotency-Key headers are rejected by Edge with HTTP 400 and error code 10015.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|
|409|Conflict|A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed (10036). Retry later with the same key and request.|[email_ErrorResponse](#schemaemail_errorresponse)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Payload Too Large. A request sent with an Idempotency-Key whose body exceeds the endpoint's Edge replay-protection limit (256 KB) is rejected before it reaches the service. Requests sent without the header are not subject to this limit.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error. Reusing an Idempotency-Key with a different request body also returns 422 with error code 10027.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service unavailable (10016), including unavailable Edge idempotency protection for a keyed request.|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|

<h3 id="summarize-file-content-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **422**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anyOf*|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|false|none|none|
|*anyOf*|[inference-embedding_ErrorResponse](#schemainference-embedding_errorresponse)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Idempotent-Replayed|boolean||Present with value `true` when Edge replayed a stored successful response for the supplied Idempotency-Key. Omitted for first-time requests and error responses.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Compute new clusters

<a id="opIdcompute_new_cluster_public_text_clusters_post"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/clusters \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "bucket": "string",
    "prefix": "string",
    "files": [
      "string"
    ],
    "min_cluster_size": 25,
    "min_subcluster_size": 5
  }'
```

`POST /ai/clusters`

Starts a background task to compute how the data in an [embedded storage bucket](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/embeddings/embed-documents) is clustered. This helps identify common themes and patterns in the data.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bucket": "string",
  "prefix": "string",
  "files": [
    "string"
  ],
  "min_cluster_size": 25,
  "min_subcluster_size": 5
}
```

<h3 id="compute-new-clusters-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PublicTextClusteringRequest](#schemapublictextclusteringrequest)|true|none|
|» bucket|body|string|true|The embedded storage bucket to compute the clusters from. The bucket must already be [embedded](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/embeddings/embed-documents).|
|» prefix|body|string|false|Prefix to filter whcih files in the buckets are included.|
|» files|body|[string]|false|Array of files to filter which are included.|
|» min_cluster_size|body|integer|false|Smallest number of related text chunks to qualify as a cluster. Top-level clusters should be thought of as identifying broad themes in your data.|
|» min_subcluster_size|body|integer|false|Smallest number of related text chunks to qualify as a sub-cluster. Sub-clusters should be thought of as identifying more specific topics within a broader theme.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "task_id": "string"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "body",
        "name"
      ],
      "msg": "Field required",
      "type": "missing"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="compute-new-clusters-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[TextClusteringResponseData](#schematextclusteringresponsedata)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

bearerAuth
</aside>

Post a customer comment on a DIR (for example, to respond to reviewer notes). Send only `content` (1–5000 chars) and an optional `parent_comment_id`; the server sets the comment type, visibility, and author automatically. The enterprise is resolved server-side from the DIR id.

|dir_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The DIR id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[DirCommentCreateRequest](#schemadircommentcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» content|body|string|true|Comment body. 1–5000 characters.|
|» parent_comment_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Optional parent comment id to thread this reply under.|

## List conferences

<a id="opIdListConferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/conferences \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /conferences`

Lists conferences. Conferences are created on demand, and will expire after all participants have left the conference or after 4 hours regardless of the number of active participants. Conferences are listed in descending order by `expires_at`.

<h3 id="list-conferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|query|string|false|Region where the conference data is located|
|filter|query|object|false|Consolidated filter parameter (deepObject style). Originally: filter[application_name][contains], filter[outbound.outbound_voice_profile_id], filter[leg_id], filter[application_session_id], filter[connection_id], filter[product], filter[failed], filter[from], filter[to], filter[name], filter[type], filter[occurred_at][eq/gt/gte/lt/lte], filter[status]|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[after], page[before], page[limit], page[size], page[number]|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|region|Australia|
|region|Europe|
|region|Middle East|
|region|US|

{
  "data": [
    {

      "updated_at": "2019-01-23T18:10:02.574Z",
      "region": "sv1",

        "call_session_id": "428c31b6-abf3-3bc1-b7f4-5013ef9657c1"
      },
      "connection_id": "3fa85f64-9191-4567-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"

This includes validation errors, invalid parameter values, call state errors, conference errors, queue errors, recording/transcription errors, and business logic violations.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

## Create conference

<a id="opIdCreateConference"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/conferences \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
    "name": "Business",
    "beep_enabled": "always",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "duration_minutes": 5,
    "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
    "start_conference_on_create": false,
    "max_participants": 250
  }'
```

`POST /conferences`

Create a conference from an existing call leg using a `call_control_id` and a conference name. Upon creating the conference, the call will be automatically bridged to the conference. Conferences will expire after all participants have left the conference or after 4 hours regardless of the number of active participants.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `conference.created`
- `conference.participant.joined`
- `conference.participant.left`
- `conference.ended`
- `conference.recording.saved`
- `conference.floor.changed`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
  "name": "Business",
  "beep_enabled": "always",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "duration_minutes": 5,
  "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
  "start_conference_on_create": false,
  "max_participants": 250
}
```

<h3 id="create-conference-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateConferenceRequest](#schemacreateconferencerequest)|true|Create a conference|
|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the conference|
|» beep_enabled|body|string|false|Whether a beep sound should be played when participants join and/or leave the conference.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string. The client_state will be updated for the creator call leg and will be used for all webhooks related to the created conference.|
|» comfort_noise|body|boolean|false|Toggle background comfort noise.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» duration_minutes|body|integer|false|Time length (minutes) after which the conference will end.|
|» hold_audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played to participants joining the conference. The URL can point to either a WAV or MP3 file. hold_media_name and hold_audio_url cannot be used together in one request. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false".|
|» hold_media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played to participants joining the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false".|
|» max_participants|body|integer|false|The maximum number of active conference participants to allow. Must be between 2 and 800. Defaults to 250|
|» start_conference_on_create|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should be started on creation. If the conference isn't started all participants that join are automatically put on hold. Defaults to "true".|
|» region|body|string|false|Sets the region where the conference data will be hosted. Defaults to the region defined in user's data locality settings (Europe or US).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» beep_enabled|always|
|» beep_enabled|never|
|» beep_enabled|on_enter|
|» beep_enabled|on_exit|
|» region|Australia|
|» region|Europe|
|» region|Middle East|
|» region|US|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "record_type": "conference",
    "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
    "name": "All hands meeting",
    "created_at": "2019-01-23T18:10:02.574Z",

      "call_session_id": "428c31b6-abf3-3bc1-b7f4-5013ef9657c1"
    },
    "connection_id": "3fa85f64-9191-4567-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
  }
}
```

<a id="opIdConferenceGatherUsingAudio"></a>

> Code samples

curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/conferences/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/actions/gather_using_audio \

    "minimum_digits": 1,
    "maximum_digits": 4,
    "timeout_millis": 30000
  }'
```

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/gather_using_audio`

Play an audio file to a specific conference participant and gather DTMF input.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
  "audio_url": "http://example.com/gather_prompt.wav",

  "maximum_digits": 4,
  "timeout_millis": 30000
}
```

<h3 id="gather-dtmf-using-audio-prompt-in-a-conference-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|[ConferenceGatherUsingAudioRequest](#schemaconferencegatherusingaudiorequest)|false|none|
|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call leg that will receive the gather prompt.|
|» audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of the audio file to play as the gather prompt. Must be WAV or MP3 format.|
|» media_name|body|string|false|The name of the media file uploaded to the Media Storage API to play as the gather prompt.|
|» minimum_digits|body|integer|false|Minimum number of digits to gather.|
|» maximum_digits|body|integer|false|Maximum number of digits to gather.|
|» maximum_tries|body|integer|false|Maximum number of times to play the prompt if no input is received.|
|» timeout_millis|body|integer|false|Duration in milliseconds to wait for input before timing out.|
|» terminating_digit|body|string|false|Digit that terminates gathering. Set to an empty string to disable the terminating digit entirely, so that a digit such as `#` can be collected as input per `valid_digits`.|

|» inter_digit_timeout_millis|body|integer|false|Duration in milliseconds to wait between digits.|
|» initial_timeout_millis|body|integer|false|Duration in milliseconds to wait for the first digit before timing out.|
|» stop_playback_on_dtmf|body|boolean|false|Whether to stop the audio playback when a DTMF digit is received.|
|» invalid_audio_url|body|string|false|URL of audio file to play when invalid input is received.|
|» invalid_media_name|body|string|false|Name of media file to play when invalid input is received.|
|» gather_id|body|string|false|Identifier for this gather command. Will be included in the gather ended webhook. Maximum 100 characters.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. Must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|

## Join a conference

<a id="opIdJoinConference"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/conferences/string/actions/join \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
    "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
    "end_conference_on_exit": true,
    "hold": true,
    "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
    "mute": true,
    "start_conference_on_enter": true,
    "supervisor_role": "whisper",
    "whisper_call_control_ids": [
      "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
      "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
    ],
    "beep_enabled": "always"
  }'
```

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/join`

Join an existing call leg to a conference. Issue the Join Conference command with the conference ID in the path and the `call_control_id` of the leg you wish to join to the conference as an attribute. The conference can have up to a certain amount of active participants, as set by the `max_participants` parameter in conference creation request. 

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `conference.participant.joined`
- `conference.participant.left`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "end_conference_on_exit": true,
  "hold": true,
  "hold_audio_url": "http://www.example.com/audio.wav",
  "mute": true,
  "start_conference_on_enter": true,
  "supervisor_role": "whisper",
  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",
    "v2:qqpb0mmvd-ovhhBr0BUQQn0fld5jIboaaX3-De0DkqXHzbf8d75xkw"
  ],
  "beep_enabled": "always"
}
```

<h3 id="join-a-conference-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the conference by id or name|
|body|body|[JoinConferenceRequest](#schemajoinconferencerequest)|true|Join Conference request object|
|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string. Please note that the client_state will be updated for the participient call leg and the change will not affect conferencing webhooks unless the participient is the owner of the conference.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» end_conference_on_exit|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should end and all remaining participants be hung up after the participant leaves the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» soft_end_conference_on_exit|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should end after the participant leaves the conference. NOTE this doesn't hang up the other participants. Defaults to "false".|
|» hold|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be put on hold immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» hold_audio_url|body|string|false|The URL of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. hold_media_name and hold_audio_url cannot be used together in one request. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|» hold_media_name|body|string|false|The media_name of a file to be played to the participant when they are put on hold after joining the conference. The media_name must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. The file must either be a WAV or MP3 file. Takes effect only when "start_conference_on_create" is set to "false". This property takes effect only if "hold" is set to "true".|
|» mute|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be muted immediately after joining the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» start_conference_on_enter|body|boolean|false|Whether the conference should be started after the participant joins the conference. Defaults to "false".|
|» supervisor_role|body|string|false|Sets the joining participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|» whisper_call_control_ids|body|[string]|false|Array of unique call_control_ids the joining supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|
|» beep_enabled|body|string|false|Whether a beep sound should be played when the participant joins and/or leaves the conference. Can be used to override the conference-level setting.|
|» region|body|[ConferenceRegion](#schemaconferenceregion)|false|Region where the conference data is located. Defaults to the region defined in user's data locality settings (Europe or US).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» supervisor_role|barge|
|» supervisor_role|monitor|
|» supervisor_role|none|
|» supervisor_role|whisper|
|» beep_enabled|always|
|» beep_enabled|never|
|» beep_enabled|on_enter|
|» beep_enabled|on_exit|
|» region|Australia|
|» region|Europe|
|» region|Middle East|
|» region|US|

    "result": "ok"

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/record_start`

Start recording the conference. Recording will stop on conference end, or via the Stop Recording command.

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `conference.recording.saved`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "format": "wav",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "play_beep": true
}

|» format|body|string|true|The audio file format used when storing the conference recording. Can be either `mp3` or `wav`.|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore any command with the same `command_id` for the same `conference_id`.|
|» channels|body|string|false|When `dual`, final audio file will be stereo recorded with the conference creator on the first channel, and the rest on the second channel.|

|» trim|body|string|false|When set to `trim-silence`, silence will be removed from the beginning and end of the recording.|
|» custom_file_name|body|string|false|The custom recording file name to be used instead of the default `call_leg_id`. Telnyx will still add a Unix timestamp suffix.|

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/speak`

Convert text to speech and play it to all or some participants.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_ids": [
    "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg"
  ],

<h3 id="speak-text-to-conference-participants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|[ConferenceSpeakRequest](#schemaconferencespeakrequest)|true|none|
|» call_control_ids|body|[string]|false|Call Control IDs of participants who will hear the spoken text. When empty all participants will hear the spoken text.|
|» payload|body|string|true|The text or SSML to be converted into speech. There is a 3,000 character limit.|
|» payload_type|body|string|false|The type of the provided payload. The payload can either be plain text, or Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML).|
|» voice|body|string|true|Specifies the voice used in speech synthesis.<br><br>- Define voices using the format `<Provider>.<Model>.<VoiceId>`. Specifying only the provider will give default values for voice_id and model_id.<br><br> **Supported Providers:**<br>- **AWS:** Use `AWS.Polly.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna`). For neural voices, which provide more realistic, human-like speech, append `-Neural` to the `VoiceId` (e.g., `AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural`). Check the [available voices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/available-voices.html) for compatibility.<br>- **Azure:** Use `Azure.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Azure.en-CA-ClaraNeural`, `Azure.en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural`, `Azure.en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural`). For a complete list of voices, go to [Azure Voice Gallery](https://speech.microsoft.com/portal/voicegallery). Use `voice_settings` to configure custom deployments, regions, or API keys.<br>- **ElevenLabs:** Use `ElevenLabs.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `ElevenLabs.eleven_multilingual_v2.21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM`). The `ModelId` part is optional. To use ElevenLabs, you must provide your ElevenLabs API key as an integration identifier secret in `"voice_settings": {"api_key_ref": "<secret_identifier>"}`. See [integration secrets documentation](https://developers.telnyx.com/api/secrets-manager/integration-secrets/create-integration-secret) for details. Check [available voices](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/get-voices).<br>- **Telnyx:** Use `Telnyx.<model_id>.<voice_id>` (e.g., `Telnyx.KokoroTTS.af`). Use `voice_settings` to configure voice_speed and other synthesis parameters. `Bayan` provides Arabic (multiple dialects) and English voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Bayan.Ahmed`, `Telnyx.Bayan.Amanda`). `Sukhan` provides Urdu voices (e.g., `Telnyx.Sukhan.urdu-professor`); `voice_speed` is not supported.<br>- **Minimax:** Use `Minimax.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Minimax.speech-02-hd.Wise_Woman`). Supported models: `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-2.8-turbo`. Use `voice_settings` to configure speed, volume, pitch, and language_boost.<br>- **Resemble:** Use `Resemble.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Resemble.Turbo.Aaron_en-US`). Supported models: `Pro`, `Turbo`, `Urdu`. `<VoiceId>` is a stock voice name or the ID of a Resemble voice clone. Use `voice_settings` to configure precision, sample_rate, and format.<br>- **Inworld:** Use `Inworld.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Inworld.Mini.Loretta`, `Inworld.Max.Oliver`, `Inworld.TTS2.Loretta`). Supported models: `Mini`, `Max`, `TTS2`. Use `voice_settings` to configure `delivery_mode` (`STABLE`, `BALANCED`, `CREATIVE`), supported by `TTS2` only.<br>- **Fish Audio:** Use `FishAudio.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `FishAudio.s2.1-pro.<reference_id>`). Supported models: `s2.1-pro`, `s2-pro`, `s1`. `VoiceId` is a Fish Voice-Library reference ID.<br>- **Soniox:** Use `Soniox.<ModelId>.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Soniox.tts-rt-v2.Emma`). Supported model: `tts-rt-v2`. Browse the catalog via the [Voices API](https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/text-to-speech-commands/list-available-voices). Every voice speaks all supported languages; set `language` to the two-letter ISO 639-1 code of the text, for example `it`. SSML is not supported. Use `voice_settings` to configure `speed` (0.7 to 1.3) and `reduce_silence`.<br>- **xAI:** Use `xAI.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `xAI.eve`). Available voices: `eve`, `ara`, `rex`, `sal`, `leo`.<br>- **Humain:** Use `Humain.<VoiceId>` (e.g., `Humain.sara-ar`). Available voices: `sara-en`, `abdulaziz-en`, `sara-ar`, `abdulaziz-ar`, `nourah-ar`, `abdullah-ar`. Native Arabic (Saudi dialect) and English voices only — no `ModelId` segment.<br><br>For service_level basic, you may define the gender of the speaker (male or female).|

      "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",

`POST /conferences/{id}/actions/update`

Update conference participant supervisor_role

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
  "command_id": "891510ac-f3e4-11e8-af5b-de00688a4901",
  "supervisor_role": "whisper",
  "whisper_call_control_ids": [
    "v2:Sg1xxxQ_U3ixxxyXT_VDNI3xxxazZdg6Vxxxs4-GNYxxxVaJPOhFMRQ",

<h3 id="update-conference-participant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|» call_control_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|» command_id|body|string|false|Use this field to avoid execution of duplicate commands. Telnyx will ignore subsequent commands with the same `command_id` as one that has already been executed.|
|» supervisor_role|body|string|true|Sets the participant as a supervisor for the conference. A conference can have multiple supervisors. "barge" means the supervisor enters the conference as a normal participant. This is the same as "none". "monitor" means the supervisor is muted but can hear all participants. "whisper" means that only the specified "whisper_call_control_ids" can hear the supervisor. Defaults to "none".|
|» whisper_call_control_ids|body|[string]|false|Array of unique call_control_ids the supervisor can whisper to. If none provided, the supervisor will join the conference as a monitoring participant only.|
|» region|body|[ConferenceRegion](#schemaconferenceregion)|false|Region where the conference data is located. Defaults to the region defined in user's data locality settings (Europe or US).|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|

|» supervisor_role|monitor|
|» supervisor_role|none|

|» region|Europe|
|» region|Middle East|
|» region|US|

## Retrieve page contents

<a id="opIdCreateWebSearchContents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/web_search/contents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \

  }'

`POST /web_search/contents`

Retrieves clean HTML or Markdown content from a list of URLs. Supports up to 20 URLs per request (public API limit). Specify which formats to return: `html`, `markdown`, `metadata`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "urls": [
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence"
  ],
  "formats": [
    "markdown",
    "metadata"
  ],
  "crawl_timeout": 10,
  "max_age": null
}

|» formats|body|[string]|false|Content formats to return. If omitted, `html` and `metadata` are returned by default. Retrieval is best-effort per URL: a format field appears only when that content could be produced, and a freshly crawled page may also include `html` even when not requested.|
|» crawl_timeout|body|integer|false|Timeout for crawling each URL, in seconds (1-60).|
|» max_age|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum age of cached content in seconds. `null` means no limit.|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-conversation-histories">Conversation Histories</h1>

Semantic vector search over ingested conversation history records with multi-region fan-out.

## Search conversation histories

<a id="opIdSearchConversationHistories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=customer%20called%20about%20billing%20issue' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai/conversation_histories`

Performs semantic vector search across conversation history records.

**How it works:**
1. The query text is embedded into a 1024-dimensional vector using the multilingual-e5-large model.
2. The vector is compared against indexed record chunks using semantic similarity search.
3. When no region is specified, all regions are queried in parallel (fan-out) and results are merged by score.
4. Results are ranked by similarity score (descending) and paginated via `page[number]` / `page[size]`.

**Authentication:** Requires a Telnyx API key via `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Results are automatically scoped to the caller's organization — `organization_id` is injected from the auth token and cannot be overridden.

**Chunking:** Records are split into chunks of up to 480 tokens with 64-token overlap at ingestion time. Each search result represents a single chunk, with `chunk_index` and `chunk_total` indicating its position within the original record.

**Filtering:** Use `filter[field][operator]=value` query parameters to narrow results before vector search.

Top-level filterable fields: `user_id`, `region`, `record_id`, `record_created_at`, `ingested_at`, `retention`

Note: `retention` is filter-only — it can be used to narrow results but is not returned in the response body.

Metadata fields: any field not in the list above is resolved to `data.metadata.<field>` (e.g., `filter[language]=en` → `data.metadata.language`).

Supported filter operators:
- `eq` — exact match (default when no operator specified)
- `in` — match any of comma-separated values
- `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt` — range comparisons (useful for date filtering)
- `contains` — wildcard substring match

**Examples:**
- `GET /v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=billing+issue&page[size]=10`
- `GET /v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=setup+guide&region=USA&min_score=0.5`
- `GET /v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=refund&filter[record_created_at][gte]=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`
- `GET /v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=outage&filter[region][in]=USA,DEU`
- `GET /v2/ai/conversation_histories?q=hold+time&filter[language]=en`

<h3 id="search-conversation-histories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|true|Natural language search query. The text is embedded into a 1024-dimensional vector and compared against indexed record chunks using semantic similarity.|
|region|query|string|false|Restrict search to a specific region. When omitted, all regions are queried in parallel (fan-out) and results are merged by similarity score.|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|Page number to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.|
|min_score|query|number(float)|false|Minimum cosine similarity score threshold (0.0 to 1.0). Results below this threshold are excluded.|
|filter[user_id]|query|string|false|Filter to records owned by a specific user (exact match).|
|filter[record_id]|query|string|false|Filter to chunks belonging to a specific parent record (exact match).|
|filter[region][in]|query|string|false|Filter by the region stored on the record. Comma-separated to match multiple regions (USA, DEU, AUS, UAE). Distinct from the `region` parameter, which selects which cluster(s) are queried.|
|filter[record_created_at][gte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include records whose original creation time is on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.|
|filter[record_created_at][lte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include records whose original creation time is on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.|
|filter[ingested_at][gte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include records ingested (chunked, embedded, and indexed) on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.|
|filter[ingested_at][lte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include records ingested (chunked, embedded, and indexed) on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.|
|filter[retention]|query|string|false|Filter by retention policy (exact match). Filter-only: not returned in the response body.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|region|USA|
|region|DEU|
|region|AUS|
|region|UAE|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "rec-001_chunk_0",
      "record_id": "rec-001",
      "chunk_index": 0,
      "chunk_total": 3,
      "text": "Customer called regarding a billing discrepancy on their latest invoice. Agent confirmed the charge was correct and explained the prorated amount.",
      "score": 0.92,
      "region": "USA",
      "user_id": "user-123",
      "organization_id": "org-456",
      "record_created_at": "2026-05-28T12:00:00Z",
      "ingested_at": "2026-05-28T12:01:00Z",
      "metadata": {
        "source": "call-center",
        "language": "en"
      }
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total_pages": 1,
    "total_results": 1,
    "page_number": 1,
    "page_size": 20
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "400",
      "title": "Bad Request",
      "detail": "Invalid region: invalid. Must be one of: USA, DEU, AUS, UAE"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10004",
      "title": "Authentication failed",
      "detail": "The required authentication headers were either invalid or not included in the request."
    }
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10027",
      "title": "Unprocessable Entity",
      "detail": "The server understood the syntax of the request but was unable to process the instructions."
    }
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Unexpected error",
      "detail": "An unexpected error occured.",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10007"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 503 Response

{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10037",
      "title": "Service unavailable",
      "detail": "Service is unavailable."
    }
  ]
}

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|400|Bad Request|Invalid request parameters — invalid region or malformed filter expression.|[Errors](#schemaerrors)|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-conversations">Conversations</h1>

Manage historical AI assistant conversations

## List conversations

<a id="opIdget_conversations_public_conversations_get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/conversations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai/conversations`

Retrieve a list of all AI conversations configured by the user. Supports [PostgREST-style query parameters](https://postgrest.org/en/stable/api.html#horizontal-filtering-rows) for filtering. Examples are included for the standard metadata fields, but you can filter on any field in the metadata JSON object. For example, to filter by a custom field `metadata->custom_field`, use `metadata->custom_field=eq.value`.

<h3 id="list-conversations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|string|false|Filter by conversation ID (e.g. id=eq.123)|
|name|query|string|false|Filter by conversation Name (e.g. `name=like.Voice%`)|
|created_at|query|string|false|Filter by creation datetime (e.g., `created_at=gte.2025-01-01`)|
|last_message_at|query|string|false|Filter by last message datetime (e.g., `last_message_at=lte.2025-06-01`)|
|metadata->assistant_id|query|string|false|Filter by assistant ID (e.g., `metadata->assistant_id=eq.assistant-123`)|
|metadata->assistant_version_id|query|string|false|Filter by assistant version ID (e.g., `metadata->assistant_version_id=eq.20250812T114318034399`). The version that handled the conversation is stored in metadata when the conversation starts; conversations created before this field was tracked, or that never resolved a version, have no `assistant_version_id` and do not match this filter.|
|metadata->call_control_id|query|string|false|Filter by call control ID (e.g., `metadata->call_control_id=eq.v3:123`)|
|metadata->telnyx_agent_target|query|string|false|Filter by the phone number, SIP URI, or other identifier for the agent (e.g., `metadata->telnyx_agent_target=eq.+13128675309`)|
|metadata->telnyx_end_user_target|query|string|false|Filter by the phone number, SIP URI, or other identifier for the end user (e.g., `metadata->telnyx_end_user_target=eq.+13128675309`)|
|metadata->telnyx_conversation_channel|query|string|false|Filter by conversation channel (e.g., `metadata->telnyx_conversation_channel=eq.phone_call`)|
|limit|query|integer|false|Limit the number of returned conversations (e.g., `limit=10`)|
|order|query|string|false|Order the results by specific fields (e.g., `order=created_at.desc` or `order=last_message_at.asc`)|
|or|query|string|false|Apply OR conditions using PostgREST syntax (e.g., `or=(created_at.gte.2025-04-01,last_message_at.gte.2025-04-01)`)|

{

      "metadata": {

## Aggregate Conversation Insights

<a id="opIdaggregate_conversation_insights"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/conversations/conversation-insights/aggregates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ai/conversations/conversation-insights/aggregates`

Aggregate conversation insights by specified fields

<h3 id="aggregate-conversation-insights-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_by|query|[string]|false|Fields to group by (can be comma-separated or multiple parameters). Prefix a field with 'metadata.' (e.g. 'metadata.assistant_id') to group by the conversation's metadata instead of the insight result.<br><br>Common fields used for over-time charts:<br>- `score` — Group by the insight's score value (e.g. for Agent Instruction Following, User Satisfaction).<br>- `metadata.assistant_id` — Group by the assistant that handled the conversation.<br>- `metadata.assistant_version_id` — Group by the assistant version, useful for comparing performance across versions in the portal's 'Insights Over Time' chart.<br>- `metadata.telnyx_conversation_channel` — Group by conversation channel (phone_call, web_chat, etc.).|
|show|query|[string]|false|Fields to include in the result (can be comma-separated or multiple parameters). Supports the same 'metadata.<key>' prefix as group_by. Each returned row will contain the grouped field values plus a `record_count` indicating how many conversation insights match that combination.|
|insight_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional insight ID to filter conversation insights. Only insights matching this ID will be included in the aggregation.|
|created_at|query|string|false|Filter by creation datetime to scope the aggregation window. Supports range operators (e.g., `created_at=gte.2025-01-01T00:00:00Z` for the start of the range, `created_at=lt.2025-01-02T00:00:00Z` for the end). To build per-day time series (as the portal does for the 'Insights Over Time' chart), issue one request per day bounded by `created_at=gte.<day_start>` and `created_at=lt.<next_day_start>`.|
|metadata.assistant_id|query|string|false|Filter by assistant ID (e.g., `metadata.assistant_id=eq.<assistant_id>`). When provided, only conversation insights for the specified assistant are aggregated. Used by the portal to scope the 'Insights Over Time' chart to a single assistant.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "record_count": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "body",
        "name"
      ],
      "msg": "Field required",
      "type": "missing"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="aggregate-conversation-insights-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[ConversationInsightAggregateResp](#schemaconversationinsightaggregateresp)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

`DELETE /ai/conversations/{conversation_id}`

Delete a specific conversation by its ID. Permanently deletes the conversation and its associated data: the conversation's messages, its insight generation results, any conversation memories, and its webhook request logs. Recordings are not deleted — recordings are managed separately through the /v2/recordings endpoints. This action cannot be undone.

      ],

  ]
}
```

## Delete a conversation's insight generation results

<a id="opIddelete_conversation_insight"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/conversations/string/conversations-insights/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /ai/conversations/{conversation_id}/conversations-insights/{insight_id}`

Delete one insight generation request for a conversation. Generation results are stored per conversation and per insight template; deleting a request permanently removes the stored result but does not stop insight generation from running again. To remove every insight result for the conversation, delete the conversation itself. A successful delete returns an empty response.

<h3 id="delete-a-conversations-insight-generation-results-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|conversation_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the conversation.|
|insight_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the insight generation request to delete, as returned as `data.id` by the insight generation and insights-list operations. Note that the nested `conversation_insights[].insight_id` field returned in the insights-list response is the insight template ID, not the ID accepted here.|

> Example responses

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "body",
        "name"
      ],
      "msg": "Field required",
      "type": "missing"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-conversations-insight-generation-results-responses">Responses</h3>

`POST /ai/conversations/{conversation_id}/message`

Add a new message to the conversation. Used to insert a new messages to a conversation manually ( without using chat endpoint )

  "content": "",

Generate a unique UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request. Invalid headers—including duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong values—return 400 with error code 10015. A request already in progress with the same key returns 409; reusing the key with a different request returns 422. Only successful responses are replayed, for up to 24 hours. Do not include sensitive data in the key.|

`GET /credential_connections`

Returns a list of your credential connections.

<h3 id="list-credential-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|filter|query|object|false|Consolidated filter parameter (deepObject style). Originally: filter[connection_name], filter[fqdn], filter[outbound_voice_profile_id], filter[outbound.outbound_voice_profile_id]|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[size], page[number]|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-connection_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>connection_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

## Create a credential connection

<a id="opIdCreateCredentialConnection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/credential_connections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "active": true,
    "password": "my123secure456password789",
    "user_name": "myusername123",
    "anchorsite_override": "Latency",
    "connection_name": "my name",
    "sip_uri_calling_preference": "disabled",
    "default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled": false,
    "dtmf_type": "RFC 2833",
    "encode_contact_header_enabled": true,
    "encrypted_media": "SRTP",
    "onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled": true,
    "ios_push_credential_id": "ec0c8e5d-439e-4620-a0c1-9d9c8d02a836",
    "android_push_credential_id": "06b09dfd-7154-4980-8b75-cebf7a9d4f8e",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_api_version": "1",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25,
    "call_cost_in_webhooks": false,
    "rtcp_settings": {
      "port": "rtcp-mux",
      "capture_enabled": true,
      "report_frequency_secs": 10
    },
    "inbound": {
      "ani_number_format": "+E.164",
      "dnis_number_format": "+e164",
      "codecs": [
        "G722"
      ],
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "generate_ringback_tone": true,
      "isup_headers_enabled": true,
      "prack_enabled": true,
      "sip_compact_headers_enabled": true,
      "timeout_1xx_secs": 10,
      "timeout_2xx_secs": 20,
      "shaken_stir_enabled": true,
      "simultaneous_ringing": "disabled"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "call_parking_enabled": true,
      "ani_override": "always",
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "instant_ringback_enabled": true,
      "generate_ringback_tone": true,
      "localization": "US",
      "t38_reinvite_source": "customer",
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    },
    "noise_suppression": "both",
    "noise_suppression_details": {
      "engine": "deep_filter_net",
      "attenuation_limit": 80
    },
    "jitter_buffer": {
      "enable_jitter_buffer": true,
      "jitterbuffer_msec_min": 60,
      "jitterbuffer_msec_max": 200
    },
    "bridge_generate_comfort_noise_on_cn": false
  }'
```

`POST /credential_connections`

<h3 id="create-a-credential-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateCredentialConnectionRequest](#schemacreatecredentialconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during credential connection creation|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» user_name|body|string|true|The user name to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 4-32 characters long and alphanumeric values only (no spaces or special characters).|
|» password|body|string|true|The password to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 8 to 128 characters long.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|[ConnectionName](#schemaconnectionname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the connection.|
|» sip_uri_calling_preference|body|string|false|This feature enables inbound SIP URI calls to your Credential Auth Connection. If enabled for all (unrestricted) then anyone who calls the SIP URI <your-username>@telnyx.com will be connected to your Connection. You can also choose to allow only calls that are originated on any Connections under your account (internal).|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» bridge_generate_comfort_noise_on_cn|body|boolean|false|Stores the connection preference for generating silent RTP toward the opposite call leg when comfort-noise packets (CN, payload type 13) are received during hold. Optional; defaults to false when omitted on creation. Only JSON true and false are accepted; null and non-boolean values are rejected. This preference is independent of default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled and does not modify that setting. This API provisions the preference; call-processing behavior is implemented separately.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP for encryption. Can only be set when the SIP signaling transport protocol is TLS.|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» ios_push_credential_id|body|[ConnectionIosPushCredentialId](#schemaconnectioniospushcredentialid)|false|The uuid of the push credential for Ios|
|» android_push_credential_id|body|[ConnectionAndroidPushCredentialId](#schemaconnectionandroidpushcredentialid)|false|The uuid of the push credential for Android|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(uri)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string \| null(uri)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1, v2 or texml. Note - texml can only be set when the outbound object parameter call_parking_enabled is included and set to true.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|
|» call_cost_in_webhooks|body|boolean|false|Specifies if call cost webhooks should be sent for this connection.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the connection.|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» inbound|body|[CredentialInbound](#schemacredentialinbound)|false|none|
|» outbound|body|[CredentialOutbound](#schemacredentialoutbound)|false|none|
|» noise_suppression|body|[ConnectionNoiseSuppression](#schemaconnectionnoisesuppression)|false|Controls when noise suppression is applied to calls. When set to 'inbound', noise suppression is applied to incoming audio. When set to 'outbound', it's applied to outgoing audio. When set to 'both', it's applied in both directions. When set to 'disabled', noise suppression is turned off.|
|» noise_suppression_details|body|[ConnectionNoiseSuppressionDetails](#schemaconnectionnoisesuppressiondetails)|false|Configuration options for noise suppression. These settings are stored regardless of the noise_suppression value, but only take effect when noise_suppression is not 'disabled'. If you disable noise suppression and later re-enable it, the previously configured settings will be used.|
|» jitter_buffer|body|[ConnectionJitterBuffer](#schemaconnectionjitterbuffer)|false|Configuration options for Jitter Buffer. Enables Jitter Buffer for RTP streams of SIP Trunking calls. The feature is off unless enabled. You may define min and max values in msec for customized buffering behaviors. Larger values add latency but tolerate more jitter, while smaller values reduce latency but are more sensitive to jitter and reordering.|

<h3 id="update-a-credential-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Identifies the resource.|
|body|body|[UpdateCredentialConnectionRequest](#schemaupdatecredentialconnectionrequest)|true|Parameters that can be updated in a credential connection|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Defaults to true|
|» conversation_persistence|body|boolean|false|Whether conversation persistence is enabled for this connection. When enabled, calls handled by the connection are transcribed, stored, and indexed. Defaults to false.|
|» user_name|body|string|false|The user name to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 4-32 characters long and alphanumeric values only (no spaces or special characters).|
|» password|body|string|false|The password to be used as part of the credentials. Must be 8 to 128 characters long.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» connection_name|body|[ConnectionName](#schemaconnectionname)|false|A user-assigned name to help manage the connection.|
|» sip_uri_calling_preference|body|string|false|This feature enables inbound SIP URI calls to your Credential Auth Connection. If enabled for all (unrestricted) then anyone who calls the SIP URI <your-username>@telnyx.com will be connected to your Connection. You can also choose to allow only calls that are originated on any Connections under your account (internal).|
|» default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled|body|boolean|false|When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.|
|» bridge_generate_comfort_noise_on_cn|body|boolean|false|Stores the connection preference for generating silent RTP toward the opposite call leg when comfort-noise packets (CN, payload type 13) are received during hold. Optional; omitting this field preserves the saved value. Only JSON true and false are accepted; null and non-boolean values are rejected. This preference is independent of default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled and does not modify that setting. This API provisions the preference; call-processing behavior is implemented separately.|
|» dtmf_type|body|[DtmfType](#schemadtmftype)|false|Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.|
|» encode_contact_header_enabled|body|boolean|false|Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.|
|» encrypted_media|body|[EncryptedMedia](#schemaencryptedmedia)|false|Enable use of SRTP for encryption. Can only be set when the SIP signaling transport protocol is TLS.|
|» onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.|
|» ios_push_credential_id|body|[ConnectionIosPushCredentialId](#schemaconnectioniospushcredentialid)|false|The uuid of the push credential for Ios|
|» android_push_credential_id|body|[ConnectionAndroidPushCredentialId](#schemaconnectionandroidpushcredentialid)|false|The uuid of the push credential for Android|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(uri)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string \| null(uri)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer \| null|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|
|» call_cost_in_webhooks|body|boolean|false|Specifies if call cost webhooks should be sent for this connection.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the connection.|
|» rtcp_settings|body|[ConnectionRtcpSettings](#schemaconnectionrtcpsettings)|false|none|
|» inbound|body|[CredentialInbound](#schemacredentialinbound)|false|none|
|» outbound|body|[CredentialOutbound](#schemacredentialoutbound)|false|none|
|» noise_suppression|body|[ConnectionNoiseSuppression](#schemaconnectionnoisesuppression)|false|Controls when noise suppression is applied to calls. When set to 'inbound', noise suppression is applied to incoming audio. When set to 'outbound', it's applied to outgoing audio. When set to 'both', it's applied in both directions. When set to 'disabled', noise suppression is turned off.|
|» noise_suppression_details|body|[ConnectionNoiseSuppressionDetails](#schemaconnectionnoisesuppressiondetails)|false|Configuration options for noise suppression. These settings are stored regardless of the noise_suppression value, but only take effect when noise_suppression is not 'disabled'. If you disable noise suppression and later re-enable it, the previously configured settings will be used.|
|» jitter_buffer|body|[ConnectionJitterBuffer](#schemaconnectionjitterbuffer)|false|Configuration options for Jitter Buffer. Enables Jitter Buffer for RTP streams of SIP Trunking calls. The feature is off unless enabled. You may define min and max values in msec for customized buffering behaviors. Larger values add latency but tolerate more jitter, while smaller values reduce latency but are more sensitive to jitter and reordering.|

## Check a Credential Connection Registration Status

<a id="opIdCheckRegistrationStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/credential_connections/string/actions/check_registration_status \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /credential_connections/{id}/actions/check_registration_status`

Returns the live SIP registration status for a credential connection. Reports whether the endpoint is currently registered (`status`) and the timestamp of the last SIP registration event (`last_registration`).

<h3 id="check-a-credential-connection-registration-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

## Create a credential

<a id="opIdCreateTelephonyCredential"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/telephony_credentials \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "My-new-credential",
    "connection_id": "1234567890"
  }'
```

`POST /telephony_credentials`

Creates a new on-demand telephony credential for the specified connection. The credential can then be used to generate access tokens for SIP or WebRTC clients.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "My-new-credential",
  "connection_id": "1234567890"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-credential-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TelephonyCredentialCreateRequest](#schematelephonycredentialcreaterequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during credential creation|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» tag|body|string|false|Tags a credential. A single tag can hold at maximum 1000 credentials.|
|» connection_id|body|string|true|Identifies the Credential Connection this credential is associated with.|
|» expires_at|body|string|false|ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the credential will expire.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "c215ade3-0d39-418e-94be-c5f780760199",

    "name": "2020-06-18 21:32:38.917732Z",
    "expired": false,
    "user_id": "user-id",
    "resource_id": "connection:804252963366242252",
    "sip_password": "a92dbcfb60184a8cb330b0acb2f7617b",
    "sip_username": "gencrednCvHU5IYpSBPPsXI2iQsDX",
    "created_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38",
    "expires_at": "2042-06-18T21:32:38",
    "updated_at": "2020-06-18T21:32:38.000Z"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="telnyx-api-dir-references">DIR References</h1>

Submit and manage the two business references and one financial reference that vouch for a DIR. References are contacted to confirm the business identity during vetting.

References (two business references and one financial reference) are needed only if the documents uploaded with the DIR don't already prove the business is legitimate and financially stable. Any one of these is enough proof: audited or certified financial statements (uploaded as `other`, with a description), a commercial credit report (uploaded as `business_credit_report`), or references. Telnyx reviewers decide during vetting whether your documents are enough.

## List a DIR's references

<a id="opIdlistDirReferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/dir/16635d38-75a6-4481-82e8-69af60e05011/references \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /dir/{dir_id}/references`

List the business and financial references submitted for a DIR.

Returns the two business references (slots 1 and 2) followed by the single financial reference. Each entry carries its `ref_type` and `slot`, which together address the reference when updating it, alongside the details supplied when it was submitted (name, title, organization, relationship, phone, email, timezone). No internal identifiers are exposed. Returns an empty list when no references were submitted.

<h3 id="list-a-dirs-references-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dir_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The DIR id. Lowercase UUID.|

      "slot": 1,
      "full_name": "Dana Reyes",
      "job_title": "VP of Operations",
      "organization": "Acme Logistics",
      "relationship_to_registrant": "Supplier",
      "phone_e164": "+14155550123",
      "email": "dana.reyes@example.com",
      "timezone": "America/New_York"
    }

}
