<a id="opIdCreateMessagingProfile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/messaging_profiles \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "My name",
    "enabled": true,
    "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
    "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
    "webhook_api_version": "2",
    "number_pool_settings": {
      "toll_free_weight": 10,
      "long_code_weight": 1,
      "skip_unhealthy": true,
      "sticky_sender": false,
      "geomatch": false
    },
    "url_shortener_settings": {
      "domain": "example.ex",
      "prefix": "",
      "replace_blacklist_only": true,
      "send_webhooks": false
    },
    "mm7_metadata": {
      "mm7_webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
      "mm7_failover_webhook_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks"
    },
    "whitelisted_destinations": [
      "US"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /messaging_profiles`

Creates a messaging profile that controls outbound sender selection, webhook delivery, and inbound message handling for associated numbers and short codes.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "My name",
  "enabled": true,
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
  "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
  "webhook_api_version": "2",
  "number_pool_settings": {
    "toll_free_weight": 10,
    "long_code_weight": 1,
    "skip_unhealthy": true,
    "sticky_sender": false,
    "geomatch": false
  },
  "url_shortener_settings": {
    "domain": "example.ex",
    "prefix": "",
    "replace_blacklist_only": true,
    "send_webhooks": false
  },
  "mm7_metadata": {
    "mm7_webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
    "mm7_failover_webhook_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks"
  },
  "whitelisted_destinations": [
    "US"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-messaging-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[messaging_CreateMessagingProfileRequest](#schemamessaging_createmessagingprofilerequest)|true|New Messaging Profile object|
|» name|body|string|true|A user friendly name for the messaging profile.|
|» whitelisted_destinations|body|[string]|true|Destinations to which the messaging profile is allowed to send. The elements in the list must be valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. If set to `["*"]` all destinations will be allowed.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the messaging profile is enabled or not.|
|» webhook_url|body|string \| null(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent.|
|» webhook_failover_url|body|string \| null(url)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1, v2, or a legacy 2010-04-01 format.|
|» number_pool_settings|body|[NumberPoolSettings](#schemanumberpoolsettings)|false|Number Pool allows you to send messages from a pool of numbers of different types, assigning<br>weights to each type. The pool consists of all the long code and toll free numbers<br>assigned to the messaging profile.<br><br>To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.<br>|
|» url_shortener_settings|body|[UrlShortenerSettings](#schemaurlshortenersettings)|false|The URL shortener feature allows automatic replacement of URLs that were generated using<br>a public URL shortener service.   }'
```

`PATCH /messaging_profiles/{id}`

Updates the supplied settings on the specified messaging profile. Settings omitted from the request remain unchanged.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Updated Profile for Messages",
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
  "webhook_failover_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks",
  "enabled": true,
  "webhook_api_version": "2",
  "whitelisted_destinations": [
    "US"
  ],

    "long_code_weight": 2,
    "skip_unhealthy": false,
    "sticky_sender": true,
    "geomatch": false
  },
  "url_shortener_settings": {
    "domain": "example.ex",
    "prefix": "cmpny",
    "replace_blacklist_only": true,
    "send_webhooks": false
  },
  "mm7_metadata": {
    "mm7_webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/hooks",
    "mm7_failover_webhook_url": "https://backup.example.com/hooks"
  },
  "v1_secret": "rP1VamejkU2v0qIUxntqLW2c"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|body|body|[messaging_UpdateMessagingProfileRequest](#schemamessaging_updatemessagingprofilerequest)|true|New Messaging Profile object|
|» name|body|string|false|A user friendly name for the messaging profile.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the messaging profile is enabled or not.|
|» webhook_url|body|string \| null(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent.|
|» webhook_failover_url|body|string \| null(url)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this messaging profile will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails.|
|» webhook_api_version|body|string|false|Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1, v2, or a legacy 2010-04-01 format.|
|» whitelisted_destinations|body|[string]|false|Destinations to which the messaging profile is allowed to send. The elements in the list must be valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. If set to `["*"]`, all destinations will be allowed.<br><br>This field is required if the messaging profile doesn't have it defined yet.|
|» v1_secret|body|string|false|Secret used to authenticate with v1 endpoints.|
|» number_pool_settings|body|[NumberPoolSettings](#schemanumberpoolsettings)|false|Number Pool allows you to send messages from a pool of numbers of different types, assigning<br>weights to each type. The pool consists of all the long code and toll free numbers<br>assigned to the messaging profile.<br><br>To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.<br>|
|» url_shortener_settings|body|[UrlShortenerSettings](#schemaurlshortenersettings)|false|The URL shortener feature allows automatic replacement of URLs that were generated using<br>a public URL shortener service. Some examples include bit.do, bit.ly, goo.gl, ht.ly,<br>is.gd, ow.ly, rebrand.ly, t.co, tiny.cc, and tinyurl.com. Such URLs are replaced with<br>with links generated by Telnyx. The use of custom links can improve branding and message<br>deliverability.<br><br>To disable this feature, set the object field to `null`.<br>|
|» mm7_metadata|body|[MM7Metadata](#schemamm7metadata)|false|MM7 settings for inbound messages|
|» alpha_sender|body|string \| null|false|The alphanumeric sender ID to use when sending to destinations that require an alphanumeric sender ID.|
|» daily_spend_limit|body|string|false|The maximum amount of money (in USD) that can be spent by this profile before midnight UTC.|
|» daily_spend_limit_enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether to enforce the value configured by `daily_spend_limit`.|
|» mms_fall_back_to_sms|body|boolean|false|enables SMS fallback for MMS messages.|
|» mms_transcoding|body|boolean|false|enables automated resizing of MMS media.|
|» mobile_only|body|boolean|false|Send messages only to mobile phone numbers.|
|» smart_encoding|body|boolean|false|Enables automatic character encoding optimization for SMS messages. When enabled, the system automatically selects the most efficient encoding (GSM-7 or UCS-2) based on message content to maximize character limits and minimize costs.|
|» features|body|[MessagingProfileFeatures](#schemamessagingprofilefeatures)|false|Telnyx product features the messaging customer can enable on the messaging profile. Keys map to individual feature flags; unknown keys are accepted and preserved for forward compatibility with rolling deployments.|
|» ai_assistant_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of the AI assistant associated with this messaging profile.|
|» redaction_enabled|body|boolean|false|Set to true to enable message content redaction on this profile, or false to disable it. Ignored if the organization is not on the redaction allowlist. See the [Message Redaction guide](/docs/messaging/messages/message-redaction) for what is redacted.|
|» redaction_level|body|integer|false|The redaction level to apply when redaction is enabled. 1: redact message records and reporting only. 2 (default): also redact inbound webhook payloads. See the [Message Redaction guide](/docs/messaging/messages/message-redaction).|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-programmable-fax-applications">Programmable Fax Applications</h1>

Fax Applications operations

## List all Fax Applications

<a id="opIdListFaxApplications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/fax_applications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /fax_applications`

This endpoint returns a list of your Fax Applications inside the 'data' attribute of the response. You can adjust which applications are listed by using filters. Fax Applications are used to configure how you send and receive faxes using the Programmable Fax API with Telnyx.

<h3 id="list-all-fax-applications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[number], page[size]|
|filter|query|object|false|Consolidated filter parameter (deepObject style). Originally: filter[application_name][contains], filter[outbound_voice_profile_id]|
|sort|query|string|false|Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the <code> -</code> prefix.<br/><br/><br>That is: <ul><br>  <li><br>    <code>application_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>application_name</code> field in ascending order.<br>  </li><br><br>  <li><br>    <code>-application_name</code>: sorts the result by the<br>    <code>application_name</code> field in descending order.<br>  </li><br></ul> <br/> If not given, results are sorted by <code>created_at</code> in descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|created_at|
|sort|application_name|
|sort|active|

  "data": [
    {
      "id": "1293384261075731499",

      },

    }
  ],

## Creates a Fax Application

<a id="opIdCreateFaxApplication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/fax_applications \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "application_name": "fax-router",
    "active": false,
    "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25,
    "tags": [
      "tag1",
      "tag2"
    ],
    "inbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "sip_subdomain": "example",
      "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
    },
    "outbound": {
      "channel_limit": 10,
      "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /fax_applications`

Creates a new Fax Application based on the parameters sent in the request. The application name and webhook URL are required. Once created, you can assign phone numbers to your application using the `/phone_numbers` endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "application_name": "fax-router",
  "active": false,
  "anchorsite_override": "Amsterdam, Netherlands",
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25,
  "tags": [
    "tag1",
    "tag2"
  ],
  "inbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "sip_subdomain": "example",
    "sip_subdomain_receive_settings": "only_my_connections"
  },
  "outbound": {
    "channel_limit": 10,
    "outbound_voice_profile_id": "1293384261075731499"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-fax-application-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateFaxApplicationRequest](#schemacreatefaxapplicationrequest)|true|Parameters that can be set when creating a Fax Application|
|» application_name|body|[ApplicationName](#schemaapplicationname)|true|A user-assigned name to help manage the application.|
|» active|body|[ConnectionActive](#schemaconnectionactive)|false|Specifies whether the connection can be used.|
|» anchorsite_override|body|[AnchorsiteOverride](#schemaanchorsiteoverride)|false|`Latency` directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|[WebhookEventUrl](#schemawebhookeventurl)|true|The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|[WebhookEventFailoverUrl](#schemawebhookeventfailoverurl)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|[WebhookTimeoutSecs](#schemawebhooktimeoutsecs)|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the Fax Application.|
|» inbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » sip_subdomain|body|string|false|Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. TLS signaling is supported. SRTP media encryption requires TLS transport.|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|body|string|false|This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).|
|» outbound|body|object|false|none|
|» » channel_limit|body|integer|false|When set, this will limit the number of concurrent outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.|
|» » outbound_voice_profile_id|body|[OutboundVoiceProfileId](#schemaoutboundvoiceprofileid)|false|Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» anchorsite_override|Latency|
|» anchorsite_override|Chicago, IL|
|» anchorsite_override|Ashburn, VA|
|» anchorsite_override|San Jose, CA|
|» anchorsite_override|Sydney, Australia|
|» anchorsite_override|Amsterdam, Netherlands|
|» anchorsite_override|London, UK|
|» anchorsite_override|Toronto, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Vancouver, Canada|
|» anchorsite_override|Frankfurt, Germany|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|only_my_connections|
|» » sip_subdomain_receive_settings|from_anyone|

## Send a fax

<a id="opIdSendFax"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/faxes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "connection_id": "234423",
    "media_url": "https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf",
    "media_name": "my_media_uploaded_to_media_storage_api",
    "to": "+13127367276",
    "from": "+13125790015",
    "from_display_name": "Company Name",
    "quality": "high",
    "t38_enabled": true,
    "monochrome": false,
    "black_threshold": 95,
    "store_media": false,
    "store_preview": false,
    "preview_format": "tiff",
    "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
    "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d"
  }'
```

`POST /faxes`

Send a fax. Files have size limits and page count limit validations. If a file is bigger than 50MB or has more than 350 pages it will fail with `file_size_limit_exceeded` and `page_count_limit_exceeded` respectively.

**Supported file formats:**

- PDF (`application/pdf`)
- TIFF (`application/tiff`, `image/tiff`)
- JPEG (`image/jpeg`)
- PNG (`image/png`)
- Microsoft Word `.doc` (`application/msword`)
- Microsoft Word `.docx` (`application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`)
- Rich Text Format `.rtf` (`application/rtf`)
- Plain text `.txt` (`text/plain`)

**Expected Webhooks:**

- `fax.queued`
- `fax.media.processed`
- `fax.sending.started`
- `fax.delivered`
- `fax.failed`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connection_id": "234423",
  "media_url": "https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf",
  "media_name": "my_media_uploaded_to_media_storage_api",
  "to": "+13127367276",
  "from": "+13125790015",
  "from_display_name": "Company Name",
  "quality": "high",
  "t38_enabled": true,
  "monochrome": false,
  "black_threshold": 95,
  "store_media": false,
  "store_preview": false,
  "preview_format": "tiff",
  "webhook_url": "https://www.example.com/server-b/",
  "client_state": "aGF2ZSBhIG5pY2UgZGF5ID1d"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-fax-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SendFaxRequest](#schemasendfaxrequest)|true|Send fax request|
|» connection_id|body|string|true|The connection ID to send the fax with.|
|» media_url|body|[MediaUrl](#schemamediaurl)|false|The URL (or list of URLs) to the fax document. Supported formats: PDF, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, DOC, DOCX, RTF, and TXT. media_url and media_name/contents can't be submitted together.|
|» media_name|body|[MediaName](#schemamedianame)|false|The media_name used for the fax's media. Must point to a file previously uploaded to api.telnyx.com/v2/media by the same user/organization. Supported formats: PDF, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, DOC, DOCX, RTF, and TXT. media_name and media_url/contents can't be submitted together.|
|» to|body|[To](#schemato)|true|The phone number, in E.164 format, the fax will be sent to or SIP URI|
|» from|body|[From](#schemafrom)|true|The phone number, in E.164 format, the fax will be sent from.|
|» from_display_name|body|string|false|The `from_display_name` string to be used as the caller id name (SIP From Display Name) presented to the destination (`to` number). The string should have a maximum of 128 characters, containing only letters, numbers, spaces, and -_~!.+ special characters. If ommited, the display name will be the same as the number in the `from` field.|
|» quality|body|[Quality](#schemaquality)|false|The quality of the fax. The `ultra` settings provides the highest quality available, but also present longer fax processing times. `ultra_light` is best suited for images, wihle `ultra_dark` is best suited for text.|
|» t38_enabled|body|boolean|false|The flag to disable the T.38 protocol.|
|» monochrome|body|boolean|false|The flag to enable monochrome, true black and white fax results.|
|» black_threshold|body|integer|false|The black threshold percentage for monochrome faxes. Only applicable if `monochrome` is set to `true`.|
|» store_media|body|boolean|false|Should fax media be stored on temporary URL. It does not support media_name, they can't be submitted together.|
|» store_preview|body|boolean|false|Should fax preview be stored on temporary URL.|
|» preview_format|body|string|false|The format for the preview file in case the `store_preview` is `true`.|
|» webhook_url|body|string|false|Use this field to override the URL to which Telnyx will send subsequent webhooks for this fax.|
|» client_state|body|string|false|Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. It must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» quality|normal|
|» quality|high|
|» quality|very_high|
|» quality|ultra_light|
|» quality|ultra_dark|
|» preview_format|pdf|
|» preview_format|tiff|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json

    "record_type": "fax",

<h1 id="telnyx-api-pronunciation-dictionaries">Pronunciation Dictionaries</h1>

Manage pronunciation dictionaries for text-to-speech synthesis. Dictionaries contain alias items (text replacement) and phoneme items (IPA pronunciation notation) that control how specific words are spoken.

## List pronunciation dictionaries

<a id="opIdListPronunciationDicts"></a>

List all pronunciation dictionaries for the authenticated organization. Results are paginated using offset-based pagination.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|Page number (1-based). Defaults to 1.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 250.|

## Create a pronunciation dictionary

<a id="opIdCreatePronunciationDict"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/pronunciation_dicts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Brand Names",
    "items": [
      {
        "text": "Telnyx",
        "type": "alias",
        "alias": "tel-nicks"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /pronunciation_dicts`

Create a new pronunciation dictionary for the authenticated organization. Each dictionary contains a list of items that control how specific words are spoken. Items can be alias type (text replacement) or phoneme type (IPA pronunciation notation).

As an alternative to providing items directly as JSON, you can upload a dictionary file (PLS/XML or plain text format, max 1MB) using multipart/form-data. PLS files use the standard W3C Pronunciation Lexicon Specification XML format. Text files use a line-based format: `word=alias` for aliases, `word:/phoneme/` for IPA phonemes.

Limits:
- Maximum 50 dictionaries per organization
- Maximum 100 items per dictionary
- Text: max 200 characters
- Alias/phoneme value: max 500 characters
- File upload: max 1MB (1,048,576 bytes)

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Brand Names",
  "items": [
    {
      "text": "Telnyx",
      "type": "alias",
      "alias": "tel-nicks"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-pronunciation-dictionary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreatePronunciationDictRequest](#schemacreatepronunciationdictrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Human-readable name. Must be unique within the organization.|
|» items|body|[[PronunciationDictItem](#schemapronunciationdictitem)]|true|List of pronunciation items (alias or phoneme type). At least one item is required.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "record_type": "pronunciation_dict",
    "id": "c215a3e1-be41-4701-97e8-1d3c22f9a5b7",
    "name": "Brand Names",
    "items": [
      {
        "text": "Telnyx",
        "type": "alias",
        "alias": "tel-nicks"
      }
    ],
    "version": 1,
    "created_at": "2026-03-25T12:00:00.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-03-25T12:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "90202",
      "title": "Validation failed",
      "detail": "items must have at least one item",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/items"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-pronunciation-dictionary-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

`PATCH /pronunciation_dicts/{id}`

Update the name and/or items of an existing pronunciation dictionary. Uses optimistic locking — if the dictionary was modified concurrently, the request returns 409 Conflict.

  "name": "Updated Brand Names",

      "type": "alias",
      "alias": "tel-nicks"

  ]
}

## Retrieve calls from a queue

<a id="opIdListQueueCalls"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/queues/string/calls \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /queues/{queue_name}/calls`

Retrieve the list of calls in an existing queue

<h3 id="retrieve-calls-from-a-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|queue_name|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the queue by name|
|page|query|object|false|Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[after], page[before], page[limit], page[size], page[number]|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "call_control_id": "v3:MdI91X4lWFEs7IgbBEOT9M4AigoY08M0WWZFISt1Yw2axZ_IiE4pqg",
      "call_leg_id": "2dc6fc34-f9e0-11ea-b68e-02420a0f7768",
      "call_session_id": "2dc1b3c8-f9e0-11ea-bc5a-02420a0f7768",
      "record_type": "queue_call",
      "connection_id": "7267xxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      "from": "+18005550101",
      "to": "+18005550102",
      "enqueued_at": "2019-01-23T18:10:02.574Z",
      "wait_time_secs": 145,
      "queue_position": 3,
      "queue_id": "ae1626cc-6f42-11ea-becd-02420a0f8b69",
      "is_alive": true
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total_pages": 3,
    "total_results": 55,
    "page_number": 2,
    "page_size": 25
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Resource not found",
      "detail": "Resource not found"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-calls-from-a-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response with a list of calls in a queue.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Resource not found. The requested resource does not exist. Common causes include: invalid call_control_id, conference not found, audio file not found, or recording not found.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

<h3 id="retrieve-calls-from-a-queue-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[QueueCall](#schemaqueuecall)]|false|none|none|
|meta|[PaginationMeta](#schemapaginationmeta)|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Force remove a call from a queue

<a id="opIdRemoveQueueCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/queues/string/calls/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /queues/{queue_name}/calls/{call_control_id}`

Removes an inactive call from a queue. If the call is no longer active, use this command to remove it from the queue.

<h3 id="force-remove-a-call-from-a-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|queue_name|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the queue by name|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Resource not found",
      "detail": "Resource not found"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="force-remove-a-call-from-a-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Call successfully removed from the queue|None|
|404|Not Found|Resource not found. The requested resource does not exist. Common causes include: invalid call_control_id, conference not found, audio file not found, or recording not found.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Update queued call

<a id="opIdUpdateCallInQueue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/queues/string/calls/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "keep_after_hangup": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /queues/{queue_name}/calls/{call_control_id}`

Update queued call's keep_after_hangup flag

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "keep_after_hangup": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-queued-call-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|queue_name|path|string|true|Uniquely identifies the queue by name|
|call_control_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier and token for controlling the call|
|body|body|[UpdateQueuedCallRequest](#schemaupdatequeuedcallrequest)|true|Update queued call request.|
|» keep_after_hangup|body|boolean|false|Whether the call should remain in queue after hangup.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10007",
      "title": "Resource not found",
      "detail": "Resource not found"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-queued-call-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Call has been successfully updated.|None|
|404|Not Found|Resource not found. The requested resource does not exist. Common causes include: invalid call_control_id, conference not found, audio file not found, or recording not found.|[call-control_Errors](#schemacall-control_errors)|

<h3 id="send-an-rcs-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Optional opaque, unquoted key for safely retrying the same logical request. Keys must contain 1 to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. Generate a unique UUID v4 for each operation and reuse it only when retrying that operation with the same request. Invalid headers—including duplicate, empty, malformed, or overlong values—return 400 with error code 10015. A request already in progress with the same key returns 409; reusing the key with a different request returns 422. Only successful responses are replayed, for up to 24 hours. Do not include sensitive data in the key.|
|body|body|[RCSMessage](#schemarcsmessage)|true|RCS message body|
|» agent_id|body|string|true|RCS Agent ID|
|» to|body|string|true|Phone number in +E.164 format|
|» messaging_profile_id|body|string|true|A valid messaging profile ID|
|» type|body|string|false|Message type - must be set to "RCS"|
|» webhook_url|body|string(url)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this message will be sent.|
|» agent_message|body|[RCSAgentMessage](#schemarcsagentmessage)|true|none|
|» sms_fallback|body|[SMSFallback](#schemasmsfallback)|false|none|
|» mms_fallback|body|[MMSFallback](#schemammsfallback)|false|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|RCS|

      }

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10016",
      "title": "Service Unavailable",
      "detail": "Edge idempotency protection is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later."
    }
  ]
}

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "title": "string",
      "detail": "string",
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/data/attributes/phone_number",
        "parameter": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="send-an-rcs-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful operation|[RCSResponse](#schemarcsresponse)|
|409|Conflict|A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed (10036). Retry later with the same key and request.|[messaging_Errors_0b38e7044b](#schemamessaging_errors_0b38e7044b)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Payload Too Large. A request sent with an Idempotency-Key whose body exceeds the endpoint's Edge replay-protection limit (256 KB) is rejected before it reaches the service (code 10007). Requests sent without the header are not subject to this limit.|[messaging_Errors_0b38e7044b](#schemamessaging_errors_0b38e7044b)|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service unavailable (10016), including unavailable Edge idempotency protection for a keyed request. Retry with the same key.|[messaging_Errors_0b38e7044b](#schemamessaging_errors_0b38e7044b)|
|4XX|Client Error|Unexpected error|[messaging_Errors_0b38e7044b](#schemamessaging_errors_0b38e7044b)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Idempotent-Replayed|boolean||Present with value `true` when Edge replayed a stored successful response for the supplied Idempotency-Key. Omitted for first-time requests and error responses.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/rcs/agents \
  -X POST \

  -d '{
    "brand_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",

    "configuration": {
      "basics": {
        "description": "Order confirmations and delivery updates",
        "logo_url": "https://www.example.com/rcs/logo.png",

        "terms_and_conditions_url": "https://www.example.com/terms",

          "label": "Support"
        }
      }

```

`POST /rcs/agents`

Creates an editable RCS agent draft under a brand. The `Idempotency-Key` is scoped to the authenticated organization. Reusing the key with the same request returns the original agent, while reusing it with a different request returns a conflict.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "brand_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "display_name": "Acme Order Updates",
  "use_case": "TRANSACTIONAL",
  "configuration": {
    "basics": {
      "description": "Order confirmations and delivery updates",
      "logo_url": "https://www.example.com/rcs/logo.png",
      "hero_url": "https://www.example.com/rcs/hero.png",
      "brand_color": "#123456",
      "privacy_policy_url": "https://www.example.com/privacy",
      "terms_and_conditions_url": "https://www.example.com/terms",
      "email": {
        "address": "support@example.com",
        "label": "Support"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-rcs-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|true|A caller-generated key containing letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Reuse the same key and request body when retrying the same logical agent creation.|
|body|body|[AgentCreateRequest](#schemaagentcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» brand_id|body|string(uuid)|true|none|
|» display_name|body|string|true|none|
|» use_case|body|[AgentUseCase](#schemaagentusecase)|true|none|
|» profile_id|body|string \| null|false|A Messaging Profile owned by the authenticated organization. When omitted, the agent inherits the brand profile.|
|» hosting_region|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» configuration|body|[AgentConfiguration](#schemaagentconfiguration)|true|none|

|» use_case|PROMOTIONAL|

<h1 id="telnyx-api-reference-data">Reference Data</h1>

Static reference values the API accepts: call reasons, document types, rejection types.

## List standard call reasons

<a id="opIdlistCallReasons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/call_reasons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /call_reasons`

Telnyx maintains a library of pre-vetted call-reason phrases (e.g. "Appointment reminders", "Billing inquiries") that carry through DIR vetting smoothly. You can use any string that fits your use case in `DirCreateRequest.call_reasons`, but matching one of these reduces the chance the vetting team flags the phrasing for clarification.

<h3 id="list-standard-call-reasons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|1-based page number. Out-of-range values return an empty page with correct meta.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Items per page. Default `100` for this endpoint (the call-reason library is small and most callers want the whole list in one call). Maximum 250; values above are clamped to 250.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "d29914a4-3c93-440c-af72-03778f442522",
      "reason": "Account Alert",
      "description": "Alert about account status or changes"
    },
    {
      "id": "4cabcae2-6c61-415b-ac5b-753469458a56",
      "reason": "Account Notification",
      "description": "General account notifications"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page_number": 1,
    "page_size": 2,
    "total_results": 45,
    "total_pages": 23
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10005",
      "title": "Invalid parameters",
      "detail": "field required",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10005"
      },
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/body/legal_name"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10005",
      "title": "Invalid parameters",
      "detail": "field required",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10005"
      },
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/body/legal_name"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-standard-call-reasons-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Paginated list of standard call reasons.|[CallReasonReferenceList](#schemacallreasonreferencelist)|
|default|Default|An error occurred. The response carries the standard Telnyx error envelope.|[branded-calling_Errors](#schemabranded-calling_errors)|
|4XX|Client Error|An error occurred. The response carries the standard Telnyx error envelope.|[branded-calling_Errors](#schemabranded-calling_errors)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Validate a list of call reasons

<a id="opIdvalidateCallReasons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/call_reasons/validate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '[
    "Appointment reminders",
    "Billing inquiries"
  ]'
```

`POST /call_reasons/validate`

Check up to 10 candidate `call_reasons` strings against Telnyx's vetting heuristics before sending them on a DIR create or update. The endpoint flags strings that are likely to be rejected during vetting (too generic, banned phrases, length issues, etc.) so you can fix them up front.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  "Appointment reminders",
  "Billing inquiries"
]
```

<h3 id="validate-a-list-of-call-reasons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ValidateCallReasonsRequest](#schemavalidatecallreasonsrequest)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "all_pre_approved": false,
    "non_approved_reasons": [
      "Appointment reminders",
      "Billing inquiries"
    ],
    "requires_manual_vetting": true
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10005",
      "title": "Invalid parameters",
      "detail": "field required",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10005"
      },
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/body/legal_name"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 4XX Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10005",
      "title": "Invalid parameters",
      "detail": "field required",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10005"
      },
      "source": {
        "pointer": "/body/legal_name"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="validate-a-list-of-call-reasons-responses">Responses</h3>

|default|Default|An error occurred. The response carries the standard Telnyx error envelope.|[branded-calling_Errors](#schemabranded-calling_errors)|
|4XX|Client Error|An error occurred. The response carries the standard Telnyx error envelope.|[branded-calling_Errors](#schemabranded-calling_errors)|

`GET /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation`

Phone Number Reputation tracks how your outbound caller-IDs are perceived (spam risk, engagement, etc.) across the call-screening ecosystem. This endpoint reads the enterprise-level settings: whether the product is enabled, the refresh cadence, and the stored Letter of Authorization document id.

Returns `404` if reputation has never been enabled for this enterprise.

## Enable phone-number reputation for an enterprise

<a id="opIdenableReputationSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "loa_document_id": "2a7e8337-e803-4057-a4ae-26c40eb0bc6c",
    "check_frequency": "business_daily"
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation`

Activate Phone Number Reputation for the given enterprise. Requires an uploaded Letter of Authorization document (the `loa_document_id` references the Telnyx Documents API) and a refresh-frequency selection. After activation, individual phone numbers can be registered via `POST .../reputation/numbers`.

**Prerequisite**: the calling user must have agreed to the Phone Number Reputation Terms of Service (`POST /terms_of_service/number_reputation/agree`).

Failure modes:
- `403` - Phone Number Reputation Terms of Service not accepted.
- `404` - enterprise does not exist or does not belong to your account.
- `400` - reputation already enabled for this enterprise.
- `422` - `loa_document_id` missing or `check_frequency` invalid.

**Pricing:** This is a billable action. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "loa_document_id": "2a7e8337-e803-4057-a4ae-26c40eb0bc6c",
  "check_frequency": "business_daily"
}
```

<h3 id="enable-phone-number-reputation-for-an-enterprise-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[EnterpriseReputationCreate](#schemaenterprisereputationcreate)|true|none|
|» loa_document_id|body|string|true|Id of the signed Letter of Authorization document, returned by the Telnyx Documents API after upload (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).|
|» check_frequency|body|object|false|Refresh cadence. Defaults to `business_daily` if omitted.|

## Submit ownership proof for numbers hosted elsewhere

<a id="opIdsubmitReputationExternalVerification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/external_verification \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "document_ids": [
      "2a7e8337-e803-4057-a4ae-26c40eb0bc6c"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/external_verification`

Request permission to add phone numbers that the enterprise owns but that are hosted with another provider. Submit one or more uploaded documents proving ownership, such as a carrier invoice or account statement. The request is reviewed once per enterprise. While it is `pending` or `rejected` you can submit again to replace the documents; once `approved` it cannot be changed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "document_ids": [
    "2a7e8337-e803-4057-a4ae-26c40eb0bc6c"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="submit-ownership-proof-for-numbers-hosted-elsewhere-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[ExternalVerificationSubmit](#schemaexternalverificationsubmit)|true|none|
|» document_ids|body|[string]|true|Ids of uploaded documents (Documents API) proving the enterprise owns its phone numbers hosted with another provider, for example a carrier invoice or account statement.|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|false|Optional. The phone numbers hosted with another provider that the documents cover, in E.164 format. Shown to the reviewer to match the documents to your numbers; you can still add numbers that are not listed here, and each is checked on its own.|

## Change the reputation refresh frequency

<a id="opIdupdateReputationFrequency"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/frequency \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "check_frequency": "weekly"
  }'
```

`PATCH /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/frequency`

Update how often Telnyx refreshes the reputation data for this enterprise's registered numbers. The new frequency takes effect on the next scheduled refresh.

The enterprise's reputation must be in `approved` status. A request made while the status is `pending` is rejected with `400 Bad Request`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "check_frequency": "weekly"
}
```

<h3 id="change-the-reputation-refresh-frequency-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[EnterpriseReputationUpdateFrequency](#schemaenterprisereputationupdatefrequency)|true|none|
|» check_frequency|body|[ReputationCheckFrequency](#schemareputationcheckfrequency)|true|How often Telnyx refreshes the stored reputation data for this enterprise's registered numbers.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» check_frequency|business_daily|
|» check_frequency|daily|
|» check_frequency|weekly|
|» check_frequency|biweekly|
|» check_frequency|monthly|
|» check_frequency|never|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "enterprise_id": "4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6",
    "status": "pending",
    "check_frequency": "business_daily",
    "loa_document_id": "2a7e8337-e803-4057-a4ae-26c40eb0bc6c",
    "loa_status": "pending",
    "rejection_reasons": [
      "string"
    ],

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/loa`

Render the LOA for this enterprise as a PDF. The enterprise identity, address, and authorized-representative contact are taken from the enterprise record; the optional `agent` block is supplied only when a third-party partner manages the numbers. The response is the PDF itself (unsigned unless a `signature` is provided). Sign it and upload it to the Telnyx Documents API (`POST /v2/documents`, see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents) to obtain the `loa_document_id` required by `POST .../reputation`.

{}

|» agent|body|[number-reputation_AgentInput](#schemanumber-reputation_agentinput)|false|Third-party reseller / partner managing the enterprise's phone numbers. Omit when the enterprise works directly with Telnyx.|

## List reputation-monitored phone numbers for an enterprise

<a id="opIdlistReputationNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/numbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers`

Paginated list of phone numbers registered for reputation monitoring under this enterprise. The response includes the latest reputation snapshot per number where one has been collected.

<h3 id="list-reputation-monitored-phone-numbers-for-an-enterprise-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|1-based page number. Out-of-range values return an empty page with correct meta.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Items per page. Default 10. Maximum 250; values above are clamped to 250.|
|filter[phone_number][contains]|query|string|false|Partial match on phone number. Must contain at least 5 digits.|
|filter[phone_number][eq]|query|string|false|Exact phone-number match (E.164).|
|filter[source]|query|[ReputationNumberSource](#schemareputationnumbersource)|false|Only numbers with this source.|
|filter[ownership_status]|query|[ReputationOwnershipStatus](#schemareputationownershipstatus)|false|Only numbers with this ownership status. `removed` lists the numbers that were removed, each with its `removal_reason` and `removed_at`; removed numbers are not returned otherwise.|

|filter[source]|external|

## Register phone numbers for reputation monitoring

<a id="opIdassociateReputationNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/numbers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "phone_numbers": [
      "+19493253498",
      "+12134445566"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers`

Add up to 100 phone numbers to reputation monitoring on this enterprise. Each must be in E.164 format (`+1NPANXXXXXX` for US/CA). A number in your Telnyx phone-number inventory is accepted as `source: telnyx`; a number that is not is treated as hosted with another provider and must meet the requirements below.

**Prerequisite**: reputation must already be enabled on this enterprise (see `POST .../reputation`).

**Pricing:** This is a billable action. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.

A phone number that is not in your Telnyx inventory is treated as a number hosted with another provider (`source: external`). It must be a US local number, and the enterprise's ownership proof must be approved first (`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/external_verification`); otherwise the request fails with a 400 whose `detail` contains `external_verification_required`. Ownership of such numbers is checked every day.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phone_numbers": [
    "+19493253498",
    "+12134445566"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="register-phone-numbers-for-reputation-monitoring-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[ReputationPhoneNumberCreate](#schemareputationphonenumbercreate)|true|none|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|true|1–100 phone numbers in E.164 format with a leading `+`.|

## Force a reputation refresh

<a id="opIdrefreshReputationNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/numbers/refresh \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "phone_numbers": [
      "+19493253498"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers/refresh`

Immediately refresh the stored reputation data for the listed numbers. This is in addition to the periodic refresh determined by `check_frequency`. Up to 100 numbers per call. The response carries the kicked-off jobs; the actual refresh runs asynchronously.

**Pricing:** Forcing a refresh performs live reputation lookups, which are billable. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phone_numbers": [
    "+19493253498"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="force-a-reputation-refresh-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[RefreshReputationRequest](#schemarefreshreputationrequest)|true|none|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|true|Phone numbers to refresh reputation data for. 1–100 numbers per request, each in E.164 format. Reputation refreshes are subject to per-enterprise rate limits.|

  "data": {

## Get a single reputation-monitored phone number

<a id="opIdgetPhoneNumberReputation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/numbers/%2B19493253498 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers/{phone_number}`

Retrieve one registered number with its latest reputation snapshot. The `phone_number` path parameter is in E.164 format and must be URL-encoded (e.g. `%2B19493253498`).

<h3 id="get-a-single-reputation-monitored-phone-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|phone_number|path|string|true|Phone number in E.164 format (`+1NPANXXXXXX` for US/CA). The leading `+` MUST be URL-encoded as `%2B` (e.g. `%2B19493253498`).|
|fresh|query|boolean|false|When true, fetches fresh reputation data (incurs API cost). When false (default), returns cached data.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

## Confirm or give up ownership of a phone number

<a id="opIdconfirmReputationNumberOwnership"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/numbers/%2B19493253498/ownership_confirm \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "still_own": true
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers/{phone_number}/ownership_confirm`

Answer an ownership question about a phone number hosted with another provider.

Send `still_own: true` to confirm you still own a number whose `ownership_status` is `pending_confirmation` or `flagged`; its status returns to `verified` and, after a carrier change, the new carrier becomes the one on record.

Send `still_own: false` to report that you no longer own the number. It is removed from Number Reputation immediately, whatever its current status, and the response shows it with `ownership_status: removed`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "still_own": true
}
```

<h3 id="confirm-or-give-up-ownership-of-a-phone-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|phone_number|path|string|true|Phone number in E.164 format (`+1NPANXXXXXX` for US/CA). The leading `+` MUST be URL-encoded as `%2B` (e.g. `%2B19493253498`).|
|body|body|[OwnershipConfirmRequest](#schemaownershipconfirmrequest)|true|none|
|» still_own|body|boolean|true|`true` confirms you still own the number. `false` reports that you no longer own it and removes it from Number Reputation.|
|» evidence_document_id|body|string|false|Optional id of an uploaded document supporting the confirmation.|

```

`GET /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/remediation`

Paginated list of remediation requests for this enterprise. List items omit per-number results and webhook URLs to keep the response small; call GET by id for full detail. Supports JSON:API pagination and optional filters on status and created-at range.

<h3 id="list-reputation-remediation-requests-for-an-enterprise-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|1-based page number. Out-of-range values return an empty page with correct meta.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Items per page. Maximum 250; values above are clamped to 250.|
|filter[status]|query|[RemediationStatus](#schemaremediationstatus)|false|Filter by customer-facing status.|
|filter[created_at][gte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only requests created on or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).|
|filter[created_at][lte]|query|string(date-time)|false|Only requests created on or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|filter[status]|in_progress|
|filter[status]|completed|
|filter[status]|failed|
|filter[status]|cancelled|

## Submit phone numbers for reputation remediation

<a id="opIdsubmitReputationRemediation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/remediation \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "phone_numbers": [
      "+19493253498",
      "+12134445566"
    ],
    "call_purpose": "Appointment reminders for our dental clinic.",
    "contact_email": "ops@example.com",
    "webhook_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/remediation"
  }'
```

`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/remediation`

Submit a batch of phone numbers belonging to this enterprise for reputation remediation. The request is accepted asynchronously: this endpoint returns `202` with the persisted request id, then the request transitions through processing states until completion. Use the GET endpoints to poll status and per-number results.

Each phone number must be in E.164 format and belong to this enterprise. A number that already has an in-flight remediation request is rejected.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phone_numbers": [
    "+19493253498",
    "+12134445566"
  ],
  "call_purpose": "Appointment reminders for our dental clinic.",
  "contact_email": "ops@example.com",
  "webhook_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/remediation"
}
```

<h3 id="submit-phone-numbers-for-reputation-remediation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[RemediationRequestCreate](#schemaremediationrequestcreate)|true|none|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|true|Phone numbers in E.164 format. Each must belong to this enterprise. Maximum 2,000 per request.|
|» call_purpose|body|string|true|How the numbers are used (free text).|
|» contact_email|body|string(email)|false|Optional contact email for this remediation request.|
|» webhook_url|body|string(uri)|false|Optional https:// URL for status notifications.|

## Set the number-ownership webhook URL

<a id="opIdupdateReputationWebhook"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/enterprises/4a6192a4-573d-446d-b3ce-aff9117272a6/reputation/webhook \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "webhook_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/telnyx"
  }'
```

`PATCH /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/webhook`

Set the HTTPS URL that receives number-ownership events for this enterprise: `number_reputation.number.flagged`, `number_reputation.number.removed` and `number_reputation.external_verification.status_changed`. Send `webhook_url: null` to stop receiving them.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "webhook_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/telnyx"
}
```

<h3 id="set-the-number-ownership-webhook-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enterprise_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The enterprise id. Lowercase UUID.|
|body|body|[EnterpriseReputationWebhookUpdate](#schemaenterprisereputationwebhookupdate)|true|none|
|» webhook_url|body|string \| null(uri)|true|HTTPS URL on a publicly routable host. Send `null` to stop receiving number-ownership events.|

## List reputation-monitored phone numbers across all enterprises

<a id="opIdlistReputationNumbersSimplified"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/reputation/numbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /reputation/numbers`

Convenience alias for `GET /v2/enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/numbers` that returns numbers across every enterprise you own. Useful when you don't want to look up the enterprise id first.

<h3 id="list-reputation-monitored-phone-numbers-across-all-enterprises-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page[number]|query|integer|false|1-based page number. Out-of-range values return an empty page with correct meta.|
|page[size]|query|integer|false|Items per page. Maximum 250; values above are clamped to 250.|
|filter[phone_number][contains]|query|string|false|Partial match on phone number. Must contain at least 5 digits.|
|filter[enterprise_id]|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by enterprise ID.|
|filter[phone_number][eq]|query|string|false|Exact phone-number match (E.164).|
|filter[source]|query|[ReputationNumberSource](#schemareputationnumbersource)|false|Only numbers with this source.|
|filter[ownership_status]|query|[ReputationOwnershipStatus](#schemareputationownershipstatus)|false|Only numbers with this ownership status. `removed` lists the numbers that were removed, each with its `removal_reason` and `removed_at`; removed numbers are not returned otherwise.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter[source]|telnyx|
|filter[source]|external|
|filter[ownership_status]|verified|
|filter[ownership_status]|flagged|
|filter[ownership_status]|pending_confirmation|
|filter[ownership_status]|removed|

## Get action requirement details for a sub number order

<a id="opIdgetExternalRequirement"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/external_requirements/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/sub_number_orders/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /external_requirements/{regulatory_requirement_id}/sub_number_orders/{sub_number_order_id}`

Returns the input fields an action requirement needs and the current requirement action for a sub number order. Action requirements are fulfilled by an external step rather than by uploading documents. Australia mobile ID verification is currently the only action requirement. Once a verification link has been generated, it is returned in `requirement_action.value`.

<h3 id="get-action-requirement-details-for-a-sub-number-order-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|regulatory_requirement_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The ID of the regulatory (action) requirement. For Australia mobile ID verification this is `b7c72fb8-fa08-4529-aaf6-b9117d3f3698`.|
|sub_number_order_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The ID of the sub number order the requirement belongs to.|

## Fulfill an action requirement for a sub number order

<a id="opIdcreateExternalRequirement"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/external_requirements/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/sub_number_orders/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "requirement": {
      "first_name": "Jane",
      "last_name": "Doe"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /external_requirements/{regulatory_requirement_id}/sub_number_orders/{sub_number_order_id}`

Submits the end user's details to the external verification provider and returns the requirement action. Australia mobile ID verification is currently the only action requirement. It generates a unique Onfido verification link, returned in `requirement_action.value`, which you share with the end user. The end user's `first_name` and `last_name` must be nested inside a `requirement` object; sending them at the top level is rejected.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "requirement": {
    "first_name": "Jane",
    "last_name": "Doe"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="fulfill-an-action-requirement-for-a-sub-number-order-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|regulatory_requirement_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The ID of the regulatory (action) requirement. For Australia mobile ID verification this is `b7c72fb8-fa08-4529-aaf6-b9117d3f3698`.|
|sub_number_order_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The ID of the sub number order the requirement belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» requirement|body|object|true|The end user's identity details for the action requirement. Australia mobile ID verification is currently the only action requirement. It requires `first_name` and `last_name`, the same fields the corresponding GET lists in `fields_required`.|
|» » first_name|body|string|true|The end user's first name.|
|» » last_name|body|string|true|The end user's last name.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "sub_order_id": "5f8e6b1a-2d3c-4e5f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b",
    "regulatory_requirement_id": "a5b8f1d2-3c4e-4f6a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c",
    "requirement_action": {
      "type": "id_verification",
      "value": "https://verify.onfido.com/v/8f3c2a1b-9d4e-4f6a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c"
    }
  }
}
```

}

## Schedule a future requirement version

<a id="opIdCreateRequirementVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/requirements/a9dad8d5-fdbd-49d7-aa23-39bb08a5ebaa/versions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "effective_start_at": "2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "requirement_type_ids": [
      "a38c217a-8019-48f8-bff6-0fdd9939075b"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /requirements/{id}/versions`

Create a new pending version of a requirement with a future effective start date. Only one pending version may exist per requirement at a time.

> Body parameter

```json

<h1 id="telnyx-api-research">Research</h1>

Deep research with citations and async task polling.

## Start research task

<a id="opIdCreateWebSearchResearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/web_search/research \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "query": "Compare the performance of RAG vs fine-tuning for domain-specific QA",
    "research_effort": "standard",
    "max_sources": 20,
    "background": false
  }'
```

`POST /web_search/research`

Starts a deep research task that runs multiple searches, reads sources, and synthesizes an answer with citations.

## Synchronous mode (default)

When `background` is `false` or omitted, the request blocks until the research completes and returns the answer with citations. This can take up to 120 seconds depending on `research_effort`.

## Asynchronous mode

When `background` is `true`, the request returns immediately with a `task_id` and `status: pending`. Poll `GET /web_search/research/{task_id}` to check when the research completes and retrieve the answer.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "query": "Compare the performance of RAG vs fine-tuning for domain-specific QA",
  "research_effort": "standard",
  "max_sources": 20,
  "background": false
}
```

<h3 id="start-research-task-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ResearchRequest](#schemaresearchrequest)|true|none|
|» query|body|string|true|The research question or topic.|
|» research_effort|body|string|false|Research depth level. `lite` is fastest, `deep` is most thorough.|
|» max_sources|body|integer|false|Maximum number of sources to use.|
|» background|body|boolean|false|When `true`, the research runs asynchronously. The response returns a `task_id` immediately instead of waiting for the result. Poll `GET /web_search/research/{task_id}` to check status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» research_effort|lite|
|» research_effort|standard|
|» research_effort|deep|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "answer": "RAG and fine-tuning serve different purposes...",
    "citations": [
      {
        "url": "https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15884",
        "title": "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks",
        "snippet": "We show that RAG models produce more factually grounded responses..."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Validation error",
    "details": {}
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "10009",
      "title": "Authentication failed",
      "detail": "Could not find any usable credentials in the request.",
      "meta": {
        "url": "https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/overview/errors/10009"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Internal server error"
  }
}
```

> 502 Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Provider request failed"
  }
}
```

> 504 Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Provider request timed out"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="start-research-task-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Research response. Shape depends on `background`:<br><br>- **Synchronous** (`background` false/unset): returns `answer` + `citations`.<br>- **Asynchronous** (`background` true): returns `task_id` + `status`.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request — validation error or invalid parameters.|[WebSearchError](#schemawebsearcherror)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key.<br><br>The API Gateway returns this response before the request reaches the backend service. The error format follows the standard Telnyx JSON:API error envelope with `errors[]`, not the backend-level `WebSearchError` shape.|[web-search_GatewayError](#schemaweb-search_gatewayerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error.|[WebSearchError](#schemawebsearcherror)|
|502|Bad Gateway|The upstream search provider returned an error.|[WebSearchError](#schemawebsearcherror)|
|504|Gateway Timeout|The upstream search provider timed out.|[WebSearchError](#schemawebsearcherror)|

<h3 id="start-research-task-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[ResearchResponseSync](#schemaresearchresponsesync) \| [ResearchResponseAsync](#schemaresearchresponseasync)|false|none|none|
|» *oneOf*|[ResearchResponseSync](#schemaresearchresponsesync)|false|none|Synchronous research response (when `background` is false or unset).|
|» *oneOf*|[ResearchResponseAsync](#schemaresearchresponseasync)|false|none|Asynchronous research response (when `background` is true).|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Get research task status

<a id="opIdGetWebSearchResearchStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/web_search/research/bf3026a5-dd57-44dd-b922-200041be3a4b \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /web_search/research/{task_id}`

Polls the status of a previously started asynchronous research task. When the status is `completed`, the response includes the answer and citations. When the status is `failed`, the response includes an error message.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

  "data": {
    "task_id": "bf3026a5-dd57-44dd-b922-200041be3a4b",

    "citations": [
      {
        "url": "https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15884",
        "title": "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks"
      }
    ]

}

  "error": {

The error format follows the standard Telnyx JSON:API error envelope with `errors[]`, not the backend-level `WebSearchError` shape.|[web-search_GatewayError](#schemaweb-search_gatewayerror)|

<h3 id="create-a-room-composition-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[VideoRegion](#schemavideoregion)|false|none|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(uri)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this room composition will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(uri)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this room composition will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

## Create a room.

<a id="opIdCreateRoom"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/rooms \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "unique_name": "My room",
    "max_participants": 10,
    "enable_recording": true,
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

`POST /rooms`

Synchronously creates a new video room with the provided configuration and returns the created room.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "unique_name": "My room",
  "max_participants": 10,
  "enable_recording": true,
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateRoomRequest](#schemacreateroomrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during room creation.|
|» unique_name|body|string|false|The unique (within the Telnyx account scope) name of the room.|
|» max_participants|body|integer|false|The maximum amount of participants allowed in a room. If new participants try to join after that limit is reached, their request will be rejected.|
|» enable_recording|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable recording for that room.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(uri)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(uri)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

  "data": {
    "id": "7b61621f-62e0-4aad-ab11-9fd19e272e73",

## Update a room.

<a id="opIdUpdateRoom"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/rooms/0ccc7b54-4df3-4bca-a65a-3da1ecc777f0 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "unique_name": "My room",
    "max_participants": 10,
    "enable_recording": true,
    "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
    "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
    "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
  }'
```

`PATCH /rooms/{room_id}`

Synchronously updates the specified video room's configuration and returns the updated room.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "unique_name": "My room",
  "max_participants": 10,
  "enable_recording": true,
  "webhook_event_url": "https://example.com",
  "webhook_event_failover_url": "https://failover.example.com",
  "webhook_timeout_secs": 25
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|room_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a room.|
|body|body|[PatchRoomRequest](#schemapatchroomrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during room update.|
|» unique_name|body|string|false|The unique (within the Telnyx account scope) name of the room.|
|» max_participants|body|integer|false|The maximum amount of participants allowed in a room. If new participants try to join after that limit is reached, their request will be rejected.|
|» enable_recording|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable recording for that room.|
|» webhook_event_url|body|string(uri)|false|The URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_event_failover_url|body|string(uri)|false|The failover URL where webhooks related to this room will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as 'https'.|
|» webhook_timeout_secs|body|integer|false|Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a webhook.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "7b61621f-62e0-4aad-ab11-9fd19e272e73",

        "active": true,
        "created_at": "2021-04-16T09:46:20.954863Z",
        "updated_at": "2021-04-16T10:24:55.962200Z",
        "participants": [],
        "record_type": "room_session"
      }
    ],

}

<h1 id="telnyx-api-rooms-client-tokens">Rooms Client Tokens</h1>

Rooms Client Tokens operations.

## Create Client Token to join a room.

<a id="opIdCreateRoomClientToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.telnyx.com/v2/rooms/0ccc7b54-4df3-4bca-a65a-3da1ecc777f0/actions/generate_join_client_token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "token_ttl_secs": 600,
    "refresh_token_ttl_secs": 3600
  }'
```

`POST /rooms/{room_id}/actions/generate_join_client_token`

Synchronously create an Client Token to join a Room. Client Token is necessary to join a Telnyx Room. Client Token will expire after `token_ttl_secs`, a Refresh Token is also provided to refresh a Client Token, the Refresh Token expires after `refresh_token_ttl_secs`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token_ttl_secs": 600,
  "refresh_token_ttl_secs": 3600
}
```

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|room_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a room.|
|body|body|[CreateRoomClientTokenRequest](#schemacreateroomclienttokenrequest)|true|Parameters that can be defined during Room Client Token creation.|
|» token_ttl_secs|body|integer|false|The time to live in seconds of the Client Token, after that time the Client Token is invalid and can't be used to join a Room.|
|» refresh_token_ttl_secs|body|integer|false|The time to live in seconds of the Refresh Token, after that time the Refresh Token is invalid and can't be used to refresh Client Token.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJFZDI1NTE5IiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0..1JGK9PyHkTtoP_iMu-8TzXH_fhmnsDtZZOAJLDzLW6DDtAb80wZ93l1VH5yNx5tFqwIFG0t48dRiBKWlW-nzDA",
    "token_expires_at": "2021-04-22T12:24:55Z",
    "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJFZDI1NTE5IiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0..FHsp7KlVXn1E5tTUiKZzmQ4of39gi57AakeQeqI0oAa8hzjFMVb0RGj-mxWTvHVen4GpgsUW_epqqaxK16viCA",
    "refresh_token_expires_at": "2021-04-22T12:15:05Z"
  }
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "detail": "string",
  "source": {
    "pointer": "string",
    "parameter": "string"
  },
  "meta": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Create room client token response.|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[video_Error](#schemavideo_error)|

<h3 id="create-client-token-to-join-a-room-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|object|false|none|none|
|» token|string|false|none|none|
|» token_expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp when the token expires.|
|» refresh_token|string|false|none|none|
|» refresh_token_expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|ISO 8601 timestamp when the refresh token expires.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>
